(na) (8) Natthi hataṃ hananaṃ imassāti nīhataṃ. Pācita, yo. 107.

[ hata + bhavarāga ]  CL=7 One whose passion for existence (bhavarāga) has been destroyed.
Bhavarāgahatassa me satoti ---- aggamaggena vā hatabhavarāgassa. Thera, ṭṭha, 1. 389.
hatabhāva:
[ hata + bhāva ]  CL=7 (1) A state of being killed. (2) A state of being destroyed.
(1) vuttappakārā akusaladhammā, te sabbe hatabhāvaṃ pāpuṇanti. Cūḷani, ṭṭha. 11. (2) See - hatabhāvadīpana.
hatabhāvadīpana:
[ hatabhāva + dīpana ]  CL=7 Showing the state of having been destroyed.
Saṃsāracakkassa ca arānaṃ hatabhāva-dīpanato. Dī, ṭī, 1. 295. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 245.
hatabhūna:
[ hata + bhūna ]  CL=7 One who has destroyed growth or prosperity.
Bhūnahatā (jā, 1. 125) ti hata-bhūnā, hatavuḍḍhīti attho. Jā, ṭṭha, 3. 166.
hatacakkhu:
[ hata + cakkhu ]  CL=7 (1) One whose wisdom eye has been destroyed. (2) One whose pasāda eye has been destroyed.
(1) ubhayattha kaliggāho, andhassa hatacakkhuno. Aṃ, 1. 127. (2) handāhaṃ hatacakkhusmi, kantāraddhānamāgato. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 1. 11.
hataccika:
[ hata + accika ]  CL=7 Free from flame. An extinguished fire.
Hataccikaṃ viyā (dī, 2. 111) ti yathā hatacciko aṅgāro antanteneva jotati, bahi panassa pabhā natthi, evaṃ bahi paṭicchannappabhaṃ hutvā khāyatīti attho. Dī, ṭṭha, 2. 161. Hataccikaṃ viyāti paṭihatappabhaṃ. Dī, ṭī, 2. 172.
hatachāpa:
[ hata + chāpa ]  CL=7 One whose young son was killed.
Hatachāpāvā (jā, 2. 227) ti hatapotakāva. Jā, ṭṭha,7. 34. Hatachāpā (jā, 2. 321) ti hatapo-takā. Jā, ṭṭha, 7. 268.
hatadabba:
[ hata + dabba. dabbo ahaṅkā-ro. nīti, dhātu. 124. ]  CL=7 One whose pride has been destroyed.
Sukhito sahito saṅgho, hatadabbā ca titthiyā. Apa, 2. 209. Therī, ṭṭha. 150.
hatadujjanasambādha:
[ hata + dujjana + sambādha]  CL=7 That which is hard and narrow for wicked or unwholesome people who have been struck down.
Hatadujjana-sambādhe, pavivekasukhe sive. Buddhavaṃ, ṭṭha. 353.
hataguṇa:
[ hata + guṇa ]  CL=7 The qualities that have been destroyed or struck down.
Mānahatā (thera. 369) ti mānena hataguṇā. Thera, ṭṭha, 2. 225.
hatakulika: [ hata + kula + ika ]  CL=7 One who has a broken lineage. See - hata - 1 (1).
hatakāraṇa: [ hata + kāraṇa ]  CL=7 (1) One who has destroyed the cause or root that should be destroyed. (Na) (2) A cause or root that should be eliminated, or a mistaken cause. (1) See - hatūpanisa. (Na).
hatalābhasakkāra:
[ hata + lābha + sakkāra ]  CL=7 One who has destroyed gain and honor.
Titthiyā hatalābhasakkārā hutvā kulesu evaṃ kathentā vicaranti. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 150. Te hatalābhasakkārā nippabhā nittejā issāpakatā ciñca-mānavikaṃ nāma paribbājikaṃ uyyojesuṃ. Itivuta, ṭṭha. 82.
hatamada:
[ hata + mada ]  CL=7 One whose mental intoxications or delusions have been destroyed.
Saṅgātigo hatamado, tevijjā tibhavantago. Apa, 1. 379.
hatamahiṃsa:
[ hata + mahiṃsa ]  CL=7 One who has killed buffaloes.
Hatamahiṃsanaraturaṅgādiradādīnaṃ aṅgāni ālumpitvā. Buddhavaṃ, ṭṭha. 249.
hatamatasatta:
[ hata + mata + satta ]  CL=7 Living beings who have been killed, such as thieves, and other beings who are dead (naturally).
Hatamatasatte (visuddhi, 1. 223) ti corādīhi hate, sarasena mate ca satte. Visuddhi, ṭī, 1. 288.
hatanetta:
[ hata + netta ]  CL=7 (1) One whose wisdom eye has been destroyed. (2) One whose eye of pasāda has been destroyed.
(1) hatanetto (paṭisaṃ. 124) ti naya-naṭṭhena nettanti saṅkhaṃ gatāya paññāya abhāvatoyeva vinaṭṭhanetto. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 21. (2) andhohaṃ hatanettāsmi, kantāraddhānapakkhando. Thera. 244. Hatanettāti vinaṭṭhacakkhuko. Thera, ṭṭha, 1. 249.
hatanihatamānadabba:
[ hata + nihata + māna + dabba ]  CL=7 See - hatadabba.
Hatanihata-mānadabbo hoti. Milinda. 341.
hatantarāya:
[ hata + antarāya ]  CL=7 The harm or obstacles that have been destroyed.
Hatantarā-yo (vi, ṭṭha, 1. 1) ti ---- hato viddhasto antarāyo upaddavo assāti hatantarāyo. Sārattha, 1. 15. Hatantarāyo (netti, ṭṭha. 1) ti viddhasta-upaddavo hutvāti sambandho. Netti, ṭī. 13.
hatapahata:
[ hata + pahata ]  CL=7 Beating and killing.
Aṅgulimā-lo nāma hoti luddo lohita-pāṇi hatapahate niviṭṭho. Ma, 2. 301.
hatapakkha:
[ hata + pakkha ]  CL=7 One whose lower part of the body is destroyed.
Pakkhahatoti hatapakkho pīṭhasappī. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 76, 321-2.
hatapañña:
[ hata + paññā + a ]  CL=7 One whose wisdom has been destroyed.
Evameva hatapaññatāya rittakumbhisadisaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ vādavinandhanena samantā vinandhissāmāti vadati. Dī, ṭṭha, 3. 18.
hatapaṭipakkha:
[ hata + paṭipakkha ]  CL=7 One who has had the opposing principles (or opposite dhammas) destroyed.
Puthujjanānampi vigatūpakkilese aṭṭhaguṇa-samannāgate citte hatapaṭipakkhe iddhividhaṃ pavattati. Udāna, ṭṭha. 9. Itivuta, ṭṭha. 19. Sārattha, 3. 206.
hatappabha:
[ hatā + pabhā + a ]  CL=7 The light or radiance that has been destroyed.
Hatappabho (udāna. 169) ti nittejo kāḷako hoti. Udāna, ṭṭha. 325-6. Hatappabhā (ma, ṭṭha, 1. 309) ti buddhānubhāvena vigatatejā. Ma, ṭī, 2. 3.
hataputta:
[ hata + putta ]  CL=7 One whose son has been killed (or destroyed).
Sakuṇī hataputtāva, suññaṃ disvā kulāvakaṃ. Jā, 2. 227, 321. Suttahatāya puttoti hataputtāya putto ---- hataputtaṭṭhāne tiṭṭhatīti hataputtāya putto nāma hoti. Jā, ṭṭha, 1. 376. Puttahatāyā (saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 309) ti hataputtāya. Saṃ, ṭī, 1. 330
hataputtabhātika:
[ hataputta + bhātika]  CL=7 One whose son and brother have been killed.
Kupitena hi raññā issariyaṃ acchinditvā hataputtabhāti-kānaṃ āṇattavadhānaṃ bhayena ---- kāyadukkhaṃ uppajjati. Abhi, ṭṭha, 2. 99.
hataputtaṭṭhāna: [ hataputta + ṭhāna ]  CL=7 A place of one whose son has been killed. See - hataputta.
hatarāgadosamoha: [ hata + rāga + dosa + moha ]  CL=7 One who has killed passion, anger, and delusion. See - hata1 (3).
hatasabbapāpa:
[ hata + sabba + pāpa ]  CL=7 One who has destroyed all unwholesome deeds.
Saṅghañca seṭṭhaṃ hatasabbapāpaṃ. Aṃ, ṭī, 1. 1.
hatasaṃsāracakkāra:
[ hata + saṃsāra + cakka + ara ]  CL=7 Lord Buddha who has destroyed the cycle of rebirth.
Hatasaṃsāra-cakkāro, paccayādīnacāraho. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 87. Visuddhi, 1. 195. Suttani, ṭṭha, 2. 163. Mahāni, ṭṭha. 161.
hatasobha:
[ hatā + sobhā ]  CL=7 (1) Destroyed radiance. (2) One whose beauty has destroyed.
(1) sūriyuṭṭhāne khajjopanake viya ca hatappabhe hatasobhe. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 139. (2) āṇigaṇṭhikāhato (visuddhi, 1. 104) ti āṇinā, gaṇṭhiyā ca hatasobho. Visuddhi, ṭī, 1. 129.
hataupanissaya: [ hata + upanissaya ]  CL=7 One who has destroyed the dependent place, support, or base. See - hatūpanisa.
hatavantu:
[ hana + tavantu ]  CL=7 One who is skilled in killing or has a tendency to kill.
Tavantupaccayamhi- akāsīti katavā, ahanīti hatavā. Nirutti. 727.
hatavatthaka:
[ hata + vattha + ka ]  CL=7 A robe that is beaten and washed due to use for long times.
Utuddhaṭāna (vi, 3. 403)nti ututo dīghakālato uddhaṭānaṃ hata-vatthakānaṃ, pilotikānanti vuttaṃ hoti. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 409. Hatavatthakānanti kālā-tītavatthānaṃ. Sārattha, 3. 340. Hatavatthakānanti purāṇavatthānaṃ. Vimati, 2. 198.
hatavatthakasāṭaka:
[ hatavatthaka + sāṭaka ]  CL=7 The faded clothes or garments that have been beaten and washed.
Pilotikāyā (vi, 3. 353) ti hatavatthakasāṭakena. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 393. Hatavatthakasāṭakenāti atijiṇṇasāṭako. Vimati, 2. 194.
hatavaḍḍhi:
[ hata + vaḍḍhi ]  CL=7 See - hatabhūna.
Bhūnahuno (ma, 2. 169) ti hata-vaḍḍhino mariyādakārakassa. Ma, ṭṭha, 3. 147. Bhūnaṃ vuccati vaḍḍhitaṃ, taṃ hantīti bhūnahūno. Tenāha “Hatavaḍḍhino”ti. Ma, ṭī, 3. 103.
hatavikkhittaka:
[ hata + vikkhattika. hatañca taṃ vikkhittañcāti viggaho. maṇi-mañjū, 2. 481. ]  CL=7 A disgusted corpse that one who is killed by a knife and cut into pieces and thrown, that is decayed and rotten.
Hatañca taṃ purimanayeneva vikkhittakañcāti hatavikkhittakaṃ. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 242-3. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 219. Visuddhi, 1. 174. Aṃ, ṭī, 1. 272. ---- hatavikkhittakaṃ lohi-takaṃ ----. Visuddhi, 1. 107.
hatavikkhittakapaṭikkūla:
[ hatavikkhittaka + paṭikkūla ]  CL=7 That which is disgusted by cutting into pieces and thrown away.
“Hatavikkhittakapaṭikkūlaṃ hatavikkhittakapaṭikkūla”nti manasikāro pavattetabbo. Visuddhi, 1. 185.
hatavikkhittakasaññā:
[ hatavikkhittaka + saññā ]  CL=7 The first Jhāna that arises from perceiving the repulsive corpse that has been cut into pieces and thrown away.
Hatavikkhittaka-saññāsahagataṃ. Abhi, dha. 68.
hatavilutta:
[ hata + vilutta ]  CL=7 Plundered and destroyed.
Katthaci suññā honti hataviluttā. Dī, ṭṭha, 3. 35. Tena te sakalaraṭṭhaṃ hataviluttaṃ viya vinaṭṭhaṃ. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 103.
hataviluttākoṭitabhāvadassana:
[ hatavilutta + ākoṭita + bhāva + dassana ]  CL=7 Seeing the state of killing, plundering, destruction, and striking.
Corehi manussānaṃ hataviluttākoṭitabhāvadassanato sanni-hitabalavabhayānīti attho. Kaṅkhā. 188. Sārattha, 2. 446-7. (-kaṅkhā, ṭī, saca. 342).
hatavuddhi:
[ hata + vuddhi ]  CL=7 One who destroyed the growth or prosperity.
Bhūnahaccānī (aṃ, 2. 472) ti hatavuddhīni. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 179. Bhūnaṃ vuccati vuddhi, tassa hananaṃ ghāto etesanti bhūnahaccāni. Tenāha “Hatavuddhīnī”ti. Aṃ, ṭī, 3. 186.
hatavuḍḍhi:
[ hata + vuḍḍhi ]  CL=7 (1) See - hatabhūna. (2) One who has destroyed the growth or prosperity.
(2) bhūnahatā (jā, 2. 251) ti hatavuḍḍhi. Jā, ṭṭha, 7. 93.
hati:
[ hana + ti ]  CL=7 He destroys or kills.
Upahananaṃ upahati. Nirutti. 727.
hattha:
[ hasa + ta. hasa + tha. hara + tha. hasa hasane-hasantunenāti hattho. karo, nakkhattañca. ṇvādi. 88. hasa hasane tho, hara haraṇe vā. dhāna်, ṭī. 265. hasadhātumhā tho, to vā. dhāna်, ṭī. 268. hana + tha. hana gatiyaṃ. avayavā nihananti etthāti hattho, tho. dhāna်, ṭī. 257. haṃsa + ta. haṃsa pahaṃsane haṃsīyitthāti hattho, niggahitalopo. nirutti. 749. hattha + a. hatthasaṇṭhānatāya hattho. dhāna်, ṭī. 58-60. hattha-sahitattā vā pakoṭṭho attho. dhāna်, ṭī. 268.hasta-saṃ.hattha-prā, addhamāgadhī. ]  CL=7 (1) A hand. (A) From an elbow to the tip of the fingernail. (B) The body that is grasped or attached to. (C) From the wrist to the tip of the fingernail. (2) Hattha constellation. Hasta constellation. (3) The upper arm. (4) The wrist. (5) Fingers. (6) Cupped hand. (7) The trunk of an elephant. (8) The cubit or the length from the elbow to the tip of the middle fingernail. (9) The handle. (10) A collection or an aggregate. (11) The braid or pigtail. (12) The feather of the bird. (Thi) (13) A queen of King 3rd Okkāka is named Hattha.
(1) (A) Hattho nāma kapparaṃ upādāya yāva agganakhā. Vi, 1. 174. Vi, 2. 286. (B) Hatthaggāhaṃ vā (vi, 1. 173) ti ettha hatthena sabbopi upādinnako kāyo saṅgahito, na bhinnasantāno tappaṭibaddho vatthālaṅkārādi. Kaṅkhā. 50. (C) Hatthā-nañca pādānañca sarassa ca nimittaṃ aggahesi. Vi, 1. 18. Hatthānanti bhikkhāggahaṇatthaṃ pattaṃ upanāmayato maṇibandhato pabhuti dvinnampi hatthānaṃ. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 175. Ma, ṭṭha, 3. 405. (2)  maghā ca phaggunī dve ca, hattho cittā ca sātipi. Dhāna. 59. (3) See - Hatthakoccha. (4) Hatthaṃ pādaṃ vā cāletvā (dī, ṭṭha, 2. 209) ti hattha-layapādalaye sajjetvā. Dī, ṭī, 2. 193. (5) Hatthasaddo cettha tadekadesesu aṅgulīsu daṭṭhabbo “Na bhuñjamāno sabbaṃ hatthaṃ mukhe pakkhi-pissāmī”tiādīsu viya. Sārattha, 2. 69. Kaṅkhā, ṭī, saca. 180. Dī, ṭī, 1. 220. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 33. Hatthabhatti (vi, 4. 296) nti pañcaṅgulibhattiṃ. Vi, ṭṭha, 4. 61. (6) Hatthe (dī, ṭṭha, 1. 58) ti hatthapasate, karapuṭe vā. Sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 243. (7) Hatthīti kuñjaro, so hi soṇḍasaṅkhātahattha-yuttattā “Hatthī”ti vuccati. Pācita, yo. 87. (8) Hatthasatampi uddhaṃ gantvā sampattaṃ gahetuṃ vaṭṭati. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 116. Vi, saṅgaha. 119. Hatthasatampīti ratanasatampi. Pācita, yo. 92. (9) Hatthenā (saṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 337) ti hatthapade-sena. Saṃ, ṭī, 2. 549. Hattho pāṇimhi ratane. Dhāna. 931. Ratane dvividatthike. Dhāna, ṭī. 931. (10) Hattho pāṇimhi ratane, gaṇe soṇḍāya bhantare. Dhāna. 931. Gaṇe samūhe yathā “Kesahattho”ti. Dhāna, ṭī. 931. (11)  pāso hattho kesacaye. Dhāna. 257. Pāso hattho ca ime dve kesacaye kesapariyāyato pare hutvā kesānaṃ kalāpe vattanti, na kevalā, yathā- kesapāso kesahattho iccādi. Dhāna, ṭī. 257. (12) Saṅkuṭitahatthapādā (vi, ṭṭha, 1. 109) ti ettha hatthāti pakkhā. Na hi kukkuṭānaṃ pakkhato añño hattho nāma atthi. Sārattha, 1. 351. Sakuṇānaṃ pakkhā hatthapādaṭṭhāniyāti āha “Saṅkuṭita-hatthapādā”ti. Vimati, 1. 70. (thī) (13) Tesu tatiyaokkākassa pañca mahe-siyo ahesuṃ hatthā cittā jantu jālinī visākhāti. Suttani, ṭṭha, 2. 85.
hatthabandha:
[ hattha + bandha ]  CL=7 The ornament worn on the hand.
Ucchādanaṃ parimaddanaṃ nhāpanaṃ sambāhanaṃ ādāsaṃ añjanaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ mukhacuṇṇaṃ hatthabandhaṃ ---- odātāni vatthāni dīghadasāni iti vā. Dī, 1. 7, 62. Mahāni. 296. Hatthabandhādīsu hatthe vicitrasaṅkhakapālādīni bandhitvā vicaranti, taṃ vā aññaṃ vā sabbampi hatthā-bharaṇaṃ na vaṭṭati. Dī, ṭṭha, 1. 85. Hatthabandhanti hatthe bandhitabbamābharaṇaṃ, taṃ pana saṅkha-kapālādayoti āha “Hatthe”ti-ādi. Sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 366.
hatthabhamukādivikkhepa:
[ hattha + bhamuka + ādi + vikkhepa ]  CL=7 Waving the hand, eyebrow, and so on.
Vaṇṇasaṇṭhānavikkhepehī (visuddhi, 1. 363) ti kāḷasāmatādivaṇṇehi, puthulavivarakisatādisaṇṭhā nehi hatthabhamukādivikkhepehi ca. Visuddhi, ṭī, 1. 450.
hatthabhatti:
[ hattha + bhatti ]  CL=7 Applied or smeared with the hand (five fingers).
Anujānāmi bhikkhave hatthabhattinti. Vi, 4. 296. Hatthabhattinti pañcaṅguli-bhattiṃ. Vi, ṭṭha, 4. 61.
hatthabhattikamma:
[ hattha + bhattikamma ]  CL=7 The action of marking with the hand.
Anujānāmi bhikkhave hatthabhattikammanti. Vi, 4. 296.
hatthabhāra:
[ hattha + bhāra ]  CL=7 The load or burden in the hand.
Yathā kantāraddhānapakkhandā (mahāni. 124) ti yasmā balavanto purisā hatthabhāraṃ gahetvā sajjāvudhā saparivārā kantāraṃ paṭipajjanti. Mahāni, ṭṭha. 245.
hatthacalana:
[ hattha + calana ]  CL=7 Shaking or moving the hand.
Imassa hi nisinnaṭṭhāne hatthacalanaṃ vā pādacalanaṃ vā kāyavijambhitā vā natthi. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 2. 378.
hatthaccheda:
[ hattha + cheda ]  CL=7 Cut off a hand.
Niggaho nāma bhante nāgasena hatthacchedo pādacchedo vadho bandhanaṃ. Milinda. 183. Ayaṃ rājāparādhiko hatthacchedaṃ arahati. Suttani, ṭṭha, 1. 54.
hatthacchedana:
[ hattha + chedana ]  CL=7 Cutting off a hand.
Hatthacchedanampi dukkhaṃ, pādacchedanampi dukkhaṃ. Milinda. 194.
hatthacchedādibheda: [ hatthacchedādi + bheda]  CL=9 having the types such as cutting the hand, etc. Kāraṇā nāma “Hatthacchedādibhedā adhikapīḷā karīyati etāyā”ti katvā yātanā. Ma, ṭī, 3. 363.
hatthacchedādidaṇḍa: [ hatthacchedādi + daṇḍa ]  CL=9 punishment such as one"s hand being cut, etc. Taṃ dosaṃ appaṭivekkhitvā hatthacchedādi-daṇḍaṃ karoti. Jā, ṭṭha, 4. 193.
hatthacchedādidukkha: [ hatthacchedādi + dukkha ]  CL=9 Suffering such as one"s hand being cut, etc. Saññāya sati hatthacchedādi-dukkhañceva sabbabhayāni ca honti. Netti, ṭṭha. 134.
hatthacchedādika:
[ hatthaccheda + ādi + ka ]  CL=7 The act of cutting a hand and others.
Bhedana (dhamma. 34) nti hatthacchedādikaṃ sarīrabhedanaṃ. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 2. 45.
hatthacchedādikammakāraṇā:
[ hatthacchedādi + kamma + kāraṇā ]  CL=7 The actions or deeds involving the cutting of the hand, and similar afflictions. (32 kinds of actions or deeds).  See - kammakaraṇā.
Tattha tattha rājādi-to hatthacchedādikammakāraṇaṃ pāpuṇanto mahādukkhaṃ anubhavati. Vimāna, ṭṭha. 19, 20.
hatthacchedādikāraṇayoga:
[ hatthacchedādi + kāraṇa + yoga. kāraṇā?]  CL=7 Connected to the affliction of cutting the hand, and so on.
Pariyeṭṭhimūlakaṃ mahantaṃ anayabya-sanaṃ pāpuṇante hatthacchedādikāraṇayo-gena. Cariyā, ṭṭha. 310. Dī, ṭī, 1. 91.
hatthacchedādilābha: [ hatthacchedādi + lābha]  CL=9 Attainment of- obtaining- the cutting the hand. Na kevalaṃ tuyhaṃ idha ---- hatthacchedādilābhopīti dassetuṃ. Vimāna, ṭṭha. 210.
hatthacchedādiparikilesāpatti: [ hatthacche-dādi + parikilesa + āpatti ]  CL=9 reaching the misery- punishment such as cutting one"s hand, etc. Parikleso (therī. 417) ti hatthacchedādiparikilesāpatti. Therī, ṭṭha. 249.
hatthacchejja:
[ hattha + chejja ]  CL=7 See - hatthaccheda.
Yaṃ tava pāṇippahāre hatthacchejjaṃ pādacchejjaṃ ----. Milinda. 191.
hatthacchinna:
[ hattha + chinna. hatthā chinnā yassāti hatthacchinno. pācita်, yo. 268. ]  CL=7 One whose hand is cut.
Dujjīvitaṃ nāma hatthacchinnassa pādacchinnassa ----. Vi, 1. 93. Hatthacchinnādivatthūsu hatthacchinno (vi, 3. 126) ti yassa hatthatale vā maṇibandhe vā kappare vā yattha katthaci eko vā dve vā hatthā chinnā honti. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 308. Vi, saṅgaha. 140. Ayameva so hatthacchinno anañño. Jā, 1. 50. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 109.
hatthacchinnapāḷi:
[ hatthacchinna + pāḷi ]  CL=7 The Pali word for "cut-off hand".
Upālitthero idha hatthacchinnapāḷiyaṃ āha. Vajira. 438.
hatthacchinnādibheda:
[ hatthacchinnādi + bheda]  CL=7 Distinguished by one whose hand is cut off, etc.
Aṅgahīno nāma hatthacchinnādibhedo. Vi, ṭṭha, 4. 161.
hatthacchinnādika:
[ hatthacchinna + ādi + ka]  CL=7 One whose hand is cut off, etc.
Tañca hatthacchinnādiko ekacco paṭikkhittattā appattopi sosārito. Vimati, 2. 286.
hatthacchinnādivatthu: [ hatthacchinnādi + vatthu ]  CL=7 The subject concerns a person whose hand is cut off, and so on. See - hatthacchinna.
hatthacchinnādivatthukathā:
[ hatthacchinnādivatthu + kathā ]  CL=7 The discourse related to the story of an individual whose hand is cut off.
Hatthacchinnādivatthukathā. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 308.
hatthacchinnādivatthukathāvaṇṇanā:
[ hatthacchinnādivatthukathā + vaṇṇanā ]  CL=7 The commentary on the story of individuals whose hand is cut off.
Hatthacchinnādivatthuka-thāvaṇṇanā niṭṭhitā. Vajira. 439. Sārattha, 3. 265. Vimati, 2. 128.
hatthacāpalla: [ hattha + cāpalla ]  CL=7 Fidgeting with the hand or restless movement of the hand. See - hatthakukkucca.
hatthadhovana:
[ hattha + dhovana ]  CL=7 Hand washing water.
Bhisāluvañca pādāsiṃ, udakaṃ hatthadhovanaṃ. Apa, 1. 133. (jā, ṭṭha, 2. 153. Ma, ṭī, 3. 341).
hatthadhovanakicca:
[ hatthadhovana + kicca ]  CL=7 The activity of washing the hands.
Hatthadhovanakiccaṃ natthi. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 69. Vi, saṅgaha. 132.
hatthadhovanattha:
[ hatthadhovana + attha ]  CL=7 The benefit or purpose of washing the hands.
Maṇikāro sā-lohiteneva hatthena taṃ paṭigga-hetvā peḷāya upari ṭhapetvā hattha-dhovanatthaṃ anto pāvisi. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 2. 23.
hatthadhovanaudaka:
[ hatthadhovana + udaka]  CL=7 Hand washing water.
Na tāva udakanti idaṃ hattha-dhovanaudakaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ. Vi, ṭṭha, 4. 120. (vi, saṅgaha. 236). Hatthadhovanaudakaṃ sandhāyāti bhuttāvissa bhojanā-vasāne hatthadhovanaudakaṃ sandhāya. Sārattha, 3. 423. (-vimati, 2. 259).
hatthadhovanavelā:
[ hatthadhovana + velā ]  CL=7 The time of washing the hands.
Athassa hatthadhovanavelāya gandhamādane eko paccekabuddho sattame divase samāpatti-to vuṭṭhāya ---- bhattabhatikaṃ addasa. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 2. 57.
hatthadhovanodaka:
[ hatthadhovana + udaka ]  CL=7 See - hatthadhovanaudaka.
Athassa navasappinā saṅkhataṃ khīrayāguṃ purato ṭhapetvā hatthadhovanodakaṃ āhariṃsu. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 1. 406.
hatthadhovanādisabbakicca:
[ hatthadhovana + ādi + sabbakicca ]  CL=7 All duties, including hand washing and others.
Yathā āpo hatthadhovanādisabbakiccesu pāṇīnaṃ upayogaṃ gacchati. Suttani, ṭṭha, 2. 57.
hatthadhovanūdaka:
[ hatthadhovana + udaka]  CL=7 See - hatthadhovanaudaka.
Athassa hatthadhovanūdakaṃ datvā. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 2. 439.
hatthadvayamajjha:
[ hattha + dvaya + majjha ]  CL=7 At the center of the two hands.
Bhagavato kira piṇḍāya pavisitukāmassa bhamaro viya vikasitapadumadvayamajjhaṃ indanīlamaṇi-vaṇṇaselamayapatto hatthadvayamajjhaṃ āgacchati. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 226. Suttani, ṭṭha, 1. 126.
hatthadāna:
[ hattha + dāna ]  CL=7 Offering the hand.
Saddhammahatthadānatthaṃ hatthadānaṃ. Cariyā, ṭṭha. 298. Dī, ṭī, 1. 86. Sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 276.
hatthaga:
[ hattha + gamu + kvi ]  CL=7 See - hatthaka 3.
Tatiye hatthagoti vattabbe hatthakoti vuttaṃ. Aṃ, ṭī, 3. 233.
hatthagahaṇa:
[ hattha + gahaṇa ]  CL=7 Seizing by the hand.
Hattha-ga(gga)haṇanhāpana(nahāpana)dhovanacoḷa-parimajjanādikāle ---- dukkhamuppajjati. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 134. Abhi, ṭṭha, 2. 91. Mahāni, ṭṭha. 61. Visuddhi, 2. 131. Chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo avassutā avassutassa purisapuggalassa hatthaggahaṇampi sādiyanti. Vi, 2. 284. Purisapuggalassa hatthaggahaṇaṃ vātiādīsu pana yaṃ purisapuggalena hatthe gahaṇaṃ kataṃ, taṃ purisapuggalassa hatthagga-haṇanti vuttaṃ hoti. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 177. Kaṅkhā. 296. Hatthaggahaṇaṃ vā saṅghaṭi-kaṇṇaggahaṇaṃ vā sādiyati. Sārattha, 2. 298.
hatthagahaṇādikiriya:
[ hatthagahaṇa + ādi + kiriya ]  CL=7 Having reached the state of being taken by hand.
Ācāroti ācaraṇaṃ hatthagahaṇādikiriyā. Sārattha, 2. 317.
hatthagamana:
[ hattha + gamana ]  CL=7 Reaching in the hand.
Paṭirājūnaṃ hatthagamanavasena aññathābhāvo veditabbo. Ma, ṭṭha, 3. 238.
hatthagandha:
[ hattha + gandha ]  CL=7 The smell of the hand.
Hatthagandhañca mukhagandhañca ghāyitvā te bhikkhū parisaṅkanti. Vi, ṭṭha, 2. 171.
hatthagata:
[ hattha + gata ]  CL=7 That which is in one"s own hand, in one’s possession, or under one’s control.
Attano bhaṇḍaṃ parahatthagataṃ parabhaṇḍaṃ attano hatthagataṃ. Vi, 1. 351. Hatthagataṃ rajjasiriṃ kheḷapiṇḍaṃ viya chaḍḍetvā. Cariyā, ṭṭha. 189.
hatthagatabhaṇḍaggahaṇa:
[ hatthagata + bhaṇḍa + gahaṇa ]  CL=7 Taking the wealth or property that is secured in one"s own hand.
Sampattavisayagga-haṇaṃ kāmupādānaṃ corānaṃ hatthagata-bhaṇḍaggahaṇaṃ viya. Sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 464.
hatthagatadhanasāra:
[ hatthagata + dhana + sāra ]  CL=7 The essential wealth or property that is secured in one"s own hand.
Hatthasāra (dī, ṭṭha, 1. 194) nti hatthagata-dhanasāraṃ. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 132.
hatthagatakaraṇa:
[ hatthagata + karaṇa ]  CL=7 The act of bringing something into one’s control or possession.
Kāmaṃkā-ro pana hatthagatakaraṇavasenāti āha “Aggahetabbāti attho” ti. Dī, ṭī, 2. 124.
hatthagatakāla:
[ hatthagata + kāla ]  CL=7 The time of arriving in the hand or the time of possession.
Nanu imaṃ maṃsañca tvañca mama hatthagata-kālato paṭṭhāya mayhameva santakaṃ. Cariyā, ṭṭha. 165.
hatthagatamattikā:
[ hatthagatā + mattikā ]  CL=7 The clay that is in one"s own hand.
Baddhaṃ katvāti hatthagatamattikaṃ viya attano vase avattantaṃ katvā. Ma, ṭī, 3. 178.
hatthagatasadisa: [ hatthagata + sadisa ]  CL=7 Similar to something in one"s hand or something in one"s possession. See - hatthagatatta. .
hatthagatasuvaṇṇavalaya:
[ hatthagata + suvaṇṇa + valaya ]  CL=7 A gold bracelet or a gold bracelet worn on the hand.
Hatthagata-suvaṇṇavalayānaṃ aññamaññaṃ saṅghaṭṭanaṃ. Visuddhi, ṭī, 1. 291.
hatthagatatta:
[ hatthagata + sadisa + tta. majjhelopa. ]  CL=7 The state or essence of being secured in one’s control or something firmly within one’s possession or grasp.
Hatthagatattā (ma, ṭṭha, 2. 245) ti hatthagatasadisattā, āsannattāti attho. Ma, ṭī, 2. 266.
hatthagatādivisiṭṭha:
[ hatthagata + ādi + visiṭṭha ]  CL=7 Distinguished by being in one"s hand or possession, etc.
Hatthagatādivisiṭṭhā upani-dhāpaññatti. Anuṭī, 3. 39.
hatthagatūpanidhā:
[ hatthagata + upanidhā ]  CL=7 The Paññata that speaks or talks by touching the object or thing in hand.
Chattapāṇi satthapāṇītiādikā hatthagataṃ upanidhāya vuttatāya hattha-gatūpanidhā nāma. Abhi, ṭṭha, 3. 27.
hatthagayhūpaga:
[ hattha + gayhūpaga ]  CL=7 Reached a state of something that should be taken by hand.
Hatthaṃ āgacchatīti hatthagayhūpago hoti. Saṃ, ṭī, 1. 152.
hatthagaṇhanakarāja:
[ hattha + gaṇhanaka + rāja ]  CL=7 A king who holds the hand.
Attano dhītuyā hatthaga(gga)ṇhanakarājā viya. Dī, ṭī, 1. 174. Sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 446. Ma, ṭī, 3. 230.
hatthaggahaṇamatta:
[ hatthaggahaṇa + matta]  CL=7 (Na) (1) Merely holding the hand. (Ti) (2) That which is only holding the hand.
(Ti) (na) (1) hatthaggahaṇamattena ca tesaṃ kāmakiccaṃ ijjhati. Itivuta, ṭṭha. 286. (ti)
(2) See - hatthaggahaṇamattadibbaphassa.
hatthaggahaṇamattadibbaphassa:
[ hatthaggahaṇa-matta + dibba + phassa ]  CL=7 The touch or contact of a deva who merely holds the hand.
Tena dibbaphassenā (dī, ṭṭha, 1. 304) ti hatthaggahaṇamattadibbaphassena. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 374.
hatthaggahaṇādikāyasampayoga:
[ hatthaggahaṇādi + kāya + sampayoga]  CL=7 Association with the body in actions such as holding the hand, and so on.
Kāyasaṃsaggaṃ samāpajjeyyā (vi, 1. 173) ti hatthaggahaṇādikāyasampa-yogaṃ kāyamissibhāvaṃ samāpajjeyya. Vi, ṭṭha, 2. 120. Kaṅkhā. 128.
hatthaggāha:
[ hattha + gāha ]  CL=7 (1) Holding the hand. (2) Grasping something with one"s own hand.
(1) (2) hatthaggāhaṃ vā veṇiggāhaṃ vā. Vi, 1. 173. Hatthassa gahaṇaṃ hatthaggāho. Vi, ṭṭha, 2. 121. Kaṅkhā. 128. Hatthassa, tappaṭibandhassa ca gahaṇaṃ hatthaggāho. Vi, vinicchaya, ṭī, 1. 42.
hatthaggāhādika:
[ hatthaggāha + ādi + ka ]  CL=7 Actions such as holding or grasping the hand, and so on.
Assāti hatthaggādikassa sabbassa. Vimati, 1. 258.
hatthaggāhādisamāpajjana:
[ hatthaggāhādi + samāpajjana ]  CL=7 Reaching a state of holding the hand, and similar actions or attaining the condition of actions like grasping the hand, etc.
Hatthaggāhādisamā-pajjananti imānettha pañca aṅgāni. Kaṅkhā. 129.
hatthahāriya:
[ hattha + hāriya ]  CL=7 Able to be eaten by hand.
Sūpo nāma dvesūpā muggasūpo māsasūpo hatthahāriyo. Vi, 2. 249. (vi, ṭṭha, 2. 282. Kaṅkhā. 178, 281. Vi, saṅgaha. 37).
hatthaka:
[ hattha + gamu + kvi. hatthaga-hū liုlyaka် ga-kiု ka-pru. hastaka-saṃ. hatthaya-prā. ]  CL=7 (1) A bundle of ten flowers. (2) A thera named Hatthaka who was the sākiya prince. (3) A lay disciple named Hatthaka who is an etadagga, the son of the Āḷavī king. (4) A Brahma named Hatthaka. (5) Hatthakasutta, Aṅguttara Nikāya 3.35 (AN3.35), 3.128 (AN3.128).
(1) Yasmiṃ hatthake vatthu pūrati. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 286. Indīvarānaṃ hatthaka (vimāna. 63) nti uddālakapupphahatthaṃ vātaghātakapupphakalāpaṃ. ---- nīluppala-hatthakanti kuvalayakalāpaṃ. Vimāna, ṭṭha. 181. Dasahi pupphehi katakalāpo hatthako. Sārattha, 2. 140. (2) Tena kho pana samayena hatthako sakya-putto vādakkhitto hoti. Vi, 2. 1. (-vi, 5. 22). Tattha musāvādavaggassa tāva paṭhamasikkhāpade hatthakoti tassa therassa nāmaṃ. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 1. (-dī, ṭṭha, 3. 75. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 2. 247). (3) Catūhi saṅgahavatthūhi parisaṃ saṅgaṇhantānaṃ yadidaṃ hatthako āḷavako. Aṃ, 1. 27. (-135, 282. Aṃ, 3. 53-4-5). Evaṃ so kumāro rājapurisānaṃ hatthato yakkhassa hatthaṃ ---- bhagavato hattha-to puna rājapurisānaṃ hatthaṃ gatattā nāmato “Hatthako āḷavako”ti jāto. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 307. Itissa hatthato hatthaṃ gatattā “Hatthako āḷavako”tveva nāmaṃ akaṃsu. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 301. (-aṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 115. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 222). Tatiye hatthagoti vattabbe hatthakoti vuttaṃ. Aṃ, ṭī, 3. 233. (4) Atha kho bhagavā hatthakaṃ devaputtaṃ etadavoca oḷārikaṃ hatthaka attabhāvaṃ abhinimmināhīti. Aṃ, 1. 282. Dī, ṭṭha, 2. 172. (5) Kusinārabhaṇḍanā ceva, gotamabharaṇḍu-hatthako. Aṃ, 1. 287.
hatthakabaddha:
[ hatthaka + baddha ]  CL=7 A bundle of lotus flowers.
Hatthakabaddhāni honti. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 286.
hatthakacchapaka:
[ hattha + kacchapa + ka ]  CL=7 A cupped hand formed by the palms.
Apacitiṃ dassetvā hatthakacchapakaṃ katvā nisīdi. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 210.
hatthakakaca:
[ hattha + kakaca ]  CL=7 A saw with a hand-held handle or a saw with a handle held by hand.
Kakacenā (paṭisaṃ. 170) ti hatthakaka-cena. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 78.
hatthakamahābrahma:
[ hatthaka + mahābrahma]  CL=7 A great Brahma named Hatthaka.
Devaputto hi pañcālacaṇḍo viya hatthakamahābrahmā viya sanaṅkumārabrahmā viya ca eko dhamma-kathikadevaputto. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 365.
hatthakamma:
[ hattha + kamma ]  CL=7 Manual work or work done by hand such as carpentry.
Therā aṭṭhārasa mahā-vihārapaṭisaṅkharaṇatthāya hatthakammaṃ paṭivedasuṃ. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 9. Suddhacittena pana hatthakammaṃ yācantassa āpatti nāma natthi. Sārattha, 2. 330. Hatthakamma (khuddasikkhā. 40) nti hatthena kātabbaṃ vaḍḍhakīādīnaṃ kammaṃ. Khuddasikkhā, ṭī, saca. 404. Hatthakamma (dī, ṭṭha, 1. 9) nti hatthakiriyaṃ, hatthakammassa karaṇanti vuttaṃ hoti. Sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 72.
hatthakammakāraka:
[ hatthakamma + kāraka]  CL=7 One who does manual work or a manual laborer.
Rājā hatthakammakārake manusse adāsi. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 9. Khuddaka, ṭṭha. 80.
hatthakammamatta:
[ hatthakamma + matta ]  CL=7 Merely manual work.
Hatthakammamattaṃ me detha. Sārattha, 1. 29. Sārattha, 3. 332. Sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 41.
hatthakammamūla:
[ hatthakamma + mūla ]  CL=7 The price of the manual work.
Te ce hatthakammamūlaṃ ānetvā denti. Gahe-tabbaṃ. Vi, ṭṭha. 2. 262. Vi, saṅgaha. 61. Satasahassaṃ hatthakammamūlaṃ dīyittha. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 1. 249.
hatthakammasīsa:
[ hatthakamma + sīsa ]  CL=7 Making manual work the main task.
Hatthakamma-sīsena pana ekasmiṃ gehe mañcaṭṭhānamattaṃ labbhati. Abhi, ṭṭha, 2. 321.
hatthakammayācana:
[ hatthakamma + yācana ]  CL=7 Asking for the price of the manual work.
Hatthakamma-yācanavasena ca mūlacchejjāya vā ---- gahetuṃ vaṭṭati. Vi, ṭṭha, 2. 149. Vi, saṅgaha. 15.
hatthakammādisampaṭicchana:
[ hatthakamma + ādi + sampaṭicchana ]  CL=7 Accepting the manual work, etc.
Suṭṭhu vīmaṃsitvāva hattha-kammādisampaṭicchanaṃ saṅgahakaraṇañca yuttaṃ. Vimati, 1. 28.
hatthakasutta:
[ hatthaka + sutta ]  CL=7 Hatthakasutta, Aṅguttara Nikāya 3.35 (AN3.35); 3.128 (AN3.128) - (A) A discourse that speaks of the lay disciple Hatthaka, the Āḷavī prince. (B) A discourse concerning the Brahma Hatthaka.
(A) aṅguttara-nikāya, tikanipāta, 1-paṇṇāsaka, 4-vagga, 5-sutta. Aṃ, 1. 135. Aṭṭhakanipāta, 1-paṇṇāsaka, 3-vagga, 3-4-sutta. Aṃ, 3. 3. 53-4. (B) aṅguttaranikāya, tika-nipāta, 3-paṇṇāsaka, 3-vagga, 5-sutta. Aṃ, 1. 282.
hatthakasuttavaṇṇanā:
[ hatthakasutta + vaṇṇanā ]  CL=7 The commentary on the Hatthakasutta.
Aṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 23-8.
hatthakavatthu:
[ hatthaka + vatthu ]  CL=7 The life story of the venerable Hatthaka.
Hatthakavatthu chaṭṭhaṃ. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 2. 247-8. Khuddakanikāya, dhammapadaaṭṭhakathā, 19-vagga, 6-vatthu.
hatthakaṭaka:
[ hattha + kaṭaka ]  CL=7 A bracelet.
Hatthesu hatthakaṭakaṃ viya bāhāsu keyūraṃ viya. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 55.
hatthakicca:
[ hattha + kicca ]  CL=7 The manual work. Jivhā hatthakiccaṃ.
Visuddhi, 1. 339. Sīhānaṃ purimaṃ pādadvayaṃ hatthakiccampi karoti. Ma, ṭī, 2. 5.
hatthakiccasādhana:
[ hatthakicca + sādhana ]  CL=7 Accomplishing the manual work or function of a hand.
Jivhāya hatthakicca-sādhanañca hoti. Dī, ṭṭha, 1. 179. Ma, ṭṭha, 1. 271.
hatthakiriya:
[ hattha + kiriya ]  CL=7 Doing the manual work such as carpentry and other crafts.
Hatthakamma (dī, ṭṭha, 1. 9) nti hattha-kiriyaṃ, hatthakammassa karaṇanti vuttaṃ hoti. Sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 72.
hatthakoccha:
[ hattha + koccha ]  CL=7 Back of the hand.
Hatthakocchaṃ koṭṭāpenti. Vi, 4. 458. Hatthakocchanti piṭṭhihatthaṃ. Vi, ṭṭha, 4. 129.
hatthakosalla:
[ hattha + kosalla ]  CL=7 Skillful in the function of hands or handicrafts.
Sippa (khuddaka.4. Suttani. 319) nti yaṃ kiñci hattha-kosallaṃ. Khuddaka, ṭṭha. 112. Suttani, ṭṭha, 2. 18.
hatthakukkucca:
[ hattha + kukkucca ]  CL=7 Fidgeting with the hands or fiddling with the hands.
Hatthakukkucca (ma, 2. 339) nti ---- hatthena asaṃyatakaraṇaṃ. Ma, ṭṭha, 3. 267. Tattha hi ekabhikkhussāpi hatthakukkuccaṃ vā pādakukkuccaṃ vā khipitasaddo vā natthi. Dī, ṭṭha, 1. 139. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 253. Hatthassa kukatattā asaṃyamo asampajañña-kiriyā hatthakukkuccanti veditabbo. Dī, ṭī, 1. 217. Saṃ, ṭī, 1. 209. Hatthena, hatthassa vā kukatabhāvo hatthakukkuccaṃ, asaññamo, asampajaññakiriyā ca. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 26. Hatthakukkuccampī (mahāni. 167) ti hatthehi kucchitaṃ kataṃ kukataṃ, tassa bhāvo hatthakukkuccaṃ. Mahāni, ṭṭha. 281. Hatthena kucchitaṃ kataṃ hatthakukkuccaṃ, kukatameva kukkuccanti katvā. Dī, ṭī, 3. 165. Hatthakukkuccenā (vi, ṭṭha, 3. 30) ti hatthānaṃ asaṃyatabhāvena hattha-cāpallenāti vuttaṃ hoti. Sārattha, 3. 21. Hatthakukkuccenāti hatthacāpallena. Vimati, 2. 12. Hatthakukkuccenāti hattha-lolena. Pācita, yo. 22.
hatthakukkuccaka:
[ hatthakukkucca + ka. kara် + kvi. karotīti. ]  CL=7 One who is fidgeting with hands.
Hattha-kukkuccako bhikkhu kīḷanto bhājanaṃ āmasi. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 117.
hatthakukkuccavinodana:
[ hatthakukkucca + vinodana ]  CL=7 Removing the fidgeting with hands.
Bījanīgahaṇaṃ parisāya dhammaka-thikānaṃ hatthakukkuccavinodanamukhavikāra-paṭicchādanatthaṃ dhammatāvasena āciṇṇaṃ. Vimati, 1. 16.
hatthakukkuccādipubbāsevana:
[ hatthakukkucca + ādi + pubba + āsevana ]  CL=7 Repeated practice of fidgeting with hands in the past.
Diṭṭhapubbañcānena assa hatthakukkuccādipubbāsevanaṃ. Suttani, ṭṭha, 2. 79.
hatthakukkuccādirahita:
[ hatthakukkuccādi + rahita ]  CL=7 Free from hand-fidgeting and similar behaviors.
Sā nivāte dīpasikhā viya buddhagāravena hatthakukkuccādirahitaṃ niccalaṃ parisaṃ disvā. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 284.
hatthakukkuccādivirahita:
[ hatthakukkuccādi + virahita ]  CL=7 See - hatthakukkuccādirahita.
Akukkuco (suttani. 412. Mahāni. 165) ti hatthakukkuccādivira-hito. Suttani, ṭṭha, 2. 264. Mahāni, ṭṭha. 278.
hatthakuṇī:
[ hattha + kuṇī ]  CL=7 One with a crooked hand.
Kāyikena vā mānasikena vā paripīḷitassa hatthakuṇīti vā. Peṭako. 191. Kuṇī (vi, 3. 127) ti hatthakuṇī vā pādakuṇī vā aṅgulikuṇī vā. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 312. Vi, saṅgaha. 144.
hatthakārāpaṇiya:
[ hattha + kārā-paṇiya. kārāpaniya? ]  CL=7 The price of manual work.
Hatthakārā-paṇiyaṃ panassa satasahassaṃ. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 1. 260.
hatthakīḷāpana:
[ hattha + kīḷāpana ]  CL=7 Playing with hands.
Hatthasaṃyato (dhamma. 65) ti hatthakīḷāpanādīnaṃ vā hatthena paresaṃ paharaṇādīnaṃ abhāvena hatthasaṃyato. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 2. 362.
hatthalaya:
[ hattha + laya ]  CL=7 The harmony of the posture or arrangement of the hands and fingers.
Hatthaṃ vā pādaṃ vā cāletvā hattha-layapādalaye sajjetvā. Dī, ṭī, 2. 193.
hatthalaṅghana:
[ hattha + laṅghana ]  CL=7 Raising the hands.
Aññampi panettha hatthalaṅghanapāṇippahāraaṅguliphoṭanagīvunnāmanaukkā-sanādianekappakāraṃ saṅgahetabbaṃ. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 323.
hatthamalasūcimalādi:
[ hatthamala + sūcimala + ādi ]  CL=7 The dirt from the hands, needles, and other such things.
Cīvarakammakāle pana hatthamalasūcimalādīnaṃ dhovanatthaṃ kiliṭṭhakāle ca dhovanatthaṃ vaṭṭati. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 252. Vi, saṅgaha. 5.
hatthamatta:
[ hattha + matta ]  CL=7 The load or burden of the hand or the load carried in the hand.
Pacchimakoṭiyā hatthamattā sīmantarikā ṭhapetabbā. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 337. Vi, saṅgaha. 179. (vi, ṭṭha, 2. 303).
hatthamuccita:
[ hattha + muccita ]  CL=7 (1) One freed from using the hands such as driving the coach. (2) Released from the hands.
(1) (2) hatthamucci-to (cariyā. 413) ti muccitahattho, rathapācanato muttahatthoti attho. Atha vā hatthamuccitoti hatthamutto mama hatthato muccitvāti attho. Cariyā, ṭṭha. 216.
hatthamuddhā:
[ hattha + muddhā ]  CL=7 See - hatthamuddā.
Saṅghabhedo hatthamuddhāya bhedaṃ karontassa kāyadvārato samuṭṭhahitvāpi vacīdvārameva pūreti. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 357. Hatthasaṃvācikā (abhi, ka. 80) ti mūgā viya hatthamuddhāya vattāro. Abhi, ṭṭha, 3. 146.
hatthamuddā:
[ hattha + muddā ]  CL=7 (1) The movement or transformation of the hand, such as making hand gestures. (2) Indicating or expressing the meaning of one"s desire through hand gestures. (3) Counting using the finger joints. (4) Counting with the fists or finger joints.
(dī, ṭṭha, 1. 90. Kū. Sya). (1) na hatthamuddā dassetabbā (vi, 5. 287) ti kathetabbe ca akathetabbe ca saññājananatthaṃ hatthavikāro na kātabbo. Vi, ṭṭha, 4. 206. Adhippāya-viññāpako aṅgulisaṅkocanādiko hatthavikāro hatthamuddo. Kaṅkhā, ṭī, saca. 180. Hatthena adhippāyaviññāpanaṃ hatthamuddā. Dī, ṭī, 1. 220. (2) (3) (4) muddā (dī, 1. 10) ti hatthamuddā. Dī, ṭṭha, 1. 90. Hatthamuddāti hatthena adhippāyaviññāpanaṃ, taṃ pana aṅgulisaṅkocanena gaṇanā-yevāti ācariyadhammapālattherena vuttaṃ. Ācariyasāriputtattherena pana “Hatthamuddā nāma aṅgulipabbesu saññaṃ ṭhapetvā gaṇanā”ti dassitā. Sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 374.
hatthamuddādidassana:
[ hatthamuddādi + dassana ]  CL=7 Showing the transformation of the hands, such as bending or curving the fingers, which indicates the meaning of one"s desire.
Na akkharalikhanaṃ vā hatthamuddādidassanaṃ vā kāyapayogaṃ karontassa. Kaṅkhā. 108. Adhippāyaviññāpako aṅgulisaṅko-canādiko hatthavikāro hatthamuddā, hatthasaddo cettha tadekadesesu aṅgulīsu daṭṭhabbo “Na bhuñjamāno sabbaṃ hatthaṃ mukhe pakkhipissāmī”tiādīsu viya, tasmā adhippāyaviññāpakassa aṅguli-saṅkocanādino hatthavikārassa dassanaṃ hatthamuddādidassananti evamettha attho daṭṭhabbo. Kaṅkhā, ṭī, saca. 180-1.
hatthamuddāgaṇanā:
[ hatthamuddā + gaṇanā ]  CL=7 Counting using finger joints.
Muddā (vi, 3. 9) ti hatthamuddagaṇanā. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 5. Hatthamuddāgaṇanāti aṅgulisaṅkoce-neva gaṇanā. Sārattha, 3. 3. Hatthamuddā-gaṇanāti agulisaṅkocaneneva gaṇanā. Vimati, 2. 2.
hatthamukhapādadhovananhānodakasiñcana:
[ hattha + mukha + pāda + dhovana + nhāna + udaka + siñcana ]  CL=7 Pouring water to wash the hands, face, and feet.
Hatthamukhapādadhovananhānodakasiñcananti. Vi, ṭṭha, 2. 200. (sārattha, 2. 368).
hatthamutta:
[ hattha + mutta ]  CL=7 See - hatthamuccita.
Atha vā hatthamuccitoti hatthamutto mama hatthato muccitvāti attho. Cariyā, ṭṭha. 216.
hatthamuṭṭhi:
[ hattha + muṭṭhi ]  CL=7 The fist.
Hatthamuṭṭhiyā naṃ pucchissāmi. Jā, ṭṭha, 6. 205. (319).
hatthanakha:
[ hattha + nakha ]  CL=7 Finger nails.
Hatthanakhā uparimadisāyāti dvīsu disāsu jātā. Visuddhi, 1. 243. (jā, ṭṭha, 5. 472).
hatthanakhasikha:
[ hatthanakha + sikhā ]  CL=7 The tip of the fingernail.
Kapparato paṭṭhāya pana heṭṭhāya yāva hatthanakhasikhā. Ayaṃ olambakaparicchedo. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 293.
hatthaniddhunaka:
[ hattha + niddhunaka ]  CL=7 Shaking off the hands.
Tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū hatthaniddhunakaṃ bhuñjanti. Vi, 2. 257. (vi, 5. 50, 77). Hatthaniddhunakanti hatthaṃ niddhunitvā niddhunitvā. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 166. Kaṅkhā. 283. (vi, saṅgaha. 235). Tvāsaddena kiriyāvisesana-bhāvaṃ dasseti. Pācita, yo. 136.
hatthanillehaka:
[ hattha + nillehaka]  CL=7 Licking the hands.
Tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū hatthanillehakaṃ bhuñjanti. Vi, 2. 259. (vi, 5. 51, 77). Hatthanillehakanti hatthaṃ nille-hitvā nillehitvā. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 167. Kaṅkhā. 284.
hatthantara:
[ hattha + antara ]  CL=7 The space between the hands (the left and right hands).
Hatthantara (visuddhi, 1. 180) nti dakkhiṇahatthadakkhiṇapassānaṃ vāmahatthavāmapassā-nañca antaraṃ vivaraṃ. Visuddhi, ṭī, 1. 207.
hatthanāsādicchedana:
[ hattha + nāsā + ādi + chedana ]  CL=7 Cutting off hands and nose, etc.
Hananaṃ nāma hatthapādādīhi pothanañceva, hatthanāsādicchedanañca hotīti āha “Haneyyunti pothe-yyuñceva chindeyyuñcā”ti. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 269. Vimati, 1. 174.
hatthaotāraṇa:
[ hattha + otāraṇa ]  CL=7 Lowering the hand.
Bhojanādigahaṇatthāya hatthaotāraṇaṃ bhuñjanādiatthāya ālopakaraṇaṃ. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 103.
hatthapadesa:
[ hattha + padesa ]  CL=7 The hand area.
Yathā vā kuso ubhaya-bhāgagataṃ hatthapadesaṃ lunāti. Ma, ṭī, 1. 298. Visuddhi, ṭī, 2. 113, 454.
hatthapajjotanakammakāraṇa: [ hattha + pajjotana + kamma + kāraṇā ]  CL=7 The affliction of setting fire to the hands. See - Hatthapajjotika.
hatthapajjotika:
[ hattha + pajjota + ika]  CL=7 The act of torture involves setting fire to the hands.
Hattha-pajjotika (ma, 1. 122, 129) nti hatthe telapilotikāya veṭhetvā dīpaṃ viya jālenti. Ma, ṭṭha, 1. 363. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 2. Sārattha, 2. 262. Hatthapajjotikanti hatthapajjotanakammakāraṇaṃ. Ma, ṭī, 2. 43.
hatthapallatthika:
[ hattha + pallatthikā ]  CL=7 Sitting posture with the hands clasped around the knees.
Yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca hatthapallatthikāya vā dussa-pallatthikāya vā antaraghare nisīdati. Vi, 2. 248. (vi, ṭṭha, 3. 169).
hatthapariccheda:
[ hattha + pariccheda ]  CL=7 The boundary or limit of the hand.
Atha vā ayamassa hattha-paricchedo. Visuddhi, 1. 179.
hatthaparikamma:
[ hattha + parikamma ]  CL=7 Manual preparation, such as scrubbing or cleaning with one’s own hands.
Kāci hatthaparikammaṃ, katāvī naranāriyo. Apa, 2. 282. Puthupāṇika (vi, 3. 241) nti hatthaparikammaṃ vuccati. Tasmā sabbesaṃ hatthena piṭṭhiparikammaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati. Vi, ṭṭha, 4. 44. Vi, saṅgaha. 436. (sārattha, 2. 302).
hatthaparikammapādaparikammagattaparikam:
[ hatthaparikamma + pādaparikamma + gattaparikamma + karaṇa ]  CL=7 Scrubbing the dirt on the hands, feet, and body.
Hatthaparikammapāda parikammagattaparikammakaraṇena sacepi asuci muccati, anāpatti. Vi, ṭṭha, 2. 107. Kaṅkhā, ṭī, saca. 226.
hatthaparimaddana:
[ hattha + parimaddana ]  CL=7 Kneading or massaging the hands.
So putto ---- hattha-parimaddanena sītuṇhakāle ca uṇho-dakasītodakanhāpanena hatthapādādīnaṃ ākaḍḍhanaparikaḍḍhanasaṅkhātena sambāha-nena upaṭṭhānaṃ kareyya. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 28.
hatthaparāmasanāpajjana:
[ hattha + parāmasana + āpajjana ]  CL=7 Reaching a state of touching by the hand.
Bhaṇḍakassa kāraṇā hatthaparāmasanāpajjanaṃ viya dukkaṭadubbhā sitapācittiyathullaccayānaṃ āpajjana-kālo. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 63.
hatthaparāmāsa:
[ hattha + parāmāsa ]  CL=7 Touching the hands of each other or mutual touching of hands.
Hatthaparāmāsaṃ karontīti kodhavasena hatthehi aññamaññaṃ parāmasanaṃ karonti. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 432. (-saṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 63. Saṃ, ṭī, 2. 328).
hatthaparāmāsādikāyakalaha:
[ hattha-parāmāsa + ādi + kāya + kalaha ]  CL=7 Physical quarrel involves clutching, seizing, or grasping with the hand, etc.
Kalahappavaḍḍhanī (dī, 3. 148) ti vācā-kalahassa ceva hatthaparāmāsādi-kāyakalahassa vaḍḍhanī. Dī, ṭṭha, 3. 128.
hatthapasata:
[ hattha + pasata ]  CL=7 Cupped palm (of the hand).
Hatthehi hatthapa-sate, karapuṭe vā. Sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 243.
hatthapasāraṇa:
[ hattha + pasāraṇa ]  CL=7 Stretching out one"s hand.
Itaresaṃ dvinnaṃ dassanatthāya payogo bhavaggahaṇatthaṃ hatthapasāraṇaṃ viya ---- hoti. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 161. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 152. Sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 464.
hatthapasāraṇaṭṭhāna:
[ hatthapasāraṇa + ṭhāna ]  CL=7 A place of stretching out one"s hand.
Svāhaṃ idha me hatthapasāraṇaṭṭhānampi natthi. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 1. 191.
hatthapatha:
[ hattha + patha ]  CL=7 In the hand.
Sālasākhā suseditavettaggaṃ viya onamitvā deviyā hatthapathaṃ upagañchi. Jā, ṭṭha, 1. 62. (-261. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 53. Jā, ṭṭha, 3. 197).
hatthapatta:
[ hattha + patta ]  CL=7 Reached the ruby in the hand.
Tampi idāni hatthapattaṃ āgataṃ. Dhamma, ṭṭha,2. 173. (apa, ṭṭha, 2. 271).
hatthapatāpaka:
[ hattha + patāpaka ]  CL=7 The griddle or heated object that causes the hands to burn.
Hatthapatāpakaṃ---- sakkhalikaṃ ahamadāsiṃ. Ma, ṭṭha, 1. 323. Hatthapatā-pakanti mandāmukhi. Ma, ṭī, 2. 14.
hatthaphaṇa:
[ hattha + phaṇa ]  CL=7 The hands that are the object for combing or brushing hair.
Hatthaphaṇenā (hatthaphaṇakenavi, ṭṭha, 4. 45) ti hatthasaṅkhātena phaṇena. Pācita, yo. 451.
hatthaphaṇaka:
[ hatthaphaṇa + ka ]  CL=7 See - hatthaphaṇa.
Hatthaphaṇakena kese osaṇṭhenti. Vi, 4. 242.
hatthapiḷandhana:
[ hattha + piḷandhana ]  CL=7 An ornament is worn on the hand.
Hatthapiḷandhanādīni khipi. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 69. (470).
hatthapiṭṭha:
[ hattha + piṭṭha ]  CL=7 The back of the hand.
Kosiyassa hatthapiṭṭhe passāvabindu pati. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 414.
hatthapiṭṭhi:
[ hattha + piṭṭhi ]  CL=7 See - hatthapiṭṭha.
Sattussado (dī, 2. 15. Ma, 2. 337) ti dve hatthapiṭṭhiyo ---- imesu sattasu ṭhānesu. Dī, ṭṭha, 2. 39. Ma, ṭṭha, 3. 260.
hatthapiṭṭhipādapiṭṭhādi:
[ hatthapiṭṭhi + pādapiṭṭhi + ādi ]  CL=7 The back of the hand and the back of the feet, etc.
Hatthapiṭṭhipādapiṭṭhādīni sandhāya vadati. Ma, ṭṭha, 3. 161. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 315.
hatthappadesa:
[ hattha + padesa ]  CL=7 The hand area.
Yathā vā kusā ubhayabhāgagataṃ hatthappadesaṃ lunanti. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 81. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 121, 189.
hatthappamāṇa:
[ hattha + pamāṇa ]  CL=7 The measurement or extent of the arm"s length (one cubit).
Sabbattha pana hatthappamāṇato abbhantare ṭhapetuṃ vaṭṭati. Vimati, 2. 231. ---- sāṇiyā hatthappamāṇaṃ chiddaṃ katvā. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 478.
hatthappasāra:
[ hattha + pasāra ]  CL=7 The stretching or extending of the hands.
Parasampattīsu cetaso hatthappasāro viyāti daṭṭhabbā. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 291.
hatthappasāraṇa:
[ hattha + pasāraṇa ]  CL=7 The stretching or extending of the hands.
Itaresaṃ pana dvinnaṃ dassanatthāya payogo bhavaggahaṇatthaṃ hatthappasāraṇaṃ viya ---- hoti. Dī, ṭṭha, 2. 392. (ma, ṭṭha, 2. 60, 73. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 177. Ma, ṭī, 1. 320).
hatthappasāraṇamatta:
[ hatthappasāraṇa + matta ]  CL=7 Only the act of stretching or extending the hand.
Hatthappasāraṇamattena sīlabhedo natthi. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 342.
hatthappasāraṇaṭṭhāna:
[ hatthappasāraṇa + ṭhāna ]  CL=7 The place of stretching or extending the hand.
Yathā nisinnova hatthaṃ pasāretvā hatthappasāraṇaṭṭhāne ṭhitāni phalāni saṃharati. Jā, ṭṭha, 4. 8.
hatthappasāraṇokāsa:
[ hatthappasāraṇa + okāsa ]  CL=7 See - hatthappasāraṇaṭṭhāna.
Asaṅkamānā (jā, 1. 82) ti evaṃ atirekapaññāsavassāni imissā pabbata-guhāya ---- mama hatthatthaṃ hatthappasā-raṇokāsaṃ āgacchantīti attho. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 344.
hatthappasāraṇādippayoga:
[ hatthappa-sāraṇa + ādi + payoga ]  CL=7 Exertion or effort of stretching or extending the hands, and so on.
Gahaṇatthāya hatthappasāraṇādippayoge dukkaṭaṃ. Kaṅkhā. 165.
hatthappatta:
[ hattha + patta ]  CL=7 Reached in the hand.
Atha kho yaso kulaputto paṭikacceva pabujjhitvā addasa sakaṃ parijanaṃ ---- hatthappattaṃ susānaṃ maññe. Vi, 3. 21. (vi, ṭṭha, 2. 63. Vajira. 168. Sārattha, 2. 273).
hatthappatāpaka:
[ hattha + patāpaka ]  CL=7 The griddle that is a cause of burning the hand.
Hatthapatāpaka (vimāna. 46) nti mandāmukhiṃ. Vimāna, ṭṭha. 134. (apa, 1. 352. Vimāna, ṭṭha. 131).
hatthappayoga:
[ hattha + payoga ]  CL=7 Exertion or effort made with the hands.
Yena kenaci aṅgapaccaṅgene viññāpetīti manasā cintetvā hatthappayogādinā yena kenaci viññāpeti. Sārattha, 3. 278.
hatthapuñchana:
[ hattha + puñchana ]  CL=7 The cloth for rubbing the hands or napkin.
Saṅkhaṃ gaṅgodakaṃ ---- hatthapuñchanaṃ haricandanaṃ aruṇavaṇṇamattikaṃ añjanaṃ harītakaṃ āmalakanti. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 56. Hatthapuñchananti pītavaṇṇaṃ mahagghahatthapuñchanavatthaṃ. Vimati, 1. 33.
hatthapuṭa:
[ hattha + puṭa ]  CL=7 The cupped hand.
Yathā mahārāja kocideva puriso nāvāya mahāsamuddaṃ ajjhogāhetvā hatthapuṭena gahetvā. Milinda. 94. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 186. Añjali (dī, ṭṭha, 1. 212) nti hatthapuṭaṃ. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 195. (-kaṅkhā, ṭī, saca. 228).
hatthapādabhañjana:
[ hatthapāda + bhañjana ]  CL=7 Breaking or shattering the hands and feet.
Apakasseva kāya (saṃ, 1. 402) nti tādisāni ṭhānāni yo ---- ettha patito hatthapādabhañjanādīni pāpuṇāti. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 156.
hatthapādabhañjanādianattha:
[ hatthapādabhañjana + ādi + anattha ]  CL=7 The harmful or damaging result of breaking or shattering the hands and feet, etc.
So patitvā hatthapādabhañjanādianatthaṃ pāpuṇāti. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 156.
hatthapādacalana:
[ hatthapāda + calana ]  CL=7 The movement of the hands and feet.
suttākaḍḍhanavasena dāruyantassa hatthapādacalanaṃ viya samiñjana-pasāraṇaṃ hoti. Abhi, ṭṭha, 2. 343.
hatthapādaccheda:
[ hatthapāda + cheda ]  CL=7 See - Hattha-pādecchajja.
Sabbe te tāvatakena pāpena labhanti hatthacchedaṃ pādacchedaṃ hattha-pādacchedaṃ ----. Milinda. 280, 338.
hatthapādacchedana:
[ hatthapāda + chedana ]  CL=7 See - hatthapādaccheda.
Jāneyyuṃ te mahārāja dukkhaṃ hatthapādacchedananti. Milinda. 72, 116, 194.
hatthapādacchedanaghātana:
[ hatthapādacchedana + ghātana ]  CL=7 Killing by cutting off hands and feet.
Tāḷanagarahaṇapabbājanato uddhaṃ hatthapādacchedanaghātanaṃ nāma natthi. Jā, ṭṭha, 4. 193.
hatthapādacchedādidassanākāra:
[ hattha-pādaccheda + ādi + dassana + ākāra ]  CL=7 The manner of showing (or demonstrating) the cutting off of the hands and feet, and so on.
Dosanīyā (saṃ, 2. 495) ti dosapaccayā hatthapādacchedādidassanākārā. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 140.
hatthapādacchejja:
[ hatthapāda + chejja ]  CL=7 Cutting off hands and feet.
Te dhammasabhāyaṃ nisīditvā aparādhānurūpaṃ corānaṃ hattha-pādecchajjādiṃ anusāsanti. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 268.
hatthapādacchindanaka:
[ hatthapāda + chindana + ka ]  CL=7 A chopping block that causes the cutting off of the hands and feet.
Aṭṭhakathāyaṃ kāraṇāya guttibandhanāgāraṃ akaraṇaṭṭhānaṃ vā dhammagandhikā hatthapādacchindanakā gandhikāti likhitaṃ. Vajira. 192.
hatthapādacchinna:
[ hatthapāda + chinna ]  CL=7 One whose hands and feet are cut off.
Hatthapādacchinnaṃ pabbājenti. Vi, 3. 126. (vi, 1. 93). Hatthapādacchinnoti yassa vuttappakāreneva catūsu hatthapā-desu dve vā tayo vā sabbe vā hattha-pādā chinnā honti. Vi, saṅgaha. 140.
hatthapādachedanāpadesa:
[ hatthapādachedana + apadesa ]  CL=7 Indicating or pointing out the cutting off of the hands and feet.
Hatthapādachedanāpadesena cettha bāttiṃsa kammakaraṇāpi dassitā evāti daṭṭhabbaṃ. Therī, ṭṭha. 173.
hatthapādadhovanapubbaka:
[ hatthapāda + dhovana + pubbaka ]  CL=7 Preceded by the washing of the hands and feet or before the washing of the hands and feet.
Ācamayitvā (peta. 188) ti hatthapādadhovanapubbakaṃ mukhaṃ vikkhā-letvā. Peta, ṭṭha. 225.
hatthapādahasitakathitavilokitādippakāra:
[ hatthapādahasita-kathitavilokitādi + pakāra + bhāga]  CL=7 The various aspects include smiling, a sidelong glance, and looking at the hands and feet.
Anubyañjanasoti hatthapādasitakathitavilokitādippa-kārabhāgaso. Ma, ṭī, 1. 165.
hatthapādahasitakathitādi:
[ hatthapāda + hasita + kathita + ādi ]  CL=7 Actions such as smiling, speaking, and involving the hands and feet, etc.
Anubyañjanaṃ hatthapādahasitakathitādi. Netti, ṭī. 60.
hatthapādahasitakathitādippabheda:
[ hatthapādahasitakathitādi + pabheda ]  CL=7 The variety of aspects, such as smiling, speaking, and involving the hands and feet, etc.
Anubyañjanaggahīti hatthapādahasita-kathitādippabhede kilesānaṃ anu anu byañjanato anubyañjanasaññite ākāre gaṇhāti. Netti, ṭī. 88.
hatthapādahasitalapitavilokitādibheda:
[ hatthapādahasita + lapita + vilokita + ādi + bheda ]  CL=7 Having a variety of aspects, such as smiling, a sidelong glance, and looking at the hands and feet, etc.
Laddhavohāraṃ hatthapāda hasitalapitavilokitādibhedaṃ ākāraṃ gaṇhāti. Cūḷani, ṭṭha. 130.
hatthapādajivhāvikāra:
[ hatthapāda + jivhā + vikāra ]  CL=7 The transformation or changing for the worse of hands, feet, and tongue.
Ajjunakumāro pana tassā hatthapādajivhā-vikāre disvā. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 458.
hatthapādakaṇṇanāsakoṭi:
[ hattha + pāda + kaṇṇa + nāsa + koṭi ]  CL=7 The tips of the hand, feet, ear, and nose.
Tasmiṃ gate senāpati bodhisattassa sarīra-to lohitaṃ puñchitvā hatthapāda-kaṇṇanāsakoṭiyo sāṭakakaṇṇe katvā. Jā, ṭṭha, 3. 39.
hatthapādakicca:
[ hatthapāda + kicca ]  CL=7 Work or task of the hands and feet or work done by the hands and feet.
Vijjamānāpi me hatthapādā hatthapādakiccaṃ na karonti. Ma, ṭṭha, 4. 165. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 119.
hatthapādakoṭi:
[ hatthapāda + koṭi ]  CL=7 The tips of hands and feet.
Hatthapāda-koṭīhi ghaṭachiddehi lākhāraso viya lohitaṃ paggharati. Jā, ṭṭha, 3. 39.
hatthapādakukkucca:
[ hatthapāda + kukkucca ]  CL=7 Restlessness or agitation of the hands and feet or fidgeting with the hands and feet. H
Hatthapādakukkuccampi kukkuccaṃ. Cūḷani. 157. Mahāni. 167, 292.
hatthapādakukkuccarahita:
[ hatthapādakukkucca + rahita ]  CL=7 Free from restlessness of the hands and feet or free from fidgeting with the hands and feet.
Taṃsaṇṭhitassā (saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 159) ti tasmiṃ hatthapādakukkuccarahite buddha-munismiṃ avaṭṭhitassa. Saṃ, ṭī, 1. 206.
hatthapādalakkhaṇajānana: [ hatthapāda-lakkhaṇa + jānana ]  CL=9 Knowing the mark of the hands and legs.
hatthapādalakkhaṇakathana: [ hatthapāda + lakkhaṇa + kathana ]  CL=9 Telling the mark of the hands and legs.
hatthapādalaḷana: [ hatthapāda + laḷana ]  CL=9 Playing of- with the hands and legs.Vuttappakāra-cittakiriyavāyodhātuvipphārena pana suttākaḍḍhanavasena dāruyantassa hattha-pādalaḷanaṃ viya samiñjanapasāraṇaṃ hoti. Saṃ, ṭṭha. 3. 229.
hatthapādamudu: [ hatthapāda + mudu ]  CL=9 With soft hands; he. Hatthapādamudutañca vindati. Dī, 3. 124.
hatthapādamukhasaṇṭhāna:
[ hatthapādamukha + saṇṭhāna ]  CL=7 The form or appearance of the hands, feet, and face.
Avasesāpi payuttakadhuttā ekamantaṃ ṭhatvā hatthapādamukhasaṇṭhānehi ca ākappena ca mātāputtā ekasadisā-yevāti āhaṃsu. Jā, ṭṭha, 1. 309.
hatthapādamukhasītalakaraṇa:
[ hatthapādamukha + sītala + karaṇa ]  CL=7 The action of cooling the hands, feet, and face.
Tā pānīyañca hatthapādamukhasītalakaraṇañca paccāsīsanti. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 57.
hatthapādamukhādidehāvayava: [ hatthapādamukha + ādi + deha + avayava ]  CL=9 The parts such as hands, face. Dehakānī (therī. 423) ti hatthapādamukhādidehā-vayavā. Therī, ṭṭha. 264.
hatthapādamukhādiākāra:
[ hatthapādamukha + ādi + ākāra ]  CL=7 The manner, form, or appearance of the hands, feet, face, etc, or the quality or nature of the hands, feet, face, etc.
Sucittitā (therī. 423) ti hatthapādamukhādiākā-rena suṭṭhu cittitā viracitā. Therī, ṭṭha. 264.
hatthapādanippīḷana:
[ hatthapāda + nippīḷana ]  CL=7 Kneading or massaging hands and feet.
niddāyitvā vuṭṭhito hatthapādanippīḷanaṃ asahamāno ko me hatthapāde uppīḷeti. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 225.
hatthapādaparikamma:
[ hatthapāda + parikamma ]  CL=7 The act of scrubbing the hands and feet.
So upaṭṭhākaṭṭhānaṃ laddhadivasato paṭṭhāya dasabalassa duvidhena udakena tividhena dantakaṭṭhena hatthapādaparikammena ---- upaṭṭhahanto. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 230. Apa, ṭṭha, 1. 349.
hatthapādaparikammādikaraṇakāla:
[ hattha-pādaparikamma + ādi + karaṇa + kāla ]  CL=7 The time or period for performing the action or preparation (such as massaging, scrubbing, or other rituals) related to the hands, feet, etc.
Dahara-kāle kīdisaṃ ahosīti hatthapāda-parikammādikaraṇakāle hatthapādādīnaṃ vaṇṇaṃ kareyyāsi. Jā, ṭṭha, 1. 304.
hatthapādapariyanta:
[ hatthapāda + pariyanta ]  CL=7 The outermost parts or edge of the hands and feet.
Hatthapādapariyantā lākhārasaparikammakatā viya. Jā, ṭṭha, 1. 166.
hatthapādapasāraṇādikāla:
[ hatthapāda + pasāraṇa + ādi + kāla ]  CL=7 A time or period of stretching out the hands and feet, etc.
Evaṃ asatiyā hatthapāda-pasāraṇādikāle phussantassa anāpatti. Vi, ṭṭha, 2. 128. Kaṅkhā, ṭī, saca. 229.
hatthapādapiṭṭhi:
[ hatthapāda + piṭṭhi ]  CL=7 The backs of the hands and feet.
Sīse vā hatthapādapiṭṭhiyaṃ vā vaṇaṃ katvā gahetuṃ vaṭṭati. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 330. Vi, saṅgaha. 422.
hatthapādapiṭṭhikaṇṇādiattha:
[ hatthapādapiṭṭhi + kaṇṇa + ādi + attha ]  CL=7 The purpose or benefit of the backs of the hands, feet, ears, etc.
Khīla kehī (therī. 423) ti hatthapādapiṭṭhi kaṇṇādiatthāya ṭhapitadaṇḍehi. Therī, ṭṭha. 264.
hatthapādapiṭṭhiparikamma:
[ hatthapādapiṭṭhi + parikamma ]  CL=7 The purpose or benefit of the backs of the hands, feet, ears, etc.
Athekadivasaṃ bodhi-satto sāyamāsaṃ bhuñjitvā sayane nipanno taṃ māṇavaṃ hatthapādapiṭṭhiparikammāni katvā. Jā, ṭṭha, 1. 473.
hatthapādapiṭṭhisambāhana:
[ hatthapādapiṭṭhi + sambāhana ]  CL=7 Kneading or massaging the hands, feet, and the upper back of the body.
Hatthapādapiṭṭhisambāhanādīni akaṃsu. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 27.
hatthapādappahāra:
[ hatthapāda + pahāra ]  CL=7 Striking the hands and feet.
Ahaṃ jeṭṭha-ko”ti aññamaññaṃ vivādaṃ vaḍḍhetvā akkose ceva paribhāse ca hattha-pādappahārādīni ca pavattetvā. Dī, ṭṭha, 3. 90.
hatthapādapāripūri:
[ hatthapāda + pāripūri ]  CL=7 The completeness of the hands and feet or the full completion of the hands and feet.
Yathā ca kullaṃ bandhantassa hatthapādapāripūri icchitabbā. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 64.
hatthapādasambāhana:
[ hatthapāda + sambāhana]  CL=7 Kneading or massaging the hands and feet.
Hatthapādasambā-hanaṃ āpucchiṃsu. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 1. 201.
hatthapādasaṃsīdana:
[ hatthapāda + saṃsīdana]  CL=7 The sinking of the hands and feet or legs.
Amhākaṃ pana mahākammaṃ karontānampi tiyāmarattiṃ dhammaṃ kathentānampi ekadivaseneva dasa yojanāni gacchantānampi hatthapādasaṃsīdanamattaṃ vā piṭṭhirujjanamattaṃ vā na hoti. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 142.
hatthapādasitahasitakathitaālokitaviloki:
[ hatthapādasita + hasita + kathita + ālokita + vilokita + ādi + bheda ]  CL=7 Having a variety of aspects, such as smiling, a sidelong glance, and looking at the hands and feet.
Laddhavohāraṃ hatthapādasitahasita kathitaālokitavilokitādi bhedaṃ ākāraṃ na gaṇhāti. Mahāni, ṭṭha. 343. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 428.
hatthapādasitaālokitavilokitādippakārabh:
[ hatthapāda + sita + ālokita + vilokita + ādi + pakāra + bhāga ]  CL=7 The various aspects include smiling, a sidelong glance, and looking at the hands and feet.
Anubyañjanasoti hatthapādasita-ālokitavilokitādippakāra-bhāgaso. Aṃ, ṭī, 3. 124.
hatthapādasīsādi:
[ hatthapāda + sīsa + ādi ]  CL=7 The hands, feet or legs, and head, etc.
Taṃ bhikkhuṃ hatthapādasīsādīsu suggahitaṃ nipparipphandaṃ gahetvā. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 227.
hatthapādasīsādirūpa:
[ hatthapādasīsādi + rūpa ]  CL=7 The form or appearance such as the hands, feet or legs, and head, etc.
Bhagavato hatthapādasīsādirūpaṃ disvāti attho. Apa, ṭṭha, 2. 217.
hatthapādatala:
[ hatthapāda + tala ]  CL=7 Laka phavāḥ khrephavāḥapraṅa.
The palm (of the hand) and the sole (of the foot).
Hatthapādatalāni tiyojanasatikāni. Dī, ṭṭha, 2. 78. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 82. (ma, ṭṭha, 3. 304).
hatthapādatalachavi:
[ hatthapādatala + chavi ]  CL=7 The skin of the palm and the skin of the sole.
Lākhārasarattasucchavī (jā, 2. 279) ti hatthapādatalachaviṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ. Jā, ṭṭha, 7. 169.
hatthapādavaḍḍhanādi:
[ hatthapāda + vaḍḍhana + ādi ]  CL=7 The growth or increase of the hands, feet, etc.
Navame bharissatī (aṃ, 2. 37) ti amhehi thaññapāyanahatthapādavaḍḍhanādīhi bhato paṭijaggito amhe mahallaka-kāle hatthapādadhovananhāpanayāgu-bhatdānādīhi bharissati. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 21. Hatthapādavaḍḍhanādīhīti ādisaddena mukhena siṅghānikāpanayananahāpanamaṇḍanādiñca saṅgaṇhāti. Aṃ, ṭī, 3. 18.
hatthapādavikala:
[ hatthapāda + vikala ]  CL=7 One with defective hands and feet or one with imperfect hands and feet.
Mayaṃ hi taṃ bhagavantaṃ andho viya cakkhuṃ badhiro viya sotaṃ mūgo viya kalyāṇavākkaraṇaṃ hatthapādavikalo viya hatthapāde ---- passituṃ upasaṅkamituṃ ca icchāmāti dasseti. Udāna, ṭṭha. 78. (-peta, ṭṭha. 4).
hatthapādavikkhepādi:
[ hatthapāda + vikkhepa + ādi ]  CL=7 The action of shaking or moving the hands, feet, and similar activities.
Tasmiṃ samaye uggaseno nāma seṭṭhiputto sahāyakena saddhiṃ mañcāti mañce ṭhito taṃ oloketvā tassā hatthapādavikkhepādīsu uppannasineho gehaṃ gantvā. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 2. 341.
hatthapādavikāra:
[ hatthapāda + vikāra ]  CL=7 The change or transformation of the hands and feet (or legs).
Amaccā catūsu passesu ṭhatvā ---- hatthapāda-vikāraṃ vā phandanamattaṃ na passiṃsu. Jā, ṭṭha, 6. 8.
hatthapādavālavatthikosa:
[ hatthapāda + vāla + vatthikosa ]  CL=7 The tusk (or trunk), the four legs, the tail, and the covering or membrane (such as the placenta).
Hatthapādavālavatthikosehi bhūmiphusanehi sattahi patiṭṭhitoti sattapatiṭṭhito. Visuddhi, ṭī, 2. 452.
hatthapādaṭhapanadaṇḍaka:
[ hatthapāda + ṭhapana + daṇḍaka ]  CL=7 A small stick placed near the hands and feet.
Upadhānaghaṭikaṃ hatthapādaṭhapana-daṇḍakañca ādāya āgantvā. Jā, ṭṭha, 3. 166.
hatthapādaṭṭhāniya:
[ hatthapāda + ṭhā + anīya ]  CL=7 Based on the hands and feet.
Sakuṇānaṃ pakkhā hatthapādaṭṭhāniyāti āha “Saṅkuṭitahatthapādā”ti. Vimati, 1. 71.
hatthapāduppīḷaka:
[ hatthapāda + upīḷaka ]  CL=7 One who kneads or massages the hands and feet/legs.
Athassa niddāyitvā hatthapāduppīnāsahanena hatthapāduppīḷakānaṃ santajjanaṃ. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 226.
hatthapāduppīḷanakapurisacatukka:
[ hatthapāduppī-ḷanaka + purisa + catukka ]  CL=7 A group of four men who knead or massage the hands, feet/legs.
Puna tassa pānāgāragamanapaṭibāhanatthaṃ hatthapāduppīḷanakapurisacatukkaṃ viya. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 226.
hatthapāduppīḷanāsahana:
[ hatthapāduppīḷana + asahana ]  CL=7 Lack of endurance for kneading or massaging the hands, feet, or legs.
Athassa niddāyitvā vuṭṭhitassa hatthapāduppīḷanāsahanena hatthapāduppīḷa-kānaṃ santajjanaṃ. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 226.
hatthapādādiavayava:
[ hatthapādādi + avayava]  CL=7 The parts of the body such as the hands, feet/legs, etc.
Hatthapādādiavayavāti āha hatthā sobhaṇātiādi. Saṃ, ṭī, 2. 323.
hatthapādādiaṅga:
[ hatthapādādi + aṅga ]  CL=7 The element or the part of the body such as the hands, feet/legs, etc.
Aṅganti hatthapādādiaṅgāni uddissa pavattaṃ vijjaṃ. Visuddhi, ṭī, 1. 55. (-dī, ṭī, 1. 267).
hatthapādādiaṅgasama:
[ hatthapāda + ādi + aṅgasama ]  CL=7 Resembling the element or the part of the body such as the hands, feet/legs, etc.
Rañño aṅganti rañño hattha-pādādiaṅgasamatāya aṅganteva saṅkhaṃ gacchati. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 224.
hatthapādādiaṅgulinakhādiaṅgapaccaṅga:
[ hatthapā-dādi + aṅguli + nakha + ādi + aṅgapaccaṅga]  CL=7 The parts of the body such as the hands, legs, fingers, toes, fingernails, toenails, etc.
Hatthapādādiaṅgulinakhādiaṅgapaccaṅge sanni-vesavisiṭṭhe upādāya aṅgapaccaṅgasamaññā ceva kāyasamaññā ca. Anuṭī, 2. 152.
hatthapādādibhedanahetu:
[ hatthapādādi + bhedana + hetu ]  CL=7 A cause of cutting off the hands, feet/ legs, etc.
Hatthapādādihetū (ma, ṭṭha, 2. 231)ti hatthapādādibhedana-hetu. Ma, ṭī, 2. 149.
hatthapādādiccheda:
[ hatthapādādi + cheda ]  CL=7 Cutting off the hands, legs/feet, etc.
Jīvite pana ālayaṃ vissajjetvā hatthapādādicche-do vā hotu maraṇaṃ vā. Aṃ, ṭī, 2. 2.
hatthapādādicchedana:
[ hatthapādādi + chedana]  CL=7 See - hatthapādādiccheda.
Sakiṃ kuddhā hattha-pādādicchedanena bahumpi anatthaṃ karonti. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 1. 308.
hatthapādādicchinna:
[ hatthapādādi + chinna ]  CL=7 One whose hands and legs are cut off.
Yasmā hatthapādādicchinnānaṃ lohitaṃ bhuñjāmi yeva. Peta, ṭṭha. 74. (-mahāni, ṭṭha.
hatthapādādicheda:
[ hatthapādādi + cheda ]  CL=7 See - hatthapādādiccheda.
Tena garahampi daṇḍampi hatthapādādichedampi pāpuṇanti. Dī, ṭṭha, 3. 128. (saṃ, ṭī, 1. 104).
hatthapādādichedana:
[ hatthapādādi + chedana]  CL=7 See - hatthapādādicchedana.
Idheva hatthapādādichedanaṃ patvā. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 112.
hatthapādādichindanagandhikā:
[ hatthapādādi + chindana + gandhikā. dhammagandhikā-krañña့်. ]  CL=7  A chopping block that is used for cutting the hands, feet/legs, etc.
Dhammagandhikāti hatthapādādichindanagandhikā. Sārattha, 2. 334. Aṭṭhakathāyaṃ kāraṇāya guttabandhanāgāraṃ akaraṇaṭṭhānaṃ vā dhammagandhikā hatthapādacchindanakā gandhikāti likhitaṃ. Vajira. 192.
hatthapādādidhovanattha:
[ hatthapādādi + dhovana + attha ]  CL=7 The benefit of washing the hands, feet/legs, etc.
Tenassa uṇhodakaṃ pivituṃ vā hatthapādādidhova-natthāya. Ma, ṭṭha, 3. 40.
hatthapādādika:
[ hatthapādādi + ka ]  CL=7 The hands, feet/legs, etc.
Chijjantu vā hatthapādādike pisuṇā piṭṭhimaṃsikā. Dī, ṭī, 3. 154.
hatthapādādiparikamma:
[ hatthapādādi + parikamma]  CL=7 Kneading or massaging the hands, feet/legs, etc.
Thero sabbampi hatthapādādiparikammaṃ katvā mahātheraṃ nhāpesi. Ma, ṭṭha, 4. 246.
hatthapādādirūpa:
[ hatthapādādi + rūpa ]  CL=7 The form or appearance of the hands, feet/legs, etc.
Tattha yesaṃ ---- hatthapādādirūpañca disvā pathavīdhātu-ādayo sanidassanāti laddhi seyya-thāpi andhakānaṃ. Abhi, ṭṭha, 3. 195.
hatthapādādisarīrāvayava:
[ hatthapādādi + sarīra + avayava ]  CL=7 The body parts or limbs such as the hands, feet/legs, etc.
Saṇṭhānapāripūriyāti hatthapādādisarīrāvayavānaṃ susaṇṭhitatāya. Ma, ṭī, 3. 358, 372.
hatthapādūpamā:
[ hatthapāda + upamā ]  CL=7 A discourse explaining the simile of the hands and feet or legs.
Hatthapādūpamā dveti. Saṃ, 2. 381.
