(1) “Hatthapāse”ti pāṭhaseso. Hatthapāso nāma samīpoti. Vi, vinicchayaṭī, 1. 134. (2) te ca kho hatthapāsaṃ avijahitvā ekasīmāyaṃ ṭhitāya. Kaṅkhā. 87. Hatthapāso nāma diyaḍḍhahatthappamāṇo. Kaṅkhā, ṭī, saca. 136. (3) hatthapāse ṭhitoti ettha pana ---- aḍḍhateyya-hattho “Hatthapāso”ti veditabbo. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 92. Hatthapāsoti hatthassa pāso samīpo hatthapāso, hattho pasati phusati asmiṃ ṭhāneti vā hatthapāso, aḍḍhateyyahattho pade-so. Pācita, yo. 73. (-kaṅkhā. 220. Kaṅkhā, ṭī, saca. 289. Vi, vinicchaya, ṭī, 1. 464-511). (4) hatthapāse (vi, ṭṭha, 2. 220) ti idaṃ dvādasahatthaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ. Sārattha, 2. 388.
hatthapāsabbhantara:
[ hatthapāsa + abbhantara ]  CL=7 Within the extent of 2.5 cubits or arm"s length.
Abhiharatīti hatthapāsabbhantare ṭhito gahaṇatthaṃ upanāmeti. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 92. Vi, saṅgaha. 127. Kaṅkhā. 221. (kaṅkhā, ṭī, saca. 289).
hatthapāsagata:
[ hatthapāsa + gata ]  CL=7 Reached arm"s length.
Tena sabhāyaṃ gacchantena hatthapāse hatthaṃ pasāretvā handimaṃ cīvaraṃ ṭhapemīti evaṃ nikkhepasukhe hatthapāsagate kismiñci āpaṇe cīvaraṃ nikkhipitvā. Vi, ṭṭha, 2. 234. Vi, saṅgaha. 42. (vi, ṭṭha, 3. 329).
hatthapāsanayana:
[ hatthapāsa + nayana ]  CL=7 Carrying or leading to arm"s length.
Evaṃ sannipati-tesu bhikkhūsu ---- hatthapāsanaya-natthañceva bahisīmakaraṇatthañca ārāmi-ke ceva samaṇuddese ca ṭhapetvā. Vi, saṅgaha. 186.
hatthapāsapamāṇa:
[ hatthapāsa + pamāṇa ]  CL=7 The extent of arm"s length.
Tassa orimantena hatthapāsapamāṇaṃ paricchinditabbaṃ. Vi, saṅgaha. 113. Tassa orimantena hatthapāsapamāṇaṃ paricchinditabbaṃ. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 110. Kaṅkhā. 230.
hatthapāsavijahana:
[ hatthapāsa + vijahana]  CL=7 Abandoning 2.5 arm"s length or cubits.
Uyyojentiyā pana uyyojane ca hatthapāsavijahane ca dukkaṭaṃ. Kaṅkhā. 319. (sārattha, 3. 95. Vimati, 2. 53, 309).
hatthapāsokkamana:
[ hatthapāsa + okkamana ]  CL=7 Entering into arm"s length or 2.5 cubits.
Hatthapāsokkamane thullaccayaṃ. Kaṅkhā. 297.
hatthapāsupagamana:
[ hatthapāsa + upagamana]  CL=7 Approaching arm"s length or reaching arm"s length.
Bhikkhuniyā nisinnaparisāyāti ādīsu hatthapāsupagamanameva pamāṇaṃ. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 348. (vajira. 515. Sārattha, 3. 281. Kaṅkhā, ṭī, saca. 152, 250).
hatthapāsupagata:
[ hatthapāsa + upagata ]  CL=7 Having approached arm"s length or reached arm"s length.
Tatra hi yattakā hatthapāsupagatā na metaṃ khamatīti evaṃ diṭṭhāvikammaṃ akatvā dukkaṭaṃ kammaṃ puna kātabbaṃ kammanti na ukkoṭenti. Ma, ṭṭha, 4. 30. (kaṅkhā. 291. Dī, ṭṭha, 3. 225. Aṃ, ṭī, 3. 201).
hatthapāsāgata:
[ hatthapāsa + āgata]  CL=7 Having approached arm"s length or reached arm"s length (hatthapāsā).
Yadā saṃsappantā aññamaññassa hatthapāsāgatā honti. Saṃ ṭṭha, 2. 267. Hatthapāsāgatā
ti hatthapāsaṃ āgatā upagatā. Saṃ, ṭī, 2. 236.
hatthapāsānayana:
[ hatthapāsa + ānayana]  CL=7 Leading to arm"s length.
Mahāsīmaṃ vā sodhetvāti mahāsīmāgatānaṃ sabbesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ hatthapāsānayanabahikaraṇādivasena sakalaṃ mahāsīmaṃ sodhetvā. Vimati, 2. 148. (vajira. 459).
hatthapāsātikkama:
[hatthapāsa + atikkama]  CL=7 Transcending the arm"s length (2.5 cubits).
Taṃ hatthapāsātikkamaṃ sandhāya vuttanti veditabbaṃ. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 110, 186. Vi, saṅgaha. 114. Hatthapāsā-tikkame (kaṅkhā. 300) ti ettha hatthapā so nāma aḍḍhateyyaratanappamāṇo padeso, tassa atikkamo hattha-pāsātikkamo, tasmiṃ hatthapāsā-tikkame. Kaṅkhā, ṭī, saca. 289, 292.
hatthapāsāvijahana:
[ hatthapāsa + avijahana ]  CL=7 Not abandoning arm"s length (hatthapāsā).
Kammaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭatīti vuttavacane hatthapāsā-vijahanaṃ na paññāyati. Vajira. 386.
hatthapāti:
[ hattha + pāti ]  CL=7 The cup of the hand.
Mahāsamudde caturo, pakkhipi hattha-pātiyaṃ. Apa, 2. 230.
hatthapūra:
[ hattha + pūra ]  CL=7 That which is full of the hand.
Thero kira pabbajita-divasato paṭṭhāya pātova uṭṭhahanto hatthapūraṃ vācikaṃ ukkhipitvā. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 196. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 1. 443.
hatthasadda:
[ hattha + sadda ]  CL=7 The word 'hattha'.
Bhūmisaṇhakaraṇīyādīsu pāṇivohārassa labbhamānattā hatthasaddena pāṇi eva vise-sito. Peta, ṭṭha. 52. (sārattha, 2. 96. Kaṅkhā, ṭī, saca. 180).
hatthasahassa:
[ hattha + sahassa ]  CL=7 One thousand hands.
 “Ahameva po-sessāmi, ahameva posessāmī” ti hatthasahassaṃ pasārayittha. Jā, ṭṭha, 1. 152.
hatthasambāhana:
[ hattha + sambāhana ]  CL=7 Kneading or massaging with the hands.
Mudutaruṇahattha sambāhanañca sukhaṃ uppādeti. Mūlaṭī, 2. 10.
hatthasampatta:
[ hattha + sampatta ]  CL=7 Reached the hand.
Hatthasampattaṃ maṃsameva pana khādiṃsu. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 97-8.
hatthasamphassa:
[ hattha + samphassa ]  CL=7 The contact of the hand.
Bodhisatto hatthasamphasseneva “Nāyaṃ manusso, devaputto aya”nti aññāsi. Apa, ṭṭha, 1. 72. Jā, ṭṭha, 1. 70.
hatthasamīpa:
[ hattha + samīpa ]  CL=7 The vicinity of the hand or the area near the hand.
Hatthapāse hotū (paṭisaṃ. 387) ti hatthasamīpe hotu. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 272. (apa, ṭṭha, 1. 64. Cariyā, ṭṭha. 79).
hatthasata:
[ hattha + sata ]  CL=7 One hundred arm"s length or one hundred cubits.
Mahāsamudde udakaṃ hatthasatampi dvepi hatthasatāni gagane ussakkati. Milinda. 252, 359. Hatthasatampi uddhaṃ gantvā sampattaṃ gahetuṃ vaṭṭati. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 116. Vi, saṅgaha. 119. (saṃ, ṭī, 2. 97. Milinda. 252, 359).
hatthasatika:
[ hatthasata + ika ]  CL=7 Having one hundred arm"s length or having a distance of one hundred cubits.
Mahājanassa o lokentasseva paṇṇāsahatthakkhandho paṇṇāsahatthasākho ubbedhato ca hatthasatiko ambarukkho sampajji. Jā, ṭṭha, 4. 265.
hatthasatubbedha:
[ hatthasata + ubbedha ]  CL=7 (1) Having a height of one hundred arm"s lengths or cubits. (Pu, Na) (2) The height is one hundred arm"s lengths or cubits.
(1) ojāya āropitattā hatthasatubbedhassa rukkhassa aṅkuraggesu bindubindūni viya hutvā sineho tiṭṭhati. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 77. (-vimāna, ṭṭha. 143). (pu, na) (2) hatthasatubbedhamassāti hatthasatubbe-dho. Saṃ, ṭī, 2. 97.
hatthasaññamapakkhara:
[ hattha + saññama + pakkhara ]  CL=7 A body whose hands are restrained, akin to a coach furnished with a place to hold hands. 
Hatthasaññamapakkharo (jā, 2. 274) ti hatthasaṃyamamayena pakkharena samannāgato. Jā, ṭṭha, 7. 147.
hatthasaññā:
[ hattha + saññā ]  CL=7 The perception of the hand.
Alanti hatthasaññāya mukhasaññāya vacībhedena ca paṭikkhipāpetvā. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 167. (dī, ṭṭha, 1. 248. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 130. Sārattha, 3. 197, 287, 359).
hatthasaṃvācika:
[ hattha + saṃvācika ]  CL=7 One who speaks with the hands or one who communicates with hand gestures.
Tattha hatthasaṃvācikā (abhi, ka. 80) ti mūgā viya hatthamuddhāya vattāro. Abhi, ṭṭha, 3. 146.
hatthasaṃyama: [ hattha + saṃyama ]  CL=7 The restraint of the hands or self-control of the hands. See - hatthasaññamapakkhara.
hatthasaṃyamamaya: [ hattha + saṃyama + maya ]  CL=7 Constructed through the restraint of the hands. See - Hatthasaññamapakkhara.
hatthasaṃyata:
[ hattha + saṃyata ]  CL=7 One who restrains the hands.
Hatthasaṃyato (dhamma. 65) ti hatthakīḷāpanādīnaṃ vā hatthena paresaṃ paharaṇādīnaṃ vā abhāvena hatthasaṃyato. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 2. 362. (khuddaka, ṭṭha. 187. Peta, ṭṭha. 109).
hatthasaṅghāṭa:
[ hattha + saṅghāṭa ]  CL=7 The gathering or assembly of the hands.
Dvīhi janehi hatthasaṅghāṭena gahito, sāṭake vā ṭhapetvā vaṃsena vayhati. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 168. Kaṅkhā. 286.
hatthasaṅkhalikā:
[ hattha + saṅkhalikā ]  CL=7 The sequence of the fingers.
Hatthasaṅkhalikā viya khāyanti. Abhi, ṭṭha, 2. 215. Visuddhi, 1. 235. Hatthasaṅkhalikā aṅgulipanti. Mūlaṭī, 2. 151. Visuddhi, ṭī, 1. 300.
hatthasaṅkāmana:
[ hattha + saṅkāmana ]  CL=7 Causing the hand to move.
Manussā manussatiracchānagatitthīnampi hatthasaṅkāmane kiṃ anāmāsadoso na hoti. Vimati, 1. 91.
hatthasaṇṭhāna:
[ hattha + saṇṭhāna ]  CL=7 The form or appearance of the hand.
Idaṃ hatthasaṇṭhānaṃ ---- idaṃ pādasaṇṭhānanti vavatthapetabbaṃ. Visuddhi, 1. 179.
hatthaseda:
[ hattha + muccita + seda. alaya်puda်kye. ]  CL=7 The sweat dripping from the hands.
Suparisuddhopi hi paṭo sūcikammato paṭṭhāya sūcimalena, hatthasedamalajalli kāhi ---- bhinnavaṇṇo hoti. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 205. Abhi, ṭṭha, 2. 314.
hatthasobhā:
[ hattha + sobhā ]  CL=7 The beauty or elegance of the hands.
Deviyā evarūpā hatthasobhā pāsādasobhā. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 251.
hatthasāra:
[ hattha + sāra ]  CL=7 Valuable items or the essence of wealth that can be held or taken with the hands.
Hatthasāraṃ gahetvā dvipadacatuppadehi saddhiṃ araññaṃ pavisitvā ----. Ma, ṭṭha, 4. 71. (-saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 193. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 63. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 166). Hatthasāra (saṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 63) nti attano santake hatthehi gahetabba-sārabhaṇḍaṃ. Saṃ, ṭī, 2. 328.
hatthatala: [ hattha + tala ]  CL=9 palm (of the hand). Te ekasmiṃ hatthatale ṭhite pāṇe ---- saṅkāmessāmi. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 151. Hatthatale ṭhapitaṃ āmalakaṃ viya sabbaṃ ññeyyadhammaṃ passatā. Ma, ṭṭha, 1. 314. Bodhisattaṃ hatthatale katvā. Jā, ṭṭha, 1. 460.
hatthatalaka: [ hattha + talaka ]  CL=9 Palm (of the hand). Evaṃ vutte candā attānaṃ, hanti hattha-talakehi. Jā,2. 253. Jā, ṭṭha, 7. 98.
hatthatalamatta: [ hatthatala + matta ]  CL=9 as much as the palm (of the hand). Thero kira pubbe tunnavāyakāle ekassa paccekabuddhassa ekāya sūciyā saddhiṃ hatthatalamattaṃ coḷakhaṇḍaṃ adāsi. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 340.
hatthatalasadisa: [ hatthatala + sadisa]  CL=9 like the palm (of the hand). Atha khvassa hatthino purato purato gantvā rājapuri-sā sabbagacche chinditvā bhūmiṃ sodhetvā taṃ hatthatalasadisamakaṃsu. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 65.
hatthatalavaṇṇa: [ hatthatala + vaṇṇa ]  CL=9 the color- appearance of the palm (of the hand). Tasmā hattha-tale ṭhapitassa sāsapassa vaṇṇopi hatthatalavaṇṇena saddhiṃ ekato ārammaṇaṃ na hotīti veditabbo. Abhi, ṭṭha, 3. 390.
hatthatalādippadesa: [ hatthatala + ādi + padesa ]  CL=9 the places such as palm (of the hand), etc. Nāpi vasā jānāti ahaṃ hatthatalādippa-dese ajjhottharitvā ṭhitāti. Abhi, ṭṭha, 2. 64. Visuddhi, 1. 357.
hatthatemanamatta: [ hattha + temana + matta ]  CL=9 as much as just wetting the hand. Hatthatemanamattampi udakaṃ nāddasa. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 252.
hatthatta: [ hattha + atta. attha-phraca်saṅa့်. atthaṃ vināsaṃ. jā, ṭṭha, 3. 444. ]  CL=9 the ruin- destruction of hand. Tthattamāyanti mamaṇḍajā pure. Jā, 1. 82. Jā, 2. 22. (-jā, ṭṭha, 4. 47).
hatthattha: [ hattha + attha ]  CL=9 ruin- destruction inside the hand. Amittānaṃva hatthatthaṃ, sivi pappoti māmiva. Jā, 1. 182. Hatthatthaṃ hatthapathaṃ gato. Jā, ṭṭha, 1. 261. Amittānaṃva hatthatthanti amittānaṃ hatthe atthaṃ vināsaṃ viya. Jā, ṭṭha, 3. 444.
hatthatthara:
[ hattha + atthara. hatthino piṭṭhiyaṃ attharaṃ hatthattharaṃ. sī, ṭī, saca်, 1. 364. ]  CL=7 (1) The elephant blanket or rug. (2) A rug or cloth decorated with elephant images.
(1) kuttakaṃ hatthattharaṃ assattharaṃ. Vi, 3. 281. Vi, 4. 313, 320. Hatthattharaassattharā (vi, 2. 281) ti hatthiassapiṭṭhīsu attharaṇakaattharaṇā eva. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 169. Vi, saṅgaha. 452. Dī, ṭṭha, 1. 83. (2) hatthattharā (aṃ, 1. 182) dayo hatthi-piṭṭhādīsu attharaṇakaattharakā ceva hatthirūpādīni dassetvā kataattharakā ca. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 171-2. Hatthattharaassattharā (saṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 87) hatthiassapiṭṭhādīsu attharitabbā hatthiassarūpavicittā ca attharakā. Saṃ, ṭī, 3. 335.
hatthattharaka:
[ hatthī + attharaka ]  CL=7 See - hatthatthara.
Hatthattharakaassattha-rakasīhattharakabyagghattharakacandattharaka-sūriyattharakacittattharakādīhi nānā-vaṇṇehi attharaṇehi santharitabbakayuttaṃ sabbokāsaṃ santharāpesuṃ. Ma, ṭṭha, 3. 13.
hatthattharaṇa:
[ hatthī + attharaṇa ]  CL=7 See - hatthatthara.
Hatthattharaṇā hatthirūpa-vicittā. Ma, ṭī, 3. 10.
hatthatāla: [ hattha + tāla ]  CL=9 Playing (musical instrument) with the hand. Nayīdha naccagītaṃ vā (jā, 1. 135) ti imasmiṃ ṭhāne kassaci naccantassa ---- vādentassa susamāhitaṃ hatthatālaṃ vā natthi. Jā, ṭṭha, 3. 208.
hatthatāḷana: [ hattha + tāḷana ]  CL=9 See hatthatāla. Atthato pana vāma-hatthaṃ ure ṭhapetvā dakkhiṇena puthupāṇi-nā hatthatāḷanena saddakaraṇaṃ. Dī, ṭī, 2. 31. Ma, ṭī, 3. 341.
hatthatāḷasadda: [ hatthatāḷa + sadda ]  CL=9 the sound of clapping hands. So gantvā bodhisattena akkantaṭṭhānepi ---- hatthatāḷasaddena naccati. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 32.
hatthavantu:
[ hattha + vantu ]  CL=7 Having hands.
Hatthavikalassa hatthavāti viya upacāra-vasenāyaṃ imassa samaññā ahosi yadidaṃ “Pupphachaḍḍako”ti. Thera, ṭṭha, 2. 226.
hatthavaḍḍhanādipāṭihāriya:
[ hattha + vaḍḍhana + ādi + pāṭihāriya ]  CL=7 The miracle of the growth of the hands, and so on.
Ettha edise hatthavaḍḍhanādipāṭihāriye yutti yuttarūpā cittato ututo vā upādiṇṇa-karūpānaṃ anuppajjanato. Visuddhi, ṭī, 2. 30.
hatthavaṭṭaka:
[ hattha + vaṭṭaka ]  CL=7 The vehicle driven by the hands such as pushing or pulling with hands.
Anujānāmi bhikkhave purisayuttaṃ hatthavaṭṭakanti. Vi, 3. 280. Purisayuttaṃ hatthavaṭṭakanti ettha purisayuttaṃ itthisārathi vā hotu purisasārathi vā vaṭṭati. Hatthavaṭṭakaṃ pana itthiyo vā vaṭṭentu purisā vā vaṭṭati-yeva. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 369. Hatthavaṭṭakanti hatthena vaṭṭetabbanti hatthavaṭṭakaṃ yānaṃ. Pācita, yo. 339.
hatthavekalla:
[ hattha + vekalla ]  CL=7 Deficiency of the hands or deformity of the hands.
Kuṇanaṃ kuṇo, hatthavekallaṃ. Saṃ, ṭī, 1. 195. Aṃ, ṭī, 2. 79.
hatthavikala:
[ hattha + vikala ]  CL=7 One with a defective hand.
Hatthavikalassa hatthavāti viya upacāravasenāyaṃ imassa samaññā ahosi yadidaṃ “Pupphachaḍḍako”ti. Thera, ṭṭha, 2. 226. Kuṇīti hatthavika lo vuccatīti āha “Ekahatthakuṇī vā ubhayatthakuṇī vā”ti. Ma, ṭī, 3. 354.
hatthavikāra:
[ hattha + vikāra ]  CL=7 The transformation of the hand.
Hatthavikārena dutiyaṃ āmantetvā hatthavilaṅghena upaṭṭhāpeyya. Vi, 3. 220-1. Hatthavikārenāti hatthasaññāya. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 287. Adhippāyaviññāpako aṅguli-saṅkocanādiko hatthavikāro hatthamuddā ---- evamettha attho daṭṭhabbo. Sārattha, 2. 69, 255. Kaṅkhā, ṭī, saca. 180. (vi, 3. 385. Ma, 1.
hatthavikārādibhedabhinna:
[ hatthavikāra + ādi + bheda + bhinna ]  CL=7 The distinctions in the transformations of the hands, and so on.
Hatthavikārādibhedabhinnattā cattāri sampajaññāni samāhaṭāni catusampajaññaṃ. Dī, ṭī, 2. 306.
hatthavilaṅghaka:
[ hattha + vilaṅghaka ]  CL=7 (1) Raising or lifting with the hands. (2) The hands that cause something to separate or come together. (3) Hands touching each other.
(1) (2) hatthavilaṅghakenā (vi, 3. 220) ti hatthukkhepakena. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 356. Hatthehi ukkhipanaṃ hatthavilaṅghanaṃ. Tenāha “Hatthukkhepakenā”ti. Atha vā vilaṅgheti desantaraṃ pāpeti etenāti vilaṅghato, hattho eva vilaṅghato hatthavilaṅghato, tena hatthavilaṅgha-tena, aññamaññaṃ saṃsibbitahatthenāti vuttaṃ hoti. Sārattha, 3. 287. (-ma, ṭṭha, 2. 144. Ma, ṭī, 2. 183). (3) hatthavilaṅghenā (ma, 3. 171) ti hatthena hatthaṃ gahetvā. Ma, ṭṭha, 4. 141. Byatiharaṇavasena laṅghakaṃ vilaṅghakaṃ, aññamaññahatthaggahaṇaṃ. Tenāha “Hatthena hatthaṃ gahetvā”ti. Ma, ṭī, 3. 345.
hatthavilaṅghana:
[ hattha + vilaṅghana ]  CL=7 Lifting with the hands.
Hatthehi ukkhipanaṃ hatthavilaṅghanaṃ, tenāha hatthukkhepake-nāti. Sārattha, 3. 287.
hatthavāra:
[ hattha + vāra ]  CL=7 The occasion or instance of the hands.
Hatthavāre hatthavāre dukkaṭaṃ. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 269. (-vi, 4. 2. 156. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 128. Kaṅkhā. 239).
hatthavāragaṇanā:
[ hatthavāra + gaṇanā ]  CL=7 The counting of the turns or occasions of the hands.
Kantanato pana pubbe kappāsavicinanaṃ ādiṃ katvā sabbapayogesu hatthavāragaṇanāya dukkaṭaṃ. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 213. Kaṅkhā. 332.
hatthaya:
[ hatthaga-phraca်saṅa့်sañña်. ]  CL=7 See - hatthaka, hatthaga.
Hatthayoti vattabbe hatthakoti vuttaṃ. Saṃ, ṭī, 1. 329.
hatthayogī:
[hattha + yogī ]  CL=7 The person practicing hand asceticism (hatthayogī) who follows the ascetic practice of eating alms food with one hand (Piṇḍapata Dhutaṅga).
Majjhimassa ekena hatthena bhinditvā khādituṃ vaṭṭati hattha-yogī nāmesa. Visuddhi, 1. 68.
hatthaṅguli:
[ hattha + aṅguli ]  CL=7 A finger.
Tathāgatassa pana catasso hatthaṅguli-yo pañcapi pādaṅguliyo ekappamāṇā honti. Ma, ṭṭha, 3. 258. Tasmā hatthaṅguli-yo ca pādaṅguliyo ca kuṇitā jātā. Peta, ṭṭha. 117.
hatthaṅgulittaca:
[ hatthaṅguli + taca ]  CL=7 The skin of the finger.
Hatthaṅgulittaco kuñci-kākosakasaṇṭhāno. Abhi, ṭṭha, 2. 224. Visuddhi, 1. 244. Khuddaka, ṭṭha. 35.
hatthaṅguṭṭha:
[ hattha + aṅguṭṭha ]  CL=7 A thumb (finger).
Dakkhi-ṇena hatthaṅguṭṭhena nābhi parāmaṭṭhā. Milinda. 127.
hatthaṭṭhi: [ hattha + aṭṭhi ]  CL=9 bone of hand. Aṭṭhīti ṭhapetvā dvattiṃsa dantaṭṭhīni avasesāni catusaṭṭhi hatthaṭṭhīni. Abhi, ṭṭha, 2. 226. Visuddhi, 1. 245.
hatthaṭṭhika: [ hattha + aṭṭhika ]  CL=9 Bone of hand. Aññena hatthaṭṭhikaṃ aññena pādaṭṭhikaṃ. Dī, 2. 235. Ma, 1. 74, 124. Ma, 3. 134. Aṃ, 2. 285. Hatthaṭṭhikanti catusaṭṭhibhedampi hatthaṭṭhikaṃ pāṭiyekkaṃ pāṭiyekkaṃ vippakiṇṇaṃ. Dī, ṭṭha, 2. 362. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 104.
hatthekadesa: [ hattha + ekadesa ]  CL=9 Part/portion of hand.
hatthialaṅkāra:
[ hatthī + alaṅkāra ]  CL=7 See - hatthālaṅkāra (1).
Alaṅkata (jā, 1. 81) nti nānāvidhehi hatthialaṅkārehi alaṅkataṃ. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 334. Hatthīnaṃ maṅgalakaraṇaṭṭhāne ābhataupakaraṇa bhaṇḍañca hatthālaṅkārañca sabbaṃ soyeva alattha. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 41-3.
hatthialaṅkārasahita:
[ hatthi-alaṅkāra + sahita ]  CL=7 See - hatthālaṅkārasahita.
Sakappano sahatthipo (apa, 2. 183) ti hatthialaṅkāra sahito hatthigopakasahitoti attho. Apa, ṭṭha, 1. 302.
hatthiassadhanadhaññasattaratanādivibhav:
[ hatthiassa + dhana + dhañña + satta + ratana + ādi + vibhava + sampanna  139.]  CL=7 One who is complete with wealth such as elephants, horses, property, paddy, and the seven kinds of gems, etc.
Ayampi purimabuddhesu katādhikāro ---- hatthi-assadhanadhaññasattaratanādivibhavasampanno saddhāsampanno kammaphalaṃ saddhahitvā. Apa, ṭṭha, 2.
hatthiassagomahiṃsagopaka:
[ hatthī + assa + go + mahiṃsa + gopaka ]  CL=7 One who takes care of the elephants, horses, bulls, buffalos, etc.
Sāmaṃ dāsabyaṃ upagato nāma jīvitahetu vā ārakkhahetu vā ahaṃ te dāsoti sayameva dāsa-bhāvaṃ upagato rājūnaṃ hatthiassago-mahiṃsagopakādayo viya. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 282.
hatthiassamanussarathakūṭāgāradhajapuṇṇa:
[ hatthi + assa + manussa + ratha + kūṭāgāra + dhaja + puṇṇa + ghaṭa + ādi + rūpa ]  CL=7 The form or appearance of an elephant, horse, person, chariot, building with a pointed roof, flag, pot full of water, and so on.
Tahiṃ sakkharakhipanasippe nipphattiṃ gato nagaradvāre nigrodharukkhamūle nisīditvā sakkharapahārehi hatthiassamanussa-rathakūṭāgāradhajapuṇṇaghaṭādirūpāni nigrodhapattesu dasseti. Peta, ṭṭha. 265.
hatthiassapiṭṭha:
[ hatthiassa + piṭṭha ]  CL=7 The back of the elephant and horse.
Yāne vā hatthiassapiṭṭhe vā candamaṇḍale vā sūriyamaṇḍale vā nisīditvā pavāritena yāva majjhantikaṃ. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 95. Vi, saṅgaha. 130.
hatthiassapiṭṭhi:
[ hatthiassa + piṭṭhi ]  CL=7 See - hatthiassapiṭṭha.
Hatthatthara assattharā hatthiassapiṭṭhīsu attharaṇakaattharaṇā eva. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 369. Vi, saṅgaha. 452.
hatthiassaratana:
[ hatthiassa + ratana]  CL=7 The treasure of elephants and horses.
Hatthiassa ratanehi vijite yathāsukhaṃ anucarati. Dī, ṭṭha, 1. 222. Ma, ṭṭha, 3. 351.
hatthiassarathaitthiyādiupabhogūpakaraṇa:
[ hatthiassa + ratha + itthi + ādi + upabhoga + upakaraṇa ]  CL=7 Wealth or possessions such as elephants, horses, chariots, women, and so on, used for enjoyment or utility.
Upabhogaparibhogūpa karaṇamahantatāyā (vi, ṭṭha, 1. 173) ti pañcakāmaguṇasaṅkhātānaṃ upabhogānañceva hatthiassarathaitthiyādiupabhogūpa-karaṇānañca mahantatāya. Sārattha, 2. 7.
hatthiassarathapattisaṅkhātacatuaṅgavant:
[ hatthiassarathapatti + saṅkhāta + catuaṅga + vantu ]  CL=7 The army composed of four elements or classifications: elephants, horses, chariots, and infantry.
Caturaṅginiyā (paṭisaṃ. 391) ti hatthiassarathapattisaṅkhāta catuaṅgavatiyā. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 292.
hatthiassarathapāsādakūṭāgārādibheda:
[ hatthiassaratha + pāsāda + kūṭāgāra + ādi + bheda ]  CL=7 Various types such as elephants, horses, chariots, mansions, buildings with pointed roofs, and so on.
Lokacitre sū (ma, ṭṭha, 2. 317) ti hatthiassa rathapāsādakūṭāgārādibhedesu ceva ārāmarāmaṇeyyakādibhedesu ca loke cittavicittesu. Ma, ṭī, 2. 322.
hatthiassausabhappamāṇa:
[ hatthī + assa + usabha + pamāṇa ]  CL=7 The extent of the leading bull, horse, and elephant.
Tassa kira pacchimagehe aṭṭhakarīsamatte ṭhāne hatthiassausabhappamāṇā suvaṇṇameṇḍakā pathaviṃ bhinditvā. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 295. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 2. 232.
hatthiassayāna:
[ hatthi + assa + yāna ]  CL=7 The vehicles of elephants and horses.
Hatthiassayānādīnipi abhiruhitvā vicaranti. Dī, ṭṭha, 3. 147.
hatthiassādibalakāya:
[ hatthiassādi + balakāya ]  CL=7 A group or body of warriors such as elephants, horses, and so on.
Balarāsī (ma, ṭṭha, 4. 171) ti hatthiassādibala-kāyo. Ma, ṭī, 3. 367.
hatthiassādidassanakāla:
[ hatthiassādi + dassana + kāla ]  CL=7 A time or period of displaying elephants, horses, etc.
Bahiddhā hatthiassādidassanakāle bahiddhā rammaṇaṃ. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 450.
hatthiassādiparissaya:
[ hatthi-assādi + parissaya ]  CL=7 See - hatthiassādi upaddava.
Ekasmiṃ pana ṭhāne ṭhatvā hatthiassādiparissayabhāvaṃ olo-ketuṃ vaṭṭati. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 163. Hatthi assādiparissayabhāva (kaṅkhā. 279) nti parissayanaṭṭhena abhibhavanaṭṭhena viheṭha naṭṭhena vā parissayo, hatthiassādi-yeva parissayo hatthiassādi-parissayo, tassābhāvaṃ, hatthiassā-diupaddavā bhāvanti attho. Kaṅkhā, ṭī, saca. 438.
hatthiassādiparivārabala:
[ hatthiassādi + parivāra + bala ]  CL=7 The military force with its attendants, such as elephants, horses, and so on.
Tena ca samayena koliyo nāma rañño bimbisārassa mahāmatto kupitaṃ paccantaṃ vūpasametvā paṭinivattento hatthiassādiparivārabalaṃ thalapathena pesetvā. Peta, ṭṭha. 156.
hatthiassādirūpa:
[ hatthiassādi + rūpa ]  CL=7 The form or appearance of elephants, horses, etc.
Salākahatthenā (vi, 1. 275. Mahāni. 295) ti lākhāya vā mañjaṭṭhiyā vā piṭṭhauda-kena vā ---- paharitvā hatthiassādi rūpāni dassentā kīḷanti. Vi, ṭṭha, 2. 205. Mahāni, ṭṭha. 362.
hatthiassādirūpaka:
[ hatthiassādirūpa + ka ]  CL=7 See - hatthiassādirūpa.
Gopphima puppheheva hatthiassādirūpakāni karonti. Vi, saṅgaha. 21.
hatthiassādivividharūpakaraṇa:
[ hatthi-assādi + vividha + rūpa + karaṇa ]  CL=7 Making various forms or appearances such as elephants, horses, and so on.
Vikubbana dassanasamatthatāyāti hatthiassādi vividharūpakaraṇaṃ. Dī, ṭī, 1.
hatthiassādivāhana:
[ hatthiassādi + vāhana ]  CL=7 The vehicle of elephants, horses, etc.
Mahanto hatthiassādivāhano etassāti mahāvāhano. Sārattha, 3. 349.
hatthibandha:
[ hatthī + bandha ]  CL=7 An elephant keeper.
Atthi tattha hatthibandhā assabandhā yāvasikā kāraṇikā sattakārakāti. Abhi, ka. 432. Hatthibandhā nāma hatthīnaṃ pādarakkhakā. Aṃ, ṭī, 3. 190. (aṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 182).
hatthibandhanādividhi:
[ hatthibandhana + ādi + vidhi ]  CL=7 The method or arrangement of binding an elephant, etc.
Tattha chekācariya (cariyā. 399) nti hatthibandhanādividhimhi kusalaṃ hatthācariyaṃ. Cariyā, ṭṭha. 112.
hatthibhattapacana:
[ hatthī + bhatta + pacana ]  CL=7 One who cooks food for elephants.
Hatthibhatta pacanādīni na kārenti. Abhi, ṭṭha, 2. 421.
hatthibhaṇḍa:
[ hatthī + bhaṇḍa ]  CL=7 The wealth or property of the elephant keeper.
Hatthibhaṇḍe assabhaṇḍe (vi, 3. 119) ti hatthigopa ke ca assagopake ca. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 297. Hatthibhaṇḍeti ettha hatthisaṅkhātaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ etesanti hatthibhaṇḍāti vutte hatthi-gopakāti āha “Hatthigopake”ti. Pācita, yo. 257.
hatthibhaṇḍaka:
[ hatthibhaṇḍa + ka ]  CL=7 See - hatthibhaṇḍa.
Upaṭṭhātabbaṃ ibhaṃ arahantīti ibbhā, hatthibhaṇḍakā. Ma, ṭī, 3. 321.
hatthibhisakka:
[ hatthī + bhisakka ]  CL=7 Someone who treats or cares for elephants in a medical sense. 
Hatthivejjā nāma hatthibhisakkā. Dī, ṭī, 1. 219. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 32.
hatthibondi:
[ hatthī + bondi ]  CL=7 An elephant"s body or the body of an elephant.
Hatthibondiṃ pavekkhāmi, tathā hi bhayatajjitoti. Jā, 1. 34. Ahauhi ito puna, tato ca punāti vuttavārato puna tatopi ca punappunaṃ vāraṇasarīrasaṅkhātaṃ hatthibondiṃ na pavekkhāmi. Jā, ṭṭha, 1. 529.
hatthicchāpa:
[ hatthī + chāpa ]  CL=7 A young elephant.
Hatthikaḷabhehi hatthicchāpehi. Vi, 3. 500. Udāna. 125-6. Aṃ, 3. 40-1. Hatthicchāpehīti khīrupakehi daharapotakehi. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 434. (udāna, ṭṭha. 226). Hatthicchāpā (aṃ, 3. 231) ti taruṇapotakā. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 282.
hatthichakaṇa:
[ hatthī + chakaṇa ]  CL=7 The bodily waste or feces of the elephant.
Hatthichakaṇāni ujjhema. Jā, 2. 246, 252. Jā, ṭṭha, 7. 83.
hatthichakaṇapiṇḍa: [ hatthī + chakaṇa + piṇḍa ]  CL=7 A lump of an elephant"s feces. See - Hatthigopakavesa.
hatthichāpa:
[ hatthī + chāpa ]  CL=7 See - hatthicchāpa.
Tassa obhaggobhaggaṃ sākhābhaṅgaṃ hatthichāpāva khādanti. Suttani, ṭṭha, 1. 91. Apa, ṭṭha, 1. 199. (jā, ṭṭha, 3. 367).
hatthidamaka:
[ hatthī + damaka ]  CL=7 One who trains/tames elephants or the elephant trainer.
rājā khattiyo buddhāvasitto hatthidamakaṃ āmantesi ----. Ma, 3. 172. (-3, 264. Cariyā. 399. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 93).
hatthidamana:
[ hatthī + damana ]  CL=7 Training or taming the elephants.
“Kiṃ mayhaṃ iminā hatthidamanena, attānaṃ damanameva varaṃ” ----. Thera, ṭṭha, 1. 214.
hatthidamma:
[ hatthī + damma ]  CL=7 A tamed elephant or a disciplined elephant.
mahārāja dve hatthidammā vā assadammā vā godammā vā sudantā suvinitā. Ma, 2. 330. “Hatthi-damakena bhikkhave hatthidammo sārito ekaṃyeva disaṃ dhāvati”. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 93.
hatthidammasārathi:
[ hatthidamma + sārathi ]  CL=7 One who trains or tames elephants or elephant trainer.
Rañño nāgo yamenaṃ hatthidammasārathi kāraṇaṃ kāreti ----.
hatthidanta:
[ hatthī + danta ]  CL=7 Ivory.
Danto nāma hatthidanto vuccati. Vi, 2. 217. Hatthidanto vā yaṃ kiñci visāṇaṃ vā atacchitaṃ yathājātameva bhājanīyaṃ. Vi, ṭṭha, 4. 84.
hatthidantappamāṇaphala:
[ hatthidanta + pamāṇa + phala ]  CL=7 A banana plant with fruit the size of an elephant’s tusk.
Tato hatthidantapamāṇaphalaṃ kadalivanaṃ. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 38.
hatthidantasadisa:
[ hatthidanta + sadisa ]  CL=7 That which resembles an ivory or an elephant tusk.
Nāgadante (mahāni.18) ti tatheva hatthidantasadise vaṅkadaṇḍake. Mahāni, ṭṭha. 81.
hatthidantādisabbadantamaya:
[ hatthidanta + ādi + sabbadanta + maya ]  CL=7 Made of all types of tusks, including elephant tusks and others.
Dantamaya (vi, 3. 295) nti hatthidantādisabba-dantamayaṃ. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 373.
hatthidassakaandha:
[ hatthī + dassaka + andha ]  CL=7 A blind person who can guide elephants.
Yathāgahitanimittavasena abhinivesakaraṇapaccuṭṭhānā, hatthidassakaandhā viya. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 154. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 45. (dī, ṭī, 1. 172).
hatthidassana:
[ hatthī + dassana ]  CL=7 The act of seeing the elephant.
Janoti hatthidassanatthaṃ sannipatitamahājano. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 110. (therī, ṭṭha. 55).
hatthidāna:
[ hatthī + dāna ]  CL=7 Offering a white elephant.
Tena tumhākaṃ hatthidānenāti vutte somanassappatto hutvā. Cariyā, ṭṭha. 85-9.
hatthidāyaka:
[ hatthī + dāyaka ]  CL=7 The venerable Hatthidāyaka who offered a white elephant.
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā hatthidāyako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsittha. Apa, 1. 233.
hatthidāyakattheraapadāna:
[ hatthidāyaka + thera + apadāna ]  CL=7 The life story of the venerable Hatthidāyaka.
Khuddakanikāya, therāpadānapāḷi, 22-vagga, 1-apadāna. Apa, 1. 233.
hatthigajjita:
[ hatthī + gajjita ]  CL=7 The roaring of the elephant.
Disāgajānaṃ hatthigajjitaṃ, kesarasīhānaṃ sīhanindādaṃ, yakkhānaṃ hiṃkārasaddaṃ ----. Udāna, ṭṭha. 60.
hatthigamanaṭṭhāna:
[ hatthi + gamana + ṭhāna ]  CL=7 The place where elephants go.
Potthakāruḷhāvachekā sabbāsu disāsu hatthigamanaṭṭhānaṃ oloketvā. Netti, vi. 51.
hatthigantha:
[ hatthī + gantha ]  CL=7 The mantra for guiding the elephant.
Hatthigantha (ma, ṭṭha, 3. 224) nti hatthīnaṃ attano vase vattāpanasatthaṃ. Tenevassa taṃ sikkhā-peti. Kiccañca ijjhati. Ma, ṭī, 3. 153.
hatthiganthasippa:
[ hatthigantha + sippa ]  CL=7 See - Hatthigantha.
Tāpaso ca hatthiganthasippaṃ jānāti. Ma, ṭṭha, 3. 224.
hatthigata:
[ hatthī + gata ]  CL=7 One who is on the elephant.
Hatthigate assagate, sannaddhe passa no mahārāja. Jā, 2. 245. Jā, ṭṭha, 7. 82.
hatthigavassavaḷavapaṭiggahaṇa:
[ hatthī + gava + assa + vaḷava + paṭiggahaṇa ]  CL=7 Accepting elephants, cows, stallions and mares.
Hatthigavassa vaḷavapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato samaṇo gotamo. Dī, 1. 5, 61. Ma, 1. 335. Sārattha, 2. 331.
hatthigavāssachanna:
[ hatthigavāssa + channa]  CL=7 Covered with elephants, bulls, and horses (that is adorned).
Hatthigavāssachanno (jā, 2. 310) ti alaṅkatahatthigavāssehi sañchanno. Jā, ṭṭha, 7. 238-9.
hatthigavāssamanussakukkurādikuṇapadugga:
[ hatthigavāssamanussakukkurādi + kuṇapa + duggandha ]  CL=7 Having the bad smell or odor of the decayed corpse of the elephant, bull, horse, and person.
hatthigavāssamanussakukkurādi-kuṇapaduggandhaṃ saṅkāraṭṭhānaṃ gantvā tattha mahāgandhakuṭiyaṃ viya nisīdi. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 277.
hatthigavāssapurisakuṇapa:
[ hatthigavāssa-purisa + kuṇapa ]  CL=7 The corpse of the elephant, bull, horse, and person.
Lohatāya pana bārā-ṇasiyaṃ hatthigavāssapurisakuṇapehi atitto ---- araññaṃ paviṭṭhosi. Jā, ṭṭha, 3. 293.
hatthigaṇa:
[ hatthī + gaṇa ]  CL=7 A group of elephants.
Yūthāti hatthigaṇato. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 116.
hatthigaṇanā:
[ hatthī + gaṇanā ]  CL=7 Counting elephants.
Hatthigaṇanāya koṭisahassahatthīnaṃ balaṃ dhāreti. Jā, ṭṭha, 1. 73. Apa, ṭṭha, 1. 75.
hatthiggahaṇa:
[ hatthī + gahaṇa ]  CL=7 Taking or seizing the elephant.
The word 'hatthi'. Ettha ca hatthiggahaṇeneva assarathayānāni, vatthaggahaṇena sabbarājālaṅkārā, odanaggahaṇena sabbabhojanavikati gahitāti veditabbaṃ. Thera, ṭṭha, 2. 323.
hatthighaṭā:
[ hatthī + ghaṭā. hatthīnaṃ samūho hatthighaṭā. dhāna်, ṭī. 362. ]  CL=7 See - hatthigaṇa.
Hatthighaṭā (dī, ṭṭha, 1. 136) ti hatthisamūho. Dī, ṭī, 1. 216. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 23. Hatthikāyo (saṃ, 1. 72) ti hatthighaṭā. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 128. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 49. Yūthāti hatthighaṭāya. Sārattha, 3. 361.
hatthigopaka:
[ hatthī + gupa + a + ka-paccañña်း svattha. hatthiṃ gopayati rakkhatīti hatthigopako. gupa rakkhaṇe, sakatthe ko. dhāna်, ṭī. 367. ]  CL=7 An elephant keeper.
Hatthibhaṇḍe assabhaṇḍe (vi, 3. 129) ti hatthigopake ca assagopake ca. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 297. (ma, ṭṭha, 3. 118. Apa, ṭṭha, 1. 137. Jā, ṭṭha, 1. 203, 205).
hatthigopakasahita:
[ hatthigopaka + sahita ]  CL=7 Accompanied by an elephant keeper.
Sakappano sahatthipo (apa, 2. 183) ti hatthialaṅkārasahito hatthigopakasahitoti attho.apa, ṭṭha, 2. 302.
hatthigopakavesa:
[ hatthigopaka + vesa]  CL=7 The appearance of the elephant keeper.
Hatthigopakavesena hatthichakaṇapiṇḍena piṭṭhiyaṃ pahari. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 304.
hatthigumba:
[ hatthī + gumba ]  CL=7 See - hatthigaṇa.
Kadāhaṃ hatthigumbe ca. Jā, 2. 163, 166. Hatthigumbeti hatthighaṭāyo. Jā, ṭṭha, 6. 65.
hatthigāma:
[ hatthī + gāma ]  CL=7 The village named Hatthi.
Āyāmānanda yena hatthigāmo. Dī, 2. 102. (-saṃ, 2. 328. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 304).
hatthigāmaka:
[ hatthigāma + ka ]  CL=7 A rich person from the village of Hatthi.
Atha kho uggo gahapati hatthigāmako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. Saṃ, 2. 328. (aṃ, 1. 27. Aṃ, 3. 50. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 304).
hatthigāmaṇī:
[ hatthī + gāmaṇī ]  CL=7 A noble elephant.
Hatthikkhandhehī (jā, 2. 370) ti te hatthigāmaṇino hitthikkhandhehi khippamāyantu. Jā, ṭṭha, 7. 369.
hatthigīvappamāṇa:
[ hatthi + gīvā + pamāṇa]  CL=7 The extent or size of the elephant"s neck.
Te hatthigīvappamāṇā ekadoṇikanāvāppamāṇā vā honti. Ma, ṭṭha, 4. 168.hatthigīvappamāṇā pariṇāhena. Ma, ṭī, 3. 365.
hatthigīvā:
[ hatthī + gīvā ]  CL=7 The elephant"s neck.
Idha rājā pasenadī kosa lo hatthigīvāya vā nisinno. Dī, 1. 97. (thera. 258, 332. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 272).
hatthihatthappamāṇa:
[ hatthī + hattha + pamāṇa ]  CL=7 The length or extent as long as the trunk of an elephant.
Pupphadāmanti hatthihatthapamāṇaṃ pupphadāmaṃ. Saṃ, ṭī, 2. 167. Aṃ, ṭī, 1. 152.
hatthijeṭṭhaka:
[ hatthī + jeṭṭhaka ]  CL=7 A chief elephant or a leading elephant.
Aparabhāge bodhisatto hatthiyoniyaṃ paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā hatthijeṭṭhako yūthapati ahosi. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 1. 51.
hatthijāti: [ hatthī + jāti ]  CL=9 The sort - type of elephant. Pakatihatthikula (ma, ṭṭha, 1. 331. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 41. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 293) nti giricaranadīcara-vanacarādippabhedā gocariyakāḷāvaka-nāmā sabbāpi balena pākatikā hatthi-jāti. Ma, ṭī, 2. 19. Saṃ, ṭī, 2. 54. Aṃ, ṭī, 3. 313.
hatthijātivisesa:
[ hatthijāti + visesa ]  CL=7 The distinct elephant lineage.
Tathārūpe hatthijātivisese uposathoti samaññāmattanti āha “Uposatho nāma nāgarājātiādīsu paññattī”ti. Ma, ṭī, 3. 262.
hatthika:
[ hattha + ṇika ]  CL=7 One who carries with the hands.
Sīsena vahatīti sīsiko. Evaṃ aṃsiko. Khandhiko. Hatthiko. Aṅguliko. Nīti, sutta. 764.

[ hatthī + kaṇa် ]  CL=7 A group of elephants.
Ukkhādīhi okkhakaṃ, oṭṭhakaṃ, orabbhakaṃ, rājakaṃ, rājaputtakaṃ, hatthikaṃ, dhenukaṃ. Moga, 3. 68. Ukkhādīhi- ukkhānaṃ usabhānaṃ samūho okkhakaṃ, oṭṭhānaṃ samūho oṭṭhakaṃ, urabbhānaṃ samūho orabbhakaṃ, evaṃ rājakaṃ, rājaputtakaṃ, hatthikaṃ, dhenukaṃ. Nirutti. 541.

[ hatthī + ka. hatthī viya hatthiko. kappadduma. hāstika-saṃ. ]  CL=7 An elephant image.
Hatthikā (jā, 2. 353) ti tātena amhākaṃ kīḷanatthāya katā hatthikā. Jā, ṭṭha, 7. 331. Paṭibhāgatthe  hatthī viya hatthiko, assako, balībaddhako. Moga, 4. 40. Paṭibhāgatthe hatthirūpakaṃ hatthikaṃ. Evaṃ assakaṃ, balībaddako iccādi. Nirutti. 548.
hatthikalabha:
[ hatthi + kalabha ]  CL=7 (1) A young elephant. (2) A very big elephant.
(1) hatthikaḷabhehī (vi, 3. 500) ti hatthipotakehi. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 434. (udāna, ṭṭha. 226). (2) hatthikalabhā (aṃ, 3. 230-1) ti mahantā mahantā nāgā. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 282.
hatthikalabhappamāṇa:
[ hatthikala-bha + pamāṇa ]  CL=7 The extent or size of a young elephant.
Hatthikalabhappamāṇo kira tadā bodhisattassa kāyo hoti. Cariyā, ṭṭha. 138.
hatthikantamanta: [ hatthi + kanta + manta ]  CL=7 The mantra that brings happiness to elephants. See - hatthikantavīṇā.
hatthikantavīṇā:
[ hatthikantā + vīṇā ]  CL=7 A harp that brings happiness to elephants.
Tena hi tesaṃ anāgamanaṃ karissāmīti tāpasassa hatthikantavīṇañceva hatthikantamantañca adāsi. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 1. 104, 123. (aṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 339).
hatthikantavīṇāsara:
[ hatthikantavīṇā + sara ]  CL=7 The sound of the harp that brings happiness to elephants.
So madhurakatho mahādhammakathiko saka-lajambudīpe rājāno hatthikantavīṇā sarena paluddhahatthino viya ----. Jā, ṭṭha, 7. 151-9.
hatthikaḷevara:
[ hatthi + kaḷevara ]  CL=7 The dead body of the elephant.
Kuṇapa (jā, 2. 55) nti hatthi kaḷevaraṃ. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 270.
hatthikaṇṇa:
[ hatthi + kaṇṇa ]  CL=7 One whose ear is like an elephant"s ear.
Hatthikaṇṇo vā mahatīti kaṇṇasakkhali kāhi samannāgato. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 310. Vi, saṅgaha. 142.
hatthikaṇṭha:
[ hatthī + kaṇṭha ]  CL=7 The neck of the elephant.
Chattapiṇḍiyaṃ pana maṇi, cūḷāmaṇi, muttāhāre maṇi, aṅkuse maṇi, hatthikaṇṭhe veṭhanamuttā-hāre maṇi, hatthikumbhe maṇīti imāni cha anagghāni. Jā, ṭṭha, 7. 252.
hatthikaṇṭhaveṭhanamuttāhāra:
[ hatthikaṇṭha + veṭhana + muttāhāra ]  CL=7 The pearl necklace worn on the neck of the elephant.
Chattapiṇḍiyaṃ pana maṇi, cūḷā maṇi, muttā-hāre maṇi, aṅkuse maṇi, hatthikaṇṭha-veṭhanamuttāhāre maṇi, hatthikumbhe maṇīti imāni cha anagghāni. Cariyā, ṭṭha. 83.
hatthikhandha:
[ hatthī + khandha ]  CL=7 See - hatthikkhandha.
Sivikā hatthikhandhena, vipine gacchato mama. Apa, 1. 310.
hatthikhandhagata:
[ hatthikhandha + gata ]  CL=7 See - Hatthikkhandhagata.
Hatthikhandhagatāya pana candaparā masanaṃ tumhākaṃ paccāmittarājānayanassa pubbanimittanti vatvā. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 478.
hatthikicca:
[ hatthi + kicca ]  CL=7 The work or task of elephants or the function performed by elephants.
Yathā erāvaṇo devaputto hatthikiccaṃ. Ma, ṭī, 3. 149.
hatthikkhandha:
[ hatthi + khandha ]  CL=7 The back of the elephant.
Hatthikkhandhaṃ samāruyha. Peta. 202, 211. (thera. 257-8. Jā, 2. 73). Uddisitvā pana “Ekaṃ dīghaṃ, rassaṃ, rattakañcukaṃ, nīlakañcukaṃ, hatthikkhandhe nisinnaṃ, majjhe nisinnaṃ vijjha, pahara ghātehī”ti. Vi, ṭṭha, 2. 45. (saṃ, ṭī, 1. 338).
hatthikkhandhagata:
[ hatthikkhandha + gata ]  CL=7 One who has reached the back of the elephant.
Sīghaṃ tato samāruyha, hatthikkhandhagato ahaṃ. Apa, 1. 242. (jā, 2. 73. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 148. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 211. Mūlaṭī, 1. 200).
hatthikkhandhapadesa:
[ hatthikkhandha + padesa ]  CL=7 The place of the back of the elephant.
Rājāsanaṃ nāma hatthikkhandha-padesaṃ sandhāya “Hatthī gīvāya vā nisinno”ti pāḷiyaṃ vuttaṃ. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 272.
hatthikkhandhavaragata:
[ hatthikkhandha + vara + gata ]  CL=7 Reached the noble back of the elephant.
Rājāpi kho sumanena vuttappakāraṃ pūjāsakkāraṃ katvā hatthikkhandhavaragato sayaṃ maṅgalahatthi matthake setacchattaṃ dhārayamāno mahānāgavanaṃ sampāpuṇi. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 63. (aṃ, ṭī, 3. 138).
hatthikkhandhādisaviññāṇaka:
[ hatthikkhandha + ādi + saviññāṇaka ]  CL=7 Living beings such as the back of the elephant, etc.
Antosīmāya hi hatthikkhandhādisaviññāṇakesu nisinnopi bhikkhu sīmaṭṭhova hoti. Vimati, 2. 153.
hatthikoṭisahassa:
[ hatthi + koṭi + sahassa ]  CL=7 One thousand billion elephants.
Tadetaṃ pakatihatthīnaṃ gaṇanāya hatthikoṭisahassānaṃ, purisagaṇanāya dasannaṃ purisakoṭisahassānaṃ balaṃ hoti.
hatthikucchi:
[ hatthi + kucchi ]  CL=7 (1) The place called Hatthikucchi. (2) The stomach or abdomen of the elephant.
(1) hatthikucchiyaṃ kira ekapacchipūraṃ āharāpetvā. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 21. Hatthikucchi-yanti evaṃ nāmake ṭhāne. Pācita, yo. 15. (2) so aññattha agantvā hatthikucchi-yaṃyeva maṃsaṃ khāditvā vasati. Jā, ṭṭha, 1. 529.
hatthikucchipabbhāramahindaguhāsadisa:
[ hatthi-kucchi + pabbhāra + mahinda + guhā + sadisa]  CL=7 That which resembles the cave of the venerable Mahinda on the hillside of Hatthikucchi.
Tasmā gambhīre darīmukhe vanappaṭicchanne hatthikucchi pabbhāramahindaguhāsadise senāsane vasitabbaṃ. Visuddhi, 1. 106.
hatthikula:
[ hatthi + kula ]  CL=7 The elephant family or clan.
Imāni hi dasa hatthikulāni. Ma, ṭṭha, 1. 331. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 41. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 293.
hatthikulānusāra:
[ hatthikula + anusāra ]  CL=7 Following the elephant lineage or following the elephant clan.
Tesu kāyabalaṃ hatthikulānusārena veditabbaṃ. Ma, ṭṭha, 1. 331. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 41. Hatthikulānusārenāti vakkhamāna hatthikulānusārena. Saṃ, ṭī, 2. 54.
hatthikumbha:
[ hatthi + kumbha ]  CL=9 (1) Elephant"s forehead. (2) Slope ground.
(1) rājā dhātucaṅkoṭakaṃ gahetvā hatthi kumbhe ṭhapesi. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 63. (-66. Dī, ṭṭha, 2. 197). (2) hatthinakhaka (vi, 4. 320) nti hatthikumbhe patiṭṭhitaṃ. Vi, ṭṭha, 4. 76. Hatthikumbheti hatthisiropiṇḍe. Pācita, yo. 488. (sārattha, 3. 404).

[ hatthikumbha + ṇa ]  CL=7 See - hatthikumbhaja.
Tathā hi hatthikumbhaṃ, varāhadāṭhaṃ, ---- aṭṭha muttāyoniyo. Sārattha, 2. 319. Ma, ṭī, 1. 70. Anuṭī, 2. 52.
hatthikumbhaja:
[ hatthikumbha + jana + kvi ]  CL=7 The pearl from the head of the elephant.
Muttāti hatthikumbhajādikā aṭṭhavidhā muttā. ---- tattha hatthikumbhajā pītavaṇṇā pabhāvihīnā (pabhāhīnā). Sārattha, 2. 319. Ma, ṭī, 1. 70. Anuṭī, 2. 53.
hatthikumbhappamāṇa:
[ hatthikumbha + pamāṇa]  CL=7 The extent or size is equal to that of the elephant"s head.
Tato mahājano sīghaṃ sīghaṃ mattikaṃ āharitvā hatthikumbhappamāṇaṃ vatthumakāsi. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 65.
hatthikumbhasadisa:
[ hatthikumbha + sadisa ]  CL=7 A stone mat resembling the head of an elephant.
Gayāsīseti gayāgāmassa hi avidūre gayāti ekā pokkharaṇīpi atthi nadīpi gayāsīsanāmako hatthikumbhasadiso piṭṭhipāsāṇopi. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 6. Sārattha, 3. 208. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 413.
hatthikuṇapa:
[ hatthi + kuṇapa ]  CL=7 See - Hatthi-kaḷevara.
Aparabhāge vātāta pena hatthikuṇape sukkhante karīsamaggo pihito. Jā, ṭṭha, 4. 327. (-jā, ṭṭha, 5. 270).
hatthikāya:
[ hatthi + kāya ]  CL=7 A group of elephants.
Saṃvijjante kho bho raṭṭhapāla imasmiṃ rājakule hatthikāyāpi ----. Ma, 2. 257. Ma, ṭī, 3. 145. Pañcame hatthikāyo (saṃ, 1. 72-3) ti hatthighaṭā. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 128. (sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 449. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 51).
hatthilakkhaṇa:
[ hatthī + lakkhaṇa ]  CL=7 The book that explains the characteristics of elephants.
Hatthilakkhaṇaṃ assalakkhaṇaṃ mahiṃsalakkhaṇaṃ ----. Dī, 1. 9, 64. Lakkhaṇanti tesaṃ lakkhaṇappakāsasatthaṃ.
hatthilaṇḍa:
[ hatthī + laṇḍa ]  CL=7 The excrement of elephants.
Hatthilaṇḍaṃ āharitvā tattha tattha chaḍḍesuṃ. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 1. 124. (jā, ṭṭha, 2. 18).
hatthiliṅga:
[ hatthī + liṅga ]  CL=7 A proboscis bird.
Āraṇo hatthiliṅgo ca, hatthi-soṇḍavihaṅgamo. Dhāna. 639. Hatthino liṅgaṃ ñāpakaṃ soṇḍaṃ yasmiṃ vijjatīti hatthiliṅgo.
hatthiliṅgasakuṇa:
[ hatthiliṅga + sakuṇa]  CL=7 A proboscis bird (a bird with a bill like an elephant’s trunk).
Eko hatthiliṅgasakuṇo “Maṃsapesī” ti maññamāno gahetvā. Ma, ṭṭha, 3.
hatthimadacalana:
[ hatthī + mada + calana ]  CL=7 The trembling and agitation of the elephant caused by being in rut.
Hatthimadacalanaṃ nāmañca sambhavoti āha “Sambhavo nikkhamatī” ti. Vimati, 1. 252.
hatthimagga:
[ hatthī + magga ]  CL=7 The path of the elephant or the elephant"s way.
Tassa paṇṇasālāya hatthimaggo hoti. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 93.
hatthimaha:
[ hatthī + maha ]  CL=7 A ceremony done out of respect for the elephant king.
Jambudīpavāsino anusaṃvaccharaṃ sannipatitvā hatthimahaṃ nāma kariṃsu. Cariyā, ṭṭha. 115.
hatthimatta:
[ hatthī + matta]  CL=7 A mountain as large as an elephant.
Na hi sineruuppāṭanakavāto hatthimattaṃ muṇḍapabbataṃ ---- kismiñcideva gaṇeti. Jā, ṭṭha, 1. 321.
hatthimaṃsa:
[ hatthī + maṃsa ]  CL=7 The meat of the elephant.
Manussā dubbhikkhe hatthimaṃsaṃ paribhuñjanti. Vi, 3. 312. (jā, 1. 292. Jā, ṭṭha, 4. 330).
hatthimaṅgala:
[ hatthī + maṅgala ]  CL=7 A blessing ceremony for elephants.
Mayaṃ hatthimaṅgalaṃ karissāma. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 41. (42-3).
hatthimaṅgalachaṇa:
[ hatthimaṅgala + chaṇa ]  CL=7 A blessing ceremony for an elephant.
Sesā brāhmaṇā rājānaṃ upasaṅkamitvā “Mahārāja hatthimaṅgalachaṇo sampatto ---- karissāmā”ti āhaṃsu. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 41. (43).
hatthimaṅgalakaraṇa:
[ hatthimaṅgala + karaṇa]  CL=7 A blessing ceremony for elephants.
Hatthimaṅgalakaraṇaṃ nāma yāva sattamā kulaparivaṭṭā amhākaṃ vaṃso. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 41, 43.
hatthimaṅgalakāraka:
[ hatthimaṅgala + kāraka ]  CL=7 One who performs a blessing ceremony for elephants.
So pana dharamānakāle rañño hatthimaṅgalakārako ahosi. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 41.
hatthimaṇḍa:
[ hatthī + maḍi + a ]  CL=7 See - hatthimeṇḍa.
Hatthiṃ maṇḍayanti rakkhantīti hatthimaṇḍā. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 32.
hatthimeṇḍa:
[ hatthī + meṇḍa ]  CL=7 An elephant keeper.
Ko nāma te mahārāja hatthisālāya hatthimeṇḍo. Jā, ṭṭha, 3. 409. Hatthimeṇḍā nāma hatthīnaṃ pādarakkhakā. Hatthiṃ maṇḍayanti rakkhantīti hatthimaṇḍā, teyeva hatthimeṇḍā, hatthiṃ minenti sammā vidahanena hiṃsantīti vā hatthimeṇḍā. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 32.
hatthimeṇḍavesa:
[ hatthimeṇḍa + vesa ]  CL=7 The form or appearance of an elephant keeper.
Taṃ divasaṃ pana mahāsatto hatthimeṇḍavesena jayampatissa pacchimāsane nisīditvā. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 304.
hatthimocanādiantarāya:
[ hatthī + mocana + ādi + antarāya ]  CL=7 The danger of releasing elephants and other related dangers.
Anantarāyenāti hatthimocanādiantarāyaṃ vinā. Kaṅkhā, ṭī, saca. 460.
hatthimukha:
[ hatthī + mukha + ṇa ]  CL=7 A hole that produces water, resembling the mouth of an elephant.
Tassa catūsu passesu sīhamukhaṃ hatthimukhaṃ assamukhaṃ usabhamukhanti cattāri mukhāni honti. Ma, ṭṭha, 3. 25. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 219.
hatthimāraka:
[ hatthī + māraka ]  CL=7 An elephant killer.
Atīte bārāṇasiyaṃ brahmadatte rajjaṃ kārente bārāṇasivāsī eko hatthimārako hatthiṃ māretvā māretvā. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 1. 50.
hatthimārakapurisa:
[ hatthimāraka + purisa]  CL=7 A man who is an elephant killer.
Tadā hatthimārakapuriso devadatto ahosi. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 182.
hatthinakha:
[ hatthī + nakha ]  CL=7 (1) A mansion resembling the elephant"s head built on sloped ground. See also - hatthinakhaka. (Pu) (2) The toenails and fingernails of an elephant.
(1) hatthimhi nakho assāti hatthinakho, pāsādassa nakho nāma heṭṭhimaparicchedo. Vajira. 528. Sārattha, 3. 404. (pu) (2) hatthinakhā pana khurā na honti. Vi, saṅgaha. 82. Kaṅkhā, ṭī, saca. 359.
hatthinakhaka:
[ hatthī + nakha + ka ]  CL=7 A mansion with a foundation resembling an elephant’s head, built on sloped ground. See also - hatthinakha (2).
Hatthina-khaka (vi,4. 320) nti hatthikumbhe patiṭṭhitaṃ evaṃ katassa ca kiretaṃ nāmaṃ. Vi, ṭṭha, 4. 76. Hatthī viyāti hatthī, bhūmibhāgo, hatthimhi patiṭṭhito pādasaṅkhāto nakho imassāti hatthinakhako, pāsādo. Pācita, yo. 488.
hatthinika:
[ hatthinī + ka +. hatthiniyo eva hatthinikā. sī, ṭī, saca်, 2. 22. ]  CL=7 (Thi) (1) A female elephant. (2) The son of a queen Hatthā. (3) A prince named Hatthinika.
(Thī) (1) pañcamattāni hatthinikāsatānī (dī, 1. 46) ti pañca kareṇusatāni. Dī, ṭṭha, 1. 134. Hatthini-kāsatānīti ettha hatthiniyo eva hatthinikā. Pañca hatthiniyā satānītipi katthaci pāṭho. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 22. (pu) (2) sabbajeṭṭhāya cattāro puttā okkāmukho karakaṇḍu hatthiniko sinisūroti. Dī, ṭṭha, 1. 230. Suttani, ṭṭha, 2. 85.
hatthinimitta:
[ hatthī + nimitta ]  CL=7 A sign or cause of an elephant.
Hatthismimpi sikkhantī (vi, 1. 275) ti hatthinimittaṃ yaṃ sippaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, taṃ sikkhanti. Vi, ṭṭha, 2. 205. (aṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 104). Hatthisminti nimittatthe bhummanti āha “Hatthinimittaṃ sikkhitabba”nti hatthivisayattā hatthisannissitattā ca hatthisippaṃ “Hatthī” ti gahetvā “Hatthismimpi sikkhatī”ti vuttaṃ. Aṃ, ṭī, 3. 105.
hatthinimittasippa:
[ hatthinimitta + sippa ]  CL=7 (1) The skill related to the cause of the elephant. (2) The skill that should be learned due to the cause of an elephant.
(1) (2) hatthisminti nimittatthe bhummaṃ, hatthinimittasippeti attho. Sārattha, 2. 373.
hatthinimmāpana:
[ hatthi + nimmāpana ]  CL=7 Cause to create an elephant image.
 “Iminā upāyena puthujjanabhāvaṃ jānāpessāmī”ti hatthi-nimmāpanādimakāsi. Visuddhi, ṭī, 2. 430.
hatthinimukha:
[ hatthinī + mukha ]  CL=7 A female elephant"s face.
Mahiḷāmukho (jā, 1. 7) ti hatthinimukhena sadisamukho. Jā, ṭṭha, 1. 204.
hatthinipariyāyavacana:
[ hatthini + pariyāya + vacana ]  CL=7 The synonym or alternate term for the word 'hatthini'.
Kareṇūti hatthinipariyāyavacanaṃ. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 22.
hatthinipuravāsī:
[ hatthinipura + vāsī=vasa + ṇī. ]  CL=7 One who is a Hatthini townsfolk or a resident of Hatthini.
Atha hatthinipuravāsī aññataro upāsako vaṇijjāya taṃ nagaraṃ gantvā. Peta, ṭṭha. 185.
hatthināga:
[ hatthī + nāga ]  CL=7 (1) A great elephant. (2) A nāga elephant.
Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 434. (2) hatthi-nāgo (ma, ṭṭha, 2. 318) ti mahāhatthī. Mahantapariyāyo nāgasaddoti keci, ahināgādito vā visesanatthaṃ hatthi-nāgoti vuttaṃ. Ma, ṭī, 2. 322.
hatthināgacariya:
[ hatthināga + cariya]  CL=7 The behavior of a great elephant.
ye hatthināgacariyādayo imasmiṃ vagge niddiṭṭhā ----. Cariyā, ṭṭha. 175.
hatthināgakula:
[ hatthināga + kula ]  CL=7 A great elephant family lineage.
Pabbatantaraṃ kira nissāya mahantaṃ hatthināgakulaṃ vasati. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 18.
hatthināgasadisapadanikkhepa:
[ hatthināga + sadisa + pada + nikkhepa ]  CL=7 Lord Buddha"s stepping style resembles the dignified footsteps of a noble elephant (like the elephant king Chaddanta).
Nāgavikkantacaraṇo (ma, ṭṭha, 3. 17) ti hatthināgasadisapada nikkhepo. Ma, ṭī, 3. 12. Saṃ, ṭī, 2. 337.
hatthināgavohāra:
[ hatthināga + vohāra]  CL=7 The designation or expression referring to a great elephant.
Nāgavohārenā (dī, ṭṭha, 2. 281) ti hatthināgavohārena. Dī, ṭī, 2. 241.
hatthinī:
[ hatthī + inī. nīti, sutta. 469. hatthino itthī hatthinī. kappadduma. hastinī-saṃ. hatthiṇī-prā, addhamāgadhī. ]  CL=7 (1) A female elephant. (2) The city named Hatthinī.
(1) mātā hatthinī mahāmāyā. Jā, ṭṭha, 4. 96. (cariyā, ṭṭha. 115). (2) kururaṭṭhe kira hatthinipure seriṇī nāma ekā rūpūpajīvinī ahosi. Peta, ṭṭha. 185.
hatthinīghaṭā:
[ hatthinī + ghaṭā ]  CL=7 A group of female elephants.
Kareṇusaṅghassāti hatthinighaṭāya. Jā, ṭṭha, 7. 263.
hatthipa:
[ hatthī + pā + a. hatthiṃ pāti rakkhatīti hatthipo. kappadduma. dhāna်, ṭī. 367. hatthipa-saṃ. ]  CL=7 Elephant rider, elephant driver, or elephant keeper.
Hatthipā hatthigopako. Dhāna. 367.
hatthipada:
[ hatthī + pada ]  CL=7 The footstep of an elephant.
So passeyya nāgavane mahantaṃ hatthipadaṃ dīghato ca āyataṃ tiriyañca vitthataṃ. Ma, 1. 233. (saṃ, 1. 87. Ma, 1. 235). Hatthipadopamo (ma, 1. 235) ti hatthipadaṃ upamā assa dhammassāti hatthipadopamo. Ma, ṭṭha, 2. 103.
hatthipadopama: [ hatthipada + upamā ]  CL=7 A simile of a footstep of an elephant. See - Hatthipada.
hatthipadopamasutta:
[ hatthipadopama + sutta ]  CL=7 A discourse that teaches about Sīla, samādhi, paññā by a simile of the footstep of an elephant. (dedicate to two sutta: cūḷahatthipadopamasutta, mahāhatthipadopamasutta, Ma, 1. 232, 242.).
Taṃ heṭṭhā hatthipadopamasuttādīsu vuttameva. Ma, ṭṭha, 4. 209.
hatthiparicāraka:
[ hatthī + paricāraka ]  CL=7 A person who takes care of an elephant.
Sahatthipa (jā, 2. 314) nti hatthiparicārikānaṃ pañcannaṃ kulasatānaṃ hatthimeṇḍahatthigopakānañca vasena sahatthipaṃ. Jā, ṭṭha, 7. 254.
hatthiparissaya:
[ hatthī + parissaya ]  CL=7 The danger or harm of an elephant.
So hatthiparissayo atthīti ārocesi. Ma, ṭṭha, 3. 224.
hatthipiṭṭha: [ hatthī + piṭṭha ]  CL=10 Nīlakaddamakāḷasāmesu yaṃkiñci gahetvā hatthipiṭṭhe nisinnassa paññāya-mānakapakaraṇaṃ kappasantoso nāma. Dī, ṭṭha, 3. 195. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 280.
hatthipiṭṭhi:
[ hatthī + piṭṭhi ]  CL=7 The back of an elephant.
Vehāyasa (vimāna. 58) nti vehāyasabhūte hatthipiṭṭhe. Vimāna, ṭṭha. 166. (vimati, 2. 197).
hatthipiṭṭhidūsanākārappatta:
[ hatthipiṭṭhi + dūsana + ākāra + patta ]  CL=7 Having reached the state of destroying the back of the elephant.
Yañca te idāni vihaññaṃ kilamatho hatthipiṭṭhidūsanākārappatto vighātoti attho. Jā, ṭṭha, 1. 380.
hatthiporika:
[ hatthipura + ṇika ]  CL=7 One who is a Hatthi townsfolk.
Madhurakā kosalakā, kaliṅgā hatthiporikā. Apa, 1. 421.
hatthiposakatāpasa:
[ hatthī + posaka + tāpasa ]  CL=7 A hermit who takes care of or adopts an elephant.
Tadā hatthiposakatāpaso saddhivihāriko ahosi. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 120.
hatthipota:
[ hatthī + pota ]  CL=7 See - hatthipotaka.
Hatthipoto vegena ubho pāde ukkhipitvā taṃ piṭṭhiyaṃ akkami. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 210.
hatthipotaka:
[ hatthipota + ka ]  CL=7 A young elephant.
Hatthikaḷabhehī (vi, 3. 500) ti hatthipotakehi. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 434. (aṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 225. Vimati, 1. 194).
hatthipotakasadisa:
[ hatthipotaka + sadisa ]  CL=7 That which resembles a young elephant.
Thero kira pakatiyāpi mahāsarīro hatthipotakasadiso. Dī, ṭṭha, 2. 170.
hatthippabhinna:
[ hatthī + pabhinna ]  CL=7 An elephant in a rut.
Hatthippabhinnaṃ viya aṅkusaggaho. Dhamma. 60. Thera. 237, 359. Taṃ ajja ahaṃ pabhinnaṃ mattahatthiṃ hatthācari-yasaṅkhāto ---- niggahessāmi. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 2. 320.
hatthippamāṇa:
[ hatthī + pamāṇa ]  CL=7 That which is as large as the size of an elephant.
Itaropi hatthippamāṇato omakataro na vaṭṭati. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 318. Vi, saṅgaha. 181. Hatthippamāṇo nāma pabbato heṭṭhimakoṭiyā aḍḍhaṭṭhamaratanubbedho. Sārattha, 3. 270. Pāsāṇo (ma, ṭṭha, 1. 27) ti antomuṭṭhiyaṃ asaṇṭhahanato paṭṭhāya yāva hatthippamāṇaṃ pāsāṇaṃ. Ma, ṭī, 1. 71.
hatthipura:
[ hatthī + pura ]  CL=7 A city called Hatthi.
Taṃ nagaraṃ hatthipuraṃ nāma bhavissati. Jā, ṭṭha, 3. 437.
hatthipākāra:
[ hatthī + pākāra ]  CL=7 The enclosure or wall that is an elephant.
Tisandhī (jā, 2. 204) ti paṭhamaṃ hatthipākā-rena parikkhittā ---- imehi catūhi saṅkhepehi tisandhīhi parivāritā. Jā, ṭṭha, 6. 244.
hatthipāla:
[ hatthī + pāla ]  CL=10 The Bodhisatta called Pāttipāla; elephant keeper; the Pāttipāla Birth story.
 (4) hatthipālajāta. (pu) (1) hatthipālo nāma satthā ahosi. Aṃ, 2. 326, 500. (2) tassa nāmaggahaṇadivase “Hatthipālo”ti nāmaṃ katvā apabbaja-natthāya hatthigopake paṭicchāpesuṃ. Jā, ṭṭha, 4. 480. Hatthipālo pana ahameva ahosiṃ. Jā, ṭṭha, 4. 495. (3) hatthārutā hatthipālā, āgacchanti mamaṃ gharaṃ. Apa, 1. 421. (4) palobhaṃ pañca paṇḍitaṃ, hatthipālaṃ ayogharaṃ. Jā, ṭṭha, 4. 504.
hatthipālajātaka: [ hatthipāla + jātaka]  CL=9 Birth Story (Jātaka) - pāttipāla. The Bodhisatta Pāttipāla -the story telling the Bodhisatta who led the big renunciation. Hatthipālajātakaṃ terasamaṃ. Jā, 1. 353.
hatthipālajātakavaṇṇanā: [ hatthipāla-jātaka + vaṇṇanā ]  CL=10 The commentary/sub-commmentary  of the Birth Story Pāttipāla.
hatthipālakumāra:
[ hatthipāla + kumāra ]  CL=10 The young prince Pāttipāta-who was the Bodhisatta.
Hatthipālakumāro tāva “Rajjaṃ pahāya mahājanaṃ ādāya pabbajissāmī”-ti gantvā. Jā, ṭṭha, 4. 484.
hatthipālakumārakāla: [ hatthipālakumāra + uppanna + kāla. majjhelopa ]  CL=10 The time of becoming the prince Pāttipāla. Tathāhissa somanassaṃ kumārakāle hatthipāla-kumārakāle ---- pariccattaattabhāvānaṃ parimāṇaṃ natthi. Visuddhi, ṭī, 1. 262.
hatthipālasamāgama: [ hatthipāla + samāgama]  CL=10 The group of the Prince Pāttipāla. The gorup of people who renunciated under the leadership of Pāla prince. Ayogharapaṇḍitasamāgame hatthipālasamāgame ca sabbapacchā nikkhanta-purisā ahesuṃ. Jā, ṭṭha, 4. 494.
hatthipāmokkha:
[ hatthī + pāmokkha ]  CL=7 A chief elephant or a leading elephant.
Atthi pana te mahārāja hatthipāmokkhoti. Milinda. 80.
hatthiratana:
[ hatthī + ratana ]  CL=7 The treasure that is elephants.
Cakkaratanaṃ, hatthiratanaṃ, assaratanaṃ. Dī, 1. 83. Dī, 2. 14. Dī, 3. 48, 63. Ma, 2. 335. Hatthiratanenā (saṃ, 1. 97) ti satasahassagghanako hatthī satasa-hassagghanakena alaṅkārena alaṅkato hatthiratanaṃ nāma. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 150. Sattaratanamaṇḍitaṃ hatthiratanaṃ datvā. Jā, ṭṭha, 1. 50. Hatthīeva ratanabhūto hatthiratananti āha “Satasahassagghana-kenā”ti ādi. Saṃ, ṭī, 1. 196.
hatthiratanasadisa:
[ hatthiratana + sadisa]  CL=7 That which resembles the treasure of elephants.
Idampi dhammavicaya sambojjhaṅgaratanaṃ ---- hatthiratanasadisaṃ hoti. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 192. (suttani, ṭṭha, 1. 274).
hatthiratanādipamukha:
[ hatthiratana + ādi + pamukha ]  CL=7 Headed or led by the treasure of elephants, etc.
Pariṇāyakaratanapubbaṅgamena hatthiratanādipamukhena mahābalakāyena ---- mahabbalo. Cariyā, ṭṭha. 41.
hatthiratanādipariṇāyakaratanapariyosāna:
[ hatthiratana + ādi + pariṇā-yakaratana + pariyosāna ]  CL=7 Starting with the treasure of elephants, etc, and ending with the counselor treasure or one of the seven treasures of a universal ruler.
Saviññāṇakaṃ hatthiratanādipariṇā yakaratanapariyosānaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi evarūpaṃ indriyabaddhaṃ. Khuddaka, ṭṭha. 148.
hatthiratha:
[ hatthī + ratha ]  CL=7 An elephant-drawn chariot or a chariot used in conjunction with an elephant.
Hatthirathānauhi antaraṃ eko sandhi. Jā, ṭṭha, 6. 244.
hatthirava:
[ hatthi + rava ]  CL=7 The sound or roar of the elephant.
So taṃ sutvā “Anekāni hatthisahassāni sannipatantū”ti hatthiravaṃ ravi. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 1. 107.
hatthirāja:
[ hatthī + rāja ]  CL=7 A chief of elephants or a king of all elephants.
Hatthirājā tadā āsiṃ, īsādanto uruḷhavā. Apa, 2. 22. Tassa saha cittuppādeneva so hatthirājā rājahaṃso viya. Ma, ṭṭha, 4. 159.
hatthirājakāla:
[ hatthirāja + uppanna + kāla ]  CL=7 The time or period of being the king of elephants.
Hatthirājakāle maggamūḷhaṃ purisaṃ samassāsetvā. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 1. 95.
hatthirājavaṇṇa:
[ hatthirāja + vaṇṇa ]  CL=7 The appearance or form of the king of all elephants.
Mahantaṃ hatthirājavaṇṇaṃ abhinimminitvā. Dī, ṭṭha, 3. 143. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 13. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 239.
hatthirūpa:
[ hatthī + rūpa ]  CL=7 (1) The appearance or form of an elephant. (2) An elephant" image.
(1) erāvaṇo devaputto kīḷanakāle hatthirūpena. Vimāna, ṭṭha. 13. (2) so sabbadisāsu anekehi hatthirūpehi samalaṅkato ṭhito. Vimati, 2. 244.
hatthirūpaka:
[ hatthirūpa + ka ]  CL=7 The figure of an elephant.
Hatthirūpakaṃ kara, assarūpaṃ karāti vadanti. Jā, ṭṭha, 1. 443. Uddhaṃ olokento rukkhapaṇṇesu hatthirūpakādīni disvā.
hatthirūpavicitta:
[ hatthirūpa + vicitta ]  CL=7 A rug decorated with elephant figures.
Hatthattharakā hatthirūpavicittā. Ma, ṭī, 3. 10.
hatthisadda:
[ hatthī + sadda ]  CL=7 (1) The sound or roar of an elephant, resembling that of a sarus crane. (2) The city named Hatthisadda. (2) The city named Hatthisadda.
(1) hatthisadda (buddhavaṃ. 306) nti hatthīnaṃ koñcanādasaddena.
hatthisaddavantu: [ hatthisadda + vantu ]  CL=7 The city that has the sound of an elephant. See - Hatthisadda (2).
hatthisahassa:
[ hatthī + sahassa ]  CL=7 One thousand elephants.
Caturāsīti hatthisahassāni adāsi sovaṇṇā-laṅkārāni sovaṇṇadhajāni hemajalappa ṭicchannāni. Aṃ, 3. 196.
hatthisambādha:
[ hatthī + sambādha ]  CL=7 A place crowded with elephants.
Hatthīhi sammaddo etthāti hatthisammaddaṃ, hatthisambādhanti attho. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 151.
hatthisammadda:
[ hatthī + sammadda ]  CL=10 (1) A place crowded, confined, and chaotic due to elephants pushing, attacking, and jostling.
(2) The pushing, attacking, crowding, confinement, and agitation of elephants.
hatthisamīpa:
[ hatthī + samīpa ]  CL=7 Near the elephant.
So hatthisamīpaṃ upasaṅkami. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 285.
hatthisamūha:
[ hatthī + samūha ]  CL=7 A group of elephants.
Hatthighaṭā (dī, ṭṭha, 1. 136) ti hatthisamūhā. Dī, ṭī, 1. 215. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 23.
hatthisannissita: [ hatthī + sannissita=saṃ + ni + si + ta ]  CL=7 Completely dependent on an elephant. See - Hatthivisaya.
hatthisarīra:
[ hatthī + sarīra ]  CL=7 The body of an elephant.
Evaṃ cuṇṇavicuṇṇāpi assāsa-passāsā hatthisarīre, ahisarīre ca ----. Vi, ṭṭha, 2. 14. Visuddhi, 1. 263.
hatthisata:
[ hatthī + sata ]  CL=7 One hundred elephants.
Kaṇhājinaṃ nikkiṇanto dāsasataṃ dāsisataṃ hatthisataṃ ----. Milinda. 275. Kiṃ deva pañca hatthisatāni natthi. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 2. 120.
hatthisaññā:
[ hatthī + saññā ]  CL=7 The perception of an elephant.
Attanā diṭṭhāvayavamattaṃ hatthisaññāya itarehi diṭṭhaṃ ananujānantā ----. Udāna, ṭṭha. 312.
hatthisaññī:
[ hatthisaññā + ī ]  CL=7 One who has the perception of an elephant or one who perceives elephants.
Thalaṃ vā pabbataṃ vā disvā hatthisaññino sappādīhi anayabyasanaṃ āpāditā viya.
hatthiseṭṭha:
[ hatthī + seṭṭha ]  CL=7 A noble elephant.
Rajatapabbatato hatthiseṭṭho āgantvā tasmiṃ padese tiṭṭhati. Dī, ṭṭha, 2. 216. (ma, ṭṭha, 4. 159).
hatthisikkhā:
[ hatthī + sikkhā ]  CL=7 The skill of training elephants.
Sikkhāti hatthisikkhā assasikkhā. Mahāni. 330. Idha hatthisikkhāya kusalo hatthiṃ gahetuṃ
hatthisikkhādisikkhanakāla:
[ hatthisikkhā + ādi + sikkhana + kāla ]  CL=7 The time or period of learning the skill of training elephants, etc.
So daharo hutvā hatthisikkhādisikkhanakālepi ----.
hatthisinānasadisa:
[ hatthī + sināna + sadisa. thī-၌ --sadisī. ]  CL=7 That which resembles the act of washing or bathing of an elephant.
Tattha nāma te bāhirepi vatthusmiṃ abhisaṅgappavatti hatthisinānasadisī hoti. Cariyā, ṭṭha. 285. Dī, ṭī, 1. 75. Sī, ṭī, saca,
hatthisippa: [ hatthī + sippa ]  CL=7 The various skills associated with elephants: investigation (or understanding them), training (handling them), riding them, and healing them.
hatthisippādisikkhana:
[ hatthisippa + ādi + sikkhana ]  CL=7 Learning the skills associated with handling elephants, etc.
Hatthisippādisikkhanaṃ na sikkhānutta-riyaṃ. Dī, ṭṭha, 3. 219. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 88.
hatthisippādisikkhanakāla:
[ hatthisippādi-sikkhana + kāla ]  CL=7 The time or period of learning the skills associated with handling elephants, etc.
So daharo hutvā hatthisippādisikkhanakālepi hetusampannatāya ----. Apa, ṭṭha, 2. 290.
hatthisoṇḍa:
[ hatthī + soṇḍā. hastiေ$ာṇḍa-saṃ. hatthisoṃḍa-prā. ]  CL=7 The trunk of an elephant.
Hatthisoṇḍāya udakaṃ gahetvā. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 209. Alaṅkatarajatadāmasadisaṃ hatthisoṇḍaṃ tesaṃ hatthe ṭhapetvā. Cariyā, ṭṭha. 82.
hatthisoṇḍaka:
[ hatthisoṇḍā + ka ]  CL=7 Wearing the cloth resembling the trunk of an elephant (the cloth is hanging down from the base of the navel). (Pu) (2) The proboscis bird.
(1) tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū gihinivatthaṃ nivāsenti.
hatthisoṇḍakasakuṇa:
[ hatthisoṇḍaka + sakuṇa ]  CL=7 A proboscis bird with a trunk-like beak.
 Taṃ “Maṃsapesī”ti sallakkhetvā hatthisoṇḍakasakuṇā ukkhipitvā. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 400.
hatthisoṇḍappamāṇamukhavaṭṭi:
[ hatthi-soṇḍa + pamāṇa + mukhavaṭṭi. thī-၌ --mukhavaṭṭinī. ]  CL=7 A rim or brim is as large as a trunk of an elephant.
Suvaṇṇakaṭāhaṃ nimmini navahatthaparikkhepaṃ pañcahatthubbedhaṃ tihatthavikkhambhaṃ aṭṭhaṅgulabahalaṃ.
hatthisoṇḍasadisa:
[ hatthisoṇḍa + sadisa ]  CL=7 Resembling the trunk of an elephant.
Tassa kira hatthisoṇḍasadisaṃ mukhaṃ. Saṃ, ṭī, 2. 348.
hatthisoṇḍasadisapanāḷi: [ hatthi-soṇḍasadisa + panāḷi ]  CL=7 A beaker or jug with a trunk-like beak.
hatthisoṇḍasakuṇa:
[ hatthisoṇḍa + sakuṇa ]  CL=7 A proboscis bird.
Pakkhinti hatthisoṇḍasakuṇaṃ. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 110. (saṃ, ṭī, 2. 348).
hatthisoṇḍasaṇṭhāna:
[ hatthisoṇḍa + saṇṭhāna ]  CL=7 That which resembles the trunk of an elephant.
Hatthisoṇḍakaṃ nāma nābhimūlato hatthisoṇḍasaṇṭhānaṃ olambakaṃ katvā. Vi, ṭṭha, 4. 54. Kaṅkhā. 276.
hatthisoṇḍavihaṅgama:
[ hatthisoṇḍa + vihaṅgama ]  CL=7 A proboscis bird.
Vāraṇo hatthiliṅgo ca, hatthisoṇḍavihaṅgamo. Dhāna. 639. Hatthisoṇḍaṃ yasmiṃ vijjati, so hatthisoṇḍā ca vihaṅgamo ceti.
hatthisoṇḍālaṅkāra:
[ hatthisoṇḍa + alaṅkāra ]  CL=7 Ornaments adorned on trunks of elephants.
Satamatte hatthisoṇḍālaṅkāre ca suvaṇṇaddhaje hemajalasañchanne katvā ṭhapesuṃ. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 43.
hatthissarathasaṃkula:
[ hatthī + assa + ratha + saṃkula ]  CL=7 Mixed with elephants, horses, and chariots.
Evampi nagaraṃ mayhaṃ, hatthissarathasaṃkulaṃ. Apa, 1. 38.
hatthisutta:
[ hatthī + sutta ]  CL=7 See - hatthisikkhā.
Neva tayo vede jānāti, na hatthisuttaṃ. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 41-2. Hatthisuttādīsū (vi, ṭṭha, 1. 315) ti hatthisikkhādīsu. Sārattha, 2. 153.
hatthisālatoraṇa:
[ hatthī + sālā + toraṇa ]  CL=7 An arched entrance or gateway for the elephant stable.
Hatthisālatoraṇe pana te mahā-rāja ekā kākī vasamānā ----. Jā, ṭṭha, 3. 409.
hatthisālā:
[ hatthī + sālā ]  CL=7 The elephant stable or elephant stall.
Hatthī hatthisālaṃ gantvā sake ṭhāne aṭṭhāsi. Vi, 4. 357. Gacchatha bhaṇe hatthisālaṃ paṭijaggitvā. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 60.
hatthisālānissita:
[ hatthisālā + nissita ]  CL=7 Dependent on the elephants" stable.
Hatthisālānissitaṃ vā hoti. Vi, 1. 226.
hatthisāriputta:
[ hatthisārī + putta ]  CL=7 The son of a trainer of elephants.
Atha kho dvīhatīhassa accayena citto ca hatthisāriputto ---- tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. Dī, 1. 175.
hatthisārī:
[ hatthī + sara + ṇī. thī-၌ hatthisārinī. ]  CL=7 An elephant trainer.
Citto ca hatthisāriputto ---- tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. Dī, 1. 175. Hatthiṃ sāreti dametīti hatthisārī,
hatthisīsa:
[ hatthī + sīsa ]  CL=7 (1) One whose head is like an elephant"s head. (Na) (2) The head of an elephant.
(1) keci hatthisīsā, keci tumbasīsā. Dī, ṭṭha, 2. 43. (2) yāva hatthisīsā
hatthiupamā:
[ hatthi + upamā ]  CL=7 A simile of an elephant.
Ovādamassa demīti ---- paṭhamameva catasso udakā-dhānūpamāyo, tato dve hatthiupamā-yo ekaṃ ādāsūpamañca dassetvā imaṃ suttaṃ kathesi. Ma, ṭṭha, 3. 88-9.
hatthivagga:
[ hatthī + vagga ]  CL=7 The section (vagga) of ten discourses known as the apadāna of the venerable Hatthidāyaka.
Hatthivaggo bāvīsatimo. Apa, 1. 238.
hatthivanacārika:
[ hatthī + vana + cārika]  CL=7 One who wanders in the elephants" forest to catch elephants.
Nāgavaniko (ma, 1. 235)
hatthivara:
[ hatthī + vara ]  CL=7 A noble elephant.
Hatthivarānaṃ dhuragate. Jā, ṭṭha, 7. 90.
hatthivaradhuragata:
[ hatthivara + dhuragata ]  CL=7 One who has reached the shoulder of a noble elephant.
Hatthivaradhuragate (jā, 2. 248) ti hatthivarānaṃ dhuragate, alaṅkatahatthikkhandhavaragateti attho.
hatthivata:
[ hatthī + vata ]  CL=7 The behavior of an elephant.
Hatthivataṃ vā assavataṃ vā govataṃ vā ----. Mahāni. 71, 240. Samādinnaṃ hatthivataṃ etesaṃ atthi. Mahāni, ṭṭha. 188.
hatthivatika:
[ hatthivata + ika ]  CL=7 One who practices the behavior of an elephant.
Te hatthivatikā vā honti. Mahāni. 68. Hatthivatikānaṃ hatthī devatā.
hatthivatādibheda:
[ hatthivata + ādi + bheda ]  CL=7 The variety of the behavior of elephants, etc.
Hatthivatādibhede vate pathaviādibhede mute ca. Suttani, ṭṭha, 2. 242. Mahāni, ṭṭha. 186.
hatthivaṇṇa:
[ hatthī + vaṇṇa ]  CL=7 The figure of an elephant.
Hatthivaṇṇaṃ tathevassaṃ, pabbataṃ jaladhiṃ tathā. Apa, 2. 266. Devesu erāvaṇādayo devaputtā hatthivaṇṇaṃ assavaṇṇaṃ vikubbanti.
hatthivejja:
[ hatthī + vejja ]  CL=7 One who heals the diseases of elephants or an elephant doctor.
Rājā purohitaṃ āha “Ācariya hatthivejjā hatthī tikicchituṃ na sakkonti. Jā, ṭṭha, 1. 511.
hatthivisaya:
[ hatthī + visaya ]  CL=7 The domain of elephants or the realm of elephants.
Hatthivisayattā, hatthisannissitattā vā hatthisippaṃ “Hatthī” ti gahitanti āha “Hatthisminti hatthi-sippe”ti. Ma, ṭī, 3. 145.
hatthivāhana:
[ hatthī + vāhana ]  CL=7 A chariot driven by an elephant or an elephant-driven chariot.
So hatthivāhanaṃ vā assavāhanaṃ vā sutvā dūrampi gacchati. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 1. 124. (jā, ṭṭha, 5. 204).
hatthivāhanakappana:
[ hatthivāhana + kappana]  CL=7 Adorned with equipment for the elephant-driven chariot.
Rājūnaṃ pana hatthivāhanakappanādiṃ mahantaṃ parikammaṃ laddhuṃ vaṭṭati. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 1. 61.
hatthivāhanasampanna:
[ hatthivāhana + sampanna]  CL=7 One who is equipped with the elephant-driven chariot or one who is fully endowed with the elephant-driven chariot.
Hatthivāhanasampanno tena sadiso nāma natthi. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 1. 124.
hatthivīthi:
[ hatthī + vīthi ]  CL=7 The path or way of elephants.
Paṭisīsakaṃ paṭimuñcitvā hatthivīthiyaṃ ṭhatvā. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 181.
hatthivīthipariyanta:
[ hatthivīthi + pariyanta ]  CL=7 The end of the path of elephants.
Paccekabuddhavesaṃ gahetvā hatthivīthipariyante eko puriso tiṭṭhati. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 181.
hatthiyodha:
[ hatthī + yodha ]  CL=7 An elephant warrior or warrior who fights using an elephant.
Idāni hatthiyodhādīsu na kutoci bhāyati. Ma, ṭṭha, 3. 90.
hatthiyogga:
[ hatthī + yogga ]  CL=7 See - hatthiyāna.
Kacchasīsena hi sabbaṃ hatthiyoggaṃ vadati. Vimāna, ṭṭha. 93.
hatthiyoggādisahita:
[ hatthiyogga + ādi + sahita ]  CL=7 Accompanied by elephants and related equipment or other items.
Tattha sayogga (jā, 2. 66) nti hatthiyoggādisahitaṃ. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 307.
hatthiyoggādiācārasikkhāpaka:
[ hatthiyogga + ādi + ācāra + sikkhāpaka ]  CL=7 One who teaches the conduct or handling of elephants and related equipment, etc.
Yoggācariyāna (ma, 3. 259) nti hatthiyoggādiācārasikkhāpakānaṃ.
hatthiyoni:
[ hatthī + yoni ]  CL=7 Elephant lineage or clan.
So tattha hatthayoniyaṃ nibbattopi maṅgalahatthiṭṭhānaṃ patvā lābhī hoti. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 339.
hatthiyotta:
[ hatthī + yotta ]  CL=7 The rope that is used to tie an elephant.
Baladevo taṃ disvā “Na naṃ hatthena chupissāmī”ti hatthisālato mahantaṃ hatthiyottaṃ āharitvā.
hatthiyuddha:
[ hatthī + yuddha ]  CL=7 (1) Fighting a battle riding an elephant. (2) Cause to fight elephants each other. (3) Elephants fighting according to their own will or desire. (4) Fighting a battle riding an elephant together with others.
(1) (2) (3) (4) seyyathidaṃ, naccaṃ gītaṃ ---- hatthiyuddhaṃ assayuddhaṃ mahiṃsayuddhaṃ usabhayuddhaṃ. Dī, 1. 6. Hatthiyuddhādīsu bhikkhuno neva hatthiādīhi saddhiṃ yujjhituṃ, na te yujjhāpetuṃ, na yujjhante daṭṭhuṃ vaṭṭati. Dī, ṭṭha, 1. 82. Hatthiādīhi saddhiṃ yujjhitunti hatthiādīsu abhiruhitvā aññehi saddhiṃ yujjhanaṃ, hatthiādīhi ca saddhiṃ sayameva yujjhanaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ, hatthiādīhi saddhiṃ aññehi yujjhiutaṃ, sayaṃ vā yujjhitunti attho. Sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 360. (-saṃ, 1. 102. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 154).
hatthiyācana:
[ hatthī + yācana ]  CL=7 Asking or begging an elephant.
Rājā aṭṭha brāhmaṇe pakkosāpetvā sakkārasammānaṃ katvā paribbayaṃ datvā hatthiyācanatthaṃ pesesi. Cariyā, ṭṭha. 37.
hatthiyāna:
[ hatthī + yāna ]  CL=7 The elephant used as a vehicle.
Tena hi samma jīvaka hatthiyānāni kappāpehīti. Dī, 1. 46. (dī, ṭṭha, 1. 134. Dī, ṭī, 1. 216).
hatthiyāyī:
[ hatthī + yā + ṇī ]  CL=7 One who travels by elephant.
Vikkiṇamāno tena kammena tena ājīvena hatthiyāyī vā ---- ajjhāva-santo. Aṃ, 2. 266-8.
hatthiyūtha:
[ hatthī + yūtha ]  CL=7 See - hatthighaṭā.
Attano bhariyañca mātarañca ādāya taṃ hatthiyūthaṃ upasaṅkamitvā. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 309. (jā, ṭṭha, 7. 263).
hatthiyūthajeṭṭhaka:
[ hatthiyūtha + jeṭṭhaka]  CL=7 The chief of all elephants.
Tadā bodhisatto kuḷīradahaṃ upanissāya vasamānaṃ hatthiyūthajeṭṭhakaṃ paṭicca kareṇuyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ gaṇhi.
hatthiyūthapati:
[ hatthiyūtha + pati ]  CL=7 The master of all elephants.
Imaṃ tantiṃ paharitvā imasmiṃ mante vutte hatthiyūthapati piṭṭhiṃ upanāmento āgacchati. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 1. 104.
hatthiācariya:
[ hatthi + ācariya ]  CL=7 See - hatthācariya.
So kira sāvatthiyaṃ hatthiācariyassa putto bhagavato santike pabbajitvā. Aṃ, ṭī, 3. 133.
hatthiādidassana:
[ hatthi + ādi + dassana ]  CL=7 Showing or displaying elephants, etc.
Attānaṃ adassetvā bahiddhā hatthiādidassanampi ettheva saṅgahitanti daṭṭhabbaṃ. Sārattha, 2. 168.
hatthiādidassanavacana:
[ hatthiādidassana + vacana ]  CL=7 The speech that illustrates or describes elephants, etc.
Yaṃ pana keci bahiddhā hatthiādidassanavacanaṃ ---- vadanti. Visuddhi, ṭī, 2. 34.
hatthiādigaṇana:
[ hatthi + ādi + gaṇana]  CL=7 Counting elephants, etc.
cattāro puriso sarahatthā pattīti vuttalakkhaṇa to hatthiādigaṇanenāti daṭṭhabbaṃ. Sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 361.
hatthiādiparivajjana:
[ hatthiādi + parivajjana]  CL=7 Avoiding elephants, etc.
Api ca “Caṇḍaṃ hatthiṃ parivajjetī”ti vacanato hatthiādiparivajjanampi bhagavato vacanānuṭṭhānanti katvā ācārasīlameva. Ma, ṭī, 1. 171.
hatthiādippabheda:
[ hatthiādi + pabheda]  CL=7 There are various kinds of things, such as elephants, etc.
Phītañcimaṃ gaha-vibhavaṃ pahāyāti imaṃ hatthiādippabhedaṃ yathāvuttaṃ avuttañca ---- sabbaṃ pahāya tava pitā pabbajito. Therī, ṭṭha. 242.
hatthiādisammadda:
[ hatthiādi + sammadda ]  CL=7 The trampling or crushing of elephants, etc.
Hatthiādisammaddena jīvitantarāyo. Dī, ṭī, 1. 243.
hatthiādisarīra:
[ hatthiādi + sarīra ]  CL=7 The bodies of elephants, etc.
Ettha ca hatthiādisarīre sunakhādisarīre ca assāsapassāsānaṃ desaddhānavisiṭṭhena kāladdhānavaseneva dīgharassatā vuttā. Sārattha, 2. 189. Vimati, 1. 211. Visuddhi, ṭī, 1. 318.
hatthiājānīya:
[ hatthi + ājānīya ]  CL=7 See - hatthājānīya.
Usabho goā jānīyo dakkhiṇapathetiādīni vadantena satthārā hatthiājānīyādīnaṃ uppattiṭṭhā nādīni kathitāni. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 2. 161.
hatthiṅgapauha:
[ hatthī + aṅga + pau္ha ]  CL=7 Questioning about the limbs or parts of the elephant.
Hatthipeuhā dasamo. Milinda. 384.
hatthiṭṭhāna:
[ hatthī + ṭhāna ]  CL=7 A place of an elephant.
Satiyā paṭṭhānaṃ satipaṭṭhānaṃ hatthiṭṭhānaassaṭṭhānādīni viya. Dī, ṭṭha, 2. 344. Ma, ṭṭha, 1. 243.
hatthotāpaka: [ hattha + otāpaka ]  CL=9 Food that burns the hand.
hatthu:
[ hara + tu. satthādigiုṇa်း. hata-saṃ. hatthu-prā. ]  CL=7 One who carries or holds.
Haratīti hatthā. Nirutti. 730.
hatthukkhepaka:
[ hattha + ukkhepaka ]  CL=7 Raising or lifting with hands.
Hatthavilaṅghanā (vi, 3. 220)ti hatthukkhepakena. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 356. Hatthehi ukkhipanaṃ hatthavilaṅghanaṃ.
hatthusabha:
[ hatthī + usabha ]  CL=7 A great elephant or a chief elephant.
Dāsisataṃ dāsasataṃ, gavaṃ hatthusabhaṃ sataṃ. Jā, 2. 368. Jā, ṭṭha, 7. 365.
hatthābharaṇa:
[ hattha + ābharaṇa ]  CL=7 The armlets or the ornament adorned on the arm.
Hatthābharaṇaṃ dhārenti. Vi, 4. 241, 285.
hatthābhijappana:
[ hattha + abhijappana ]  CL=7 Reciting a mantra to turn back the hands of those who hold weapons.
Seyyathidaṃ, āvāhanaṃ vivāhanaṃ ---- hatthābhijappanaṃ. Dī, 1. 11, 65. Hatthābhijappananti hatthānaṃ parivattanatthaṃ mantajappanaṃ. Tasmiṃ kira mante sattapadantare ṭhatvā jappite itaro hatthe parivattetvā khipati. Dī, ṭṭha, 1. 91.
hatthācariya:
[ hatthi + ācariya ]  CL=7 A person who trains elephants or instructs elephant riders; an elephant trainer or master.
Tassa cārugativilāsaṃ asahamāno rājā vadhamicchanto hatthācariyaṃ evamavoca. Milinda. 198. Tattha hatthācariyā nāma ye hatthino hatthārohakānañca sikkhāpakā. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 32. Hatthino cāreti sikkhāpetīti hatthācariyo, hatthīnaṃ sikkhāpako. Ma, ṭī, 3. 1.
hatthācariyakula: [ hatthācariya + kula]  CL=9 Family/clan of elephant-teacher. see Hattācariyasippa.
hatthācariyappamukha: [ hatthācariya + pamukha]  CL=9 has elephant-trainer as leader. Hatthācariyappamukhānaṃ attānaṃ gocarasampāpanaṃ. Cariyā, ṭṭha. 115.
hatthācariyapubbaka: [ hatthācariya + pubba + ka ]  CL=10 Became elephant trainer in the past.
hatthācariyapubbakabhikkhuvatthu: [ hatthācariyapubbakabhikkhu + vatthu ]  CL=9 Story of a monk who was an elephant-trainer in the past.
hatthācariyasippa: [ hatthācariya + sippa ]  CL=10 the skill of training elephant. Bodhisatto hatthācariyakule nibbattitvā vayappatto hatthācariyasippe nipphattiṃ patto. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 85.
hatthādiavayava:
[ hattha + ādi + avayava ]  CL=7 The parts of the body, such as the hands, etc.
Visabhāgavatthuno hi hatthādiavaya vesu subhādito parikappentassa ---- anubyañjanā nāma. Visuddhi, ṭī, 1. 48.
hatthādibheda:
[ hatthādi + bheda ]  CL=7 The variety or distinction of the hands, etc.
Tattha ajjhattaṃ upādinne rūpe (vi, 1. 154) ti attano hatthādibhede rūpe. Vi, ṭṭha, 2. 110. (kaṅkhā, ṭī. 49).
hatthādichedana:
[ hatthādi + chedana ]  CL=7 Cutting off the hands, etc.
Chedananti hatthādichedanaṃ veditabbaṃ. Sārattha, 2. 262.
hatthādijhāpanaṭṭha:
[ hatthādi + jhāpana + attha. nīti, sutta. 107. ]  CL=7 The meaning of burning the hands, etc.
Anudahanaṭṭhenā (mahāni. 5) ti hatthādijhāpanaṭṭhena. Mahāni, ṭṭha. 27.
hatthādika:
[ hatthādi + ka ]  CL=7 The hands and so on.
Idaṃ īdisanti idaṃ hatthādikaṃ īdisaṃ evamākāraṃ. Visuddhi, ṭī, 1. 206.
hatthādikāya:
[ hatthādi + kāya ]  CL=7 The body such as the hand, etc.
Kāyekade so hettha hatthādikāyo avayave samudāyopacāro yathā “Gāmo daḍḍho”ti. Kaṅkhā, ṭī, saca. 212.
hatthādiphandana:
[ hatthādi + phandana ]  CL=7 Trembling or shaking of the hands, etc.
Tasmiṃ pabujjhamāne hatthādiphandanaṃ disvāva. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 169.
hatthādisampadā:
[ hatthādi + sampadā ]  CL=7 The accomplishment or perfection of the hands, etc.
Sampattīti cakkhādiindriyapāripūri ceva hatthādisampadā ca. Saṃ, ṭī, 1. 266.
hatthājañña: [ hatthī + ājañña ]  CL=9 Good breed of elephant. So tividho usabhājañño assājañño hatthājaññoti. Thera, ṭṭha, 1. 84.
hatthājāneyya:
[ hatthī + ājāneyya ]  CL=7 See - hatthājañña.
Evamidha sabbe tasantīti vuttepi hatthājāneyyo assājāneyyo usabhājāneyyo khīṇāsavoti ime cattāro ṭhapetvā avasesā tasantīti veditabbo. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 2. 31.
hatthājānīya:
[ hatthī + ājānīya ]  CL=7 See - hatthājañña.
Bhikkhu ca khīṇāsavo hatthājānīyo ca. Aṃ, 1. 76. (saṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 262. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 51, 292).
hatthājānīyapotaka:
[ hatthājānīya + potaka ]  CL=7 A young thoroughbred elephant.
Tassa pana hatthissa putto sabbaseto hatthājānīyapotako atthi. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 17.
hatthālaṅkāra:
[ hatthī + alaṅkāra ]  CL=7 The ornaments for adorning the elephant.
Disvā evamāhāti aṅgapaccaṅgāni ghaṃsitvā ---- hatthālaṅkārena alaṅkataṃ taṃ taṃ mahānāgaṃ disvā. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 110. (apa, ṭṭha, 1. 325).
[ hattha + alaṅkāra ]  CL=7 The ornaments for adorning the hand. See - hatthālaṅkāravisesa.
hatthālaṅkārasahita:
[ hatthī + alaṅkāra + sahita ]  CL=7 Accompanied by the elephant"s ornaments.
Sakappano (apa, 1. 69) ti hatthālaṅkārasahito. Apa, ṭṭha, 2. 24.
hatthālaṅkāravisesa:
[ hatthālaṅkāra + visesa ]  CL=7 The special ornaments for adorning the hand.
Kambuparihārakanti ca hatthālaṅkāraviseso vuccati. Vimāna, ṭṭha. 151.
hatthāmalaka:
[ hattha + āmalaka ]  CL=7 An āmalaka (gooseberry) fruit placed on the palm.
Ahaṃ bhikkhave sabbaññutaññāṇasaṅkhātena samantacakkhunā sabbadhamme hatthāmalakaṃ viya olo kentopi aññaṃ ekanīvaraṇampi na samanupassāmi. Itivuta, ṭṭha. 53.
hatthāmasana:
[ hattha + āmasana ]  CL=7 Touching with the hand.
Te yāmānaṃ aññamaññaṃ āliṅgitamattena tusitānaṃ hatthā-masanamattena ---- vadanti. Dī, ṭī, 3. 208.
hatthāpalekhana:
[ hattha + apalekhana ]  CL=7 One who, after discharging excrement, wipes with the hand, and after eating food, licks the lips with the tongue.
Acela ko hoti muttācāro, hatthāpa lekhano. Dī, 1. 157. Hatthāpale khanoti hatthe piṇḍamhi ṭhite jivhāya hatthaṃ apalikhati, uccāraṃ vā hatthasmiññeva daṇḍakasaññī hutvā hatthena apalikhati. Dī, ṭṭha, 1. 292. (ma, ṭṭha, 1. 349).
hatthāroha:
[ hatthī + ā + ruha + aṇa်. nirutti. 540-nhā. ]  CL=7 An elephant rider.
Tattha hatthārohā (dī, 1. 48) ti sabbepi hatthācariyahatthivejjahatthimaṇḍā dayo dasseti. Dī, ṭṭha, 1. 142. Hatthiṃ ārohanti, ārohāpayanti cāti hatthārohā. Yehi payogehi puriso hatthino ārohanayoggo hoti, hatthissa taṃ payogaṃ vidhāyataṃ sabbesampetesaṃ gahaṇaṃ. Dī, ṭī, 1. 219. Hatthimārohantīti hatthārohā, hatthācariyahatthivejjahatthimeṇḍā dayo. Yena hi payogena puriso hatthino ārohanayoggo hoti, taṃ hatthissa payogaṃ vidhāyantānaṃ sabbesampetesaṃ gahaṇaṃ. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 32.
hatthārohakula:
[ hatthāroha + kula]  CL=7 The family or lineage of elephant riders or handlers.
So tena puññakammena devamanussesu saṃsaranto imasmiṃ buddhuppāde sāvatthiyaṃ hatthārohakule nibbattitvā. Thera, ṭṭha, 1. 214.
hatthārohaputta:
[ hatthāroha + putta]  CL=7 The son of the elephant rider.
Atha kho pesso ca hatthārohaputto kandarako ca paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. Ma, 2. 1, 4, 5. Hatthārohaputtoti hatthācariyassa putto. Ma, ṭṭha, 3. 1. (sārattha, 2. 2).
hatthārohaputtatthera:
[ hatthāroha-putta + thera ]  CL=7 A thera named Hatthārohaputta. (also known as the venerable Gaṇṭhipupphiya).
Āyasmato hatthārohaputtattherassa gāthā. Thera, ṭṭha, 1. 214.
hatthārohaputtattheragāthā:
[ hatthārohaputtatthera + gāthā ]  CL=7 The verse recited by the venerable Hatthārohaputta.
Hatthāroputtattheragāthā. Thera. 237.
hatthārohaputtattheragāthāvaṇṇanā:
[ hatthārohaputtattheragāthā + vaṇṇanā]  CL=7 The commentary of the verse of the venerable Hatthārohaputta.
Hatthārohaputtattheragāthāvaṇṇanā niṭṭhitā. Thera, ṭṭha, 1. 215.
hatthārohādisippa:
[ hatthāroha + ādi + sippa ]  CL=7 The skill of riding the elephant, etc.
Jīvitavuttiyā āyatanabhāva to hatthārohādisippameva sippāya-tanaṃ. Mūlaṭī, 1. 70.
hatthāruha:
[ hatthī + ā + ruha + a ]  CL=7 An elephant rider.
Hatthāruhampi hanati. Aṃ, 1. 432. Aṃ, 2. 143. (apa, 1. 421).
hatthāruḷha:
[ hattha + āruḷha ]  CL=7 Wealth in hand or wealth that has come into one"s hand.
Yattha pubbe paṇḍitā ---- hatthāruḷhaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ āharāpetvā rañño adaṃsu. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 135. (saṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 297).

[ hatthī + āruḷha ]  CL=7 (1) One who rides the elephant. (2) The skill of riding the elephant. (1) See - hatthāruḷhayodha.
(2) kusalo tvaṃ hatthāruḷhe aṅkusagayhe sippeti. Ma, 2. 297.
hatthāruḷhamaṇi:
[ hatthāruḷha + maṇi ]  CL=7 The ruby in the hand or the gem that has come into the hand.
Anacchariyaṃ bhikkhave yaṃ ānando manussānaṃ hatthāruḷhamaṇiṃ āharāpeyya. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 135.
hatthāruḷhayodha:
[ hatthī + āruḷha + yodha ]  CL=7 A warrior who rides the elephant.
Hatthimārohantīti hatthārohā, hatthāruḷhayodhā. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 32.
hatthāvalambana:
[ hattha + avalambana ]  CL=7 The hanging of the hand.
Olambanattha (ma, ṭṭha, 2. 255) nti tassa hatthāvalambanatthaṃ pubbāciṇṇavasena attano hatthaṃ pasāreti. Ma, ṭī, 2. 278.
hatthāḷavaka:
[ hattha + āḷavaka ]  CL=7 A person named Hatthāḷavaka, the disciple of Lord Buddha Gotama.
Citto ca hatthāḷavako aggā hessantupaṭṭhakā. Buddhavaṃ. 312, 365, 377. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 45.
hatthāṇīkahatthānīka:
[ hatthī + aṇīka. aṇati bheravasaddaṃ karo-tīti aṇīkaṃ, muddhajaṇakāro, hatthī-yeva aṇīkaṃ hatthāṇīkaṃ. pācita်, yo. 100. hatthī + anīka-saṃ. aṇiya-prā. ]  CL=7 (1) An elephant. (2) (A) The elephant army composed of three elephants, each accompanied by 12 soldiers. (B) An elephant army composed of 10 elephants. [ haṃsa + ṇe + yu. kārita-lopa. ]  CL=7 That which causes goose pimples. See - haṃsanasamattha.
haṃsanasamattha:
[ haṃsana + samattha ]  CL=7 Capable of causing goose pimples.
Lomānaṃ haṃsanasamatthatāya lomahaṃsanaṃ. Cariyā, ṭṭha. 88.
haṃsanti: [ haṃsa + anti ]  CL=7 They cause goose pimples. See - haṃsati.
haṃsapaharanaka:
[ haṃsa + paharana + ka. paharaṇaka?. ]  CL=7 One who kills a goose or swan.
Idaṃ satthā jetavane viharanto ekaṃ haṃsapaharanakaṃ bhikkhuṃ ārabbha kathesi. Jā, ṭṭha, 1. 442.
haṃsapantisata:
[ haṃsa + panti + sata ]  CL=7 One hundred rows of swan images.
Caturo ca haṃsā (saṃ, 1. 150) ti cattāri haṃsapantisatāni. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 196.
haṃsaparikkhepasaṇṭhāna: [ haṃsa + parikkhepa + saṇṭhāna ]  CL=7 That which is a round shape like the Mount Haṃsa. See - haṃsavaṭṭakacchadana.
haṃsaparisā:
[ haṃsa + parisā ]  CL=7 The assembly of the swan or the swan"s followers.
Haṃsaparisā sākiyagaṇo. Jā, ṭṭha, 4. 431.
haṃsapotaka:
[ haṃsa + pota + ka. thī-၌ --potikā. ]  CL=7 A baby swan or goose.
