haṃsapuppha:
[ haṃsa + puppha ]  CL=7 The feather from the wings of a swan or goose.
Haṃsapuppha (vi, ṭṭha, 2. 59) nti haṃsānaṃ pakkhapattaṃ. Vajira. 167.
haṃsapātana:
[ haṃsa + pātana ]  CL=7 A pond of the wandering place of geese or swans is called Haṃsapātana and Mandākinī.
Sīhapapātano (sīhapātano) haṃsapātano ----
haṃsaratha:
[ haṃsa + ratha ]  CL=7 Haṃso ratho vāhanaṃ yassāti haṃsaratho. Kappadduma. Haṃsaratha-saṃ.
A Brahma with four faces.
(thoma). Haṃsaratho, viriñco,papitā-maho
haṃsarava: [ haṃsa + rava ]  CL=7 The sound of swans. See - haṃsadundubhinissana.
haṃsaruta:
[ haṃsa + ruta ]  CL=7 See - haṃsarava.
Haṃsarutehi nigghosaṃ, viññāpentaṃ mahājanaṃ. Apa, 2. 108.
haṃsarāja:
[ haṃsa + rāja ]  CL=7 A king of swans.
Haṃsarājaṃ gahetvāna. Vi, 2. 340. (-vi, ṭṭha, 1. 44).
haṃsarūpa: [ haṃsa + rūpa ]  CL=7 The form or image of a swan. See - haṃsarūpasata.
haṃsarūpasata:
[ haṃsarūpa + sata ]  CL=7 One hundred images of swans.
Caturo ca haṃsā (saṃ, 1. 150) ti cattāri haṃsarūpasatāni. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 196.
haṃsasadisagāmī: [ haṃsa + sadisa + gāmī ]  CL=7 Having the same nature as a swan and going or going like a swan. See - haṃsasamabhāga.
haṃsasadisassara: [ haṃsasadisa + sara ]  CL=7 One"s sound is like the sound of a swan king or the king of swans. See - haṃsassara.
haṃsasahassa:
[ haṃsa + sahassa ]  CL=7 One thousand swans or geese.
Ete channavuti haṃsasahassā ñātivihaṅgamā maṃ chaḍḍetvā gacchanti. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 360.
haṃsasakuṇa:
[ haṃsa + sakuṇa. thī-၌ haṃsasakuṇī. ]  CL=7 A swan or goose.
Ahaṃ haṃsasakuṇī viya tato tato nikkhamitvā asajjamānā gamissāmi. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 2. 137.
haṃsasamabhāga:
[ haṃsa + sama + bhāga ]  CL=7 A part that resembles a swan.
Haṃsasamabhāgo (apa, 2. 119) ti haṃsasadisagāmī. Apa, ṭṭha, 2. 227.
haṃsasavhaya:
[ haṃsa + saha + avhaya. nīti, sutta. 746. ]  CL=7 The Haṃsavatī city is called Haṃsa.
Upāgami tadā buddho, nagaraṃ haṃsasavhayaṃ. Apa, 1. 41.
haṃsasenāpati: [ haṃsa + senāpati ]  CL=7 A swan general leading an army of swans. See - haṃsaghaṭa.
haṃsassara:
[ haṃsa + sara ]  CL=7 The sound of the king of swans.
Haṃsassarañño (vimāna. 53) ti haṃsassaro añño, haṃsasadi-sassaro aparo. Vimāna, ṭṭha. 152.
haṃsataruṇa:
[ haṃsa + taruṇa ]  CL=7 A young goose or swan. 
pyiurvayapyiunu sohaṅsāṅhaka, haṅsāṅhakaṅaya. Dviguṇakoṭṭhāsalābhī haṃsataruṇo jāle paharitvā cattāri bhindi. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 509.
haṃsati:
[ haṃsa + a + ti. dhātvattha. 432. ha%jhati-saṃ. haṃsui, hassai-prā, addhamāgadhī. ]  CL=7 (1) One who is glad. (2) Having goose pimples.
(1) pasīdati pahaṃsayati tusayati. Milinda. 311. (2) yo koci avītarāgo taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ pavisati, yebhuyyena lomāni haṃsantī (vi, 1. 9) ti bahutarāni lomāni haṃsanti uddhaṃ mukhāni, sūcisadisāni kaṇṭaka-sadisāni ca hutvā tiṭṭhanti, appāni na haṃsanti. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 157. (-ma, ṭṭha, 1. 353). Lomāni haṃsaye (jā, 2. 13) ti ahaṃ lomāni uṭṭhapemi ---- lomāni pahaṃsantīti vadati. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 164.
haṃsavaha:
[ haṃsa + vaha ]  CL=7 A horse named Haṃsavaha.
Haṃsavahaṃ nāma vara turaṅgamāruyha mahābhinikkhamanaṃ nikkhamitvā. Buddhavaṃ, ṭṭha. 240.
haṃsavantu:
[ haṃsa + vantu. thī-၌ haṃsavatī]  CL=7 The mansion named Haṃsava.
Haṃsavā yasavā sirinandoti tassa tayo pāsādā ahesuṃ. Buddhavaṃ, ṭṭha. 307.
haṃsavara:
[ haṃsa + vara ]  CL=7 A noble swan or goose.
Sumukho pana haṃsavaro ca mahā. Jā, 2. 148. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 553.
haṃsavattakādipokkharaṇīgata:
[ haṃsavattakādi + pokkharaṇī + gata ]  CL=7 See - haṃsavaṭṭakādipokkharaṇīgata.
Haṃsavattakādipokkharaṇīgatassa ca udakassa paricchedo natti. Dī, ṭṭha, 2. 30.
haṃsavatīnagara:
[ haṃsavatī + nagara ]  CL=7 See - haṃsavatī (A).
Haṃsavatīnagaraṃ sampāpuṇi. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 106. Haṃsavatī-nagare padumuttarakālepi sattāhaṃ mahādānaṃ datvā. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 1. 63.
haṃsavatīnagaravāsika:
[ haṃsavatīnagara + vāsī + ka ]  CL=7 The townfolk of Haṃsavatī.
Haṃsavatīnagara vāsike gandhamālādihatthe yena buddho yena.
haṃsavatīnāmaka:
[ haṃsavatī + nāma + ka ]  CL=7 Named Haṃsavatī or the one called Haṃsavatī.
Haṃsavatī nāmake nagare aññatarassa brāhmaṇa-mahāsālassa eko putto uppajji. Thera, ṭṭha, 1. 19.
haṃsavaṭṭaka: [ haṃsa + vaṭṭaka ]  CL=7 The form of a circle of swan wings. See - haṃsavaṭṭakacchadana, vaṃsavaṭṭakacchanna.
[ haṃsavaṭṭaka + ṇa ]  CL=7 The decorative design resembles the form of a circle of swan wings.  See - haṃsavaṭṭakacchadana, haṃsavaṭṭakacchanna.
haṃsavaṭṭakacchadana: [ haṃsavaṭṭaka + chadana ]  CL=7 A layered covering in the form of a decorative circle of swans wings.
haṃsavaṭṭakacchanna:
[ haṃsavaṭṭaka + channa ]  CL=7 See - haṃsavaṭṭakacchadana.
Kūṭāgāraṃ anto katvā haṃsavaṭṭakacchannena katā sabbā-kārasampannā buddhassa bhagavato gandhakuṭi. Ma, ṭṭha, 2. 169. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 3.
haṃsavaṭṭakapaṭicchanna: [ haṃsavaṭṭaka + paṭicchanna ]  CL=7 Covering or forming a roof in the shape of a decorative circle of swan wings. See - haṃsavaṭṭakacchadana, haṃsavaṭṭakacchanna.
haṃsavaṭṭakādipokkharaṇigata:
[ haṃsa-vaṭṭaka + ādi + pokkharaṇī + gata ]  CL=7 Located in a square-shaped pond, featuring designs such as a decorative circle of geese and others.
Haṃsavaṭṭakādipokkharaṇi-gatassa ca udakassa paricchedo natthi. Ma, ṭṭha, 4. 131.
haṃsavaṭṭakādisenāsana:
[ haṃsavaṭṭakādi + senāsana ]  CL=7 A dwelling place featuring designs such as a decorative circle of geese and others.
Haṃsavaṭṭakādi-senāsanāni ceva maṇḍalamāḷabhojana-sālādīni ca patiṭṭhapetvā kato vihāro.
haṃsayoni:
[ haṃsa + yoni ]  CL=7 A swan species.
Atha kho bhikkhave so brāhmaṇo kālaṅkatvā aññataraṃ haṃsayoniṃ upapajji. Vi, 2. 339.
haṃsayuttaratha:
[ haṃsa + yutta + ratha ]  CL=7 A chariot associated with images of swans.
Ahaṃ pana haṃsayuttarathe nisīditvā gacchāmi. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 35.
haṃsayūtha:
[ haṃsa + yūtha ]  CL=7 See - haṃsagaṇa.
Athekadivasaṃ tato haṃsa-yūthā katipayā suvaṇṇahaṃsā mānusiyaṃ saraṃ gantvā. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 359.
haṃsenti: [ haṃsa + ṇe + anti ]  CL=7 They cause goosebumps or goose pimples. See - haṃseti.
haṃseti:
[ haṃsa + ṇe + ti. haṃsati-mha. ]  CL=7 That which causes goosebumps or goose pimples.
Diṭṭhamattā vā sutamattā vā lomāni haṃsentīti lomahaṃsanarūpā. Mahāni, ṭṭha. 375.
haṃsādhipati:
[ haṃsa + adhipati ]  CL=7 The king of swans or the leader of swans.
Dhataraṭṭhā mahārāja, haṃsādhipatino ime. Jā, 2. 86. Mahārāja ime dhataraṭṭhakule jātā dve
haṃsādika:
[ haṃsa + ādi + ka ]  CL=7 Swans and others (like them).
Haṃsādike abhibhavanto viya nadanti. Thera, ṭṭha, 1. 97.
haṃsāpana:
[ haṃsa + ṇāpe + yu ]  CL=7 Causing goosebumps or goose pimples due to gladness.
Lomahaṃsana (peta. 202) nti bhiṃsanakabhāvena lomānaṃ haṃsāpanaṃ. Peta, ṭṭha. 234.
haṃsārāma:
[ haṃsa + ārāma ]  CL=7 A monastery named Haṃsārāma.
Haṃsārāmamupeccāhaṃ, vanditvā taṃ tathāgataṃ. Apa, 2. 157.
haṃsāvatī:
[ haṃsa + vantu + ī. haṃsavatī-phraca်saṅa့်sañña်. ]  CL=7 See - haṃsavatī.
Haṃsāvatī nāma nagaraṃ ahosi jātanagaraṃ. Dī, ṭī, 2. 83.
haṃsāvaṭṭaākāra: [ haṃsa + āvaṭṭa + ākāra ]  CL=7 The form resembles the turning motion of a swan"s wing. See - haṃsavatī.
haṃsī:
[ haṃsa + ī. haṃsī-saṃ. ]  CL=7 A female swan or goose.
Haṃsī kākī kukkuṭī. Rū. 87-nhā. Haṃsātiādīhipi haṃsīādayopi gahitā. Nīti, sutta. 823.
haṃsūpakūjita:
[ haṃsa + upakūjita ]  CL=7 The crying sound of swans.
Rammāni vanacetyāni, rammā haṃsūpakūjitā. Jā, 2. 222. Jā, ṭṭha, 7. 18.
haṅkanakavāsī:
[ haṅkanaka + vāsī]  CL=7 One who resides in the Haṅkanaka region ( in Sri Lanka).
Haṅkanakavāsī mahādattatthero viya. Abhi, ṭṭha, 2. 470.
haṅkanavihāra:
[ haṅkana + vihāra ]  CL=7 A monastery named Haṅkana in Sri Lanka.
So antarāmagge haṅkanavihāraṃ pāvisi. Ma, ṭṭha, 1. 188.
haṅkhanti: [ hana + a + ssanti. haṅkhati-krañña့်. ]  CL=7 See - haṅkhati.
haṇuhaṇukā: [ hana + ṇu= haṇu + ka. bhojanaṃ hanati hiṃsati etenāti haṇu, hanu vā. kaccañña်း. 671. hanatīti haṇu. rū. 681. thī-၌ haṇukā. hanu-saṃ. haṇu, haṇuyā-prā, addhamāgadhī. ]  CL=7 See - haṇukaṭṭhika.
haṇukaṭṭhika:
[ haṇuka + aṭṭhika ]  CL=7 The lower jaw bone.
Dantā dvīsu haṇukaṭṭhikesu ṭhitā yebhuyyena dvattiṃsa. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 76.
haṭa: [ haṭa + a. haṭa-saṃ. ]  CL=7 (1) The resin from the tree such as the yellow silk cotton tree (Cochlospermum religiosum), and so on. (2) The water plant. (1) (2) See - Haṭabhakkha.

[ hara + ta ]  CL=7 (1) That which is taken away. (2) That which is stolen. (3) That which is spread in disorder.
(1) sappissa kayena sappi haṭaṃ. Vi, 2. 324.
haṭabhakkha:
[ haṭa + bhakkha ]  CL=7 One who eats water plants.
Haṭabhakkho vā hoti. Dī, 1. 157. Dī, 3. 33. Abhi, pu. 164.
haṭabhaṇḍa:
[ haṭa + bhaṇḍa ]  CL=7 The wealth or property that is stolen.
Dvādasasaṃvaccharamatthake haṭabhaṇḍaṃ corānaṃ padānupadaṃ gantvā ---- āharissāmi. Jā, ṭṭha, 3. 481.
haṭabhāva:
[ haṭa + bhāva ]  CL=7 (1) A state of being taken away. (2) A state of being stolen.
(1) so kira attanā lesena dārūnaṃ haṭabhāvaṃ ñatvā. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 255.
haṭahaṭakesa:
[ haṭa + haṭa + kesa ]  CL=7 One whose hair is disordered.
Haṭahaṭakeso (saṃ, 1. 116) ti purimakese pacchato, pacchima-kese purato.
haṭaka:
[ haṭa + ṇvu. nīti, dhātu. 53.haṭaka-saṃ. hāṭaka-krañña့်. ]  CL=7 Gold brought up by ants.
Haṭaka (aṃ, 1. 215) nti kipillikāhi nīhaṭasuvaṇṇaṃ. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 200.
haṭasalla:
[ haṭa + salla ]  CL=7 One who has taken out an arrow.
Uddhatasallo (mahāni. 45) ti uddhaṃ haṭasallo uddharita-sallo.
haṭati:
[ haṭa + a + ti. haṭa dittiyaṃ. thoma. haṭati-saṃ. ]  CL=7 That which is radiance.
Haṭa dittiyaṃ. Haṭati. Nīti, dhātu. 53.
haṭha:
[ haṭha + ṇa. dhāna်, ṭī. 399, 400. ]  CL=7 (1) Treat someone with force or violence. (2) Acting or making something with force. (3) Forcibly tying or attaching someone/something to a pole or pillar. (4) Secured or attached to the pillar by force.
(1) (2) balakkāro haṭho bhave. Dhāna. 400. Haṭha balakkāre, ṇo. Dhāna, ṭī. 400. (3) (4) hago saṃvare haṭo tu, hityaṃ haṭho balakkāra. Pluti kīlabaddhe hado, vaccossagge pavattati. Dhātvattha. 421.
haṭhati:
[ haṭha + a + ti. haṭhati-saṃ. ]  CL=7 (1) He treats someone or something with force. (2) He appears on the surface. (3) He attaches someone or something to the pillar.
(1) (3) haṭhati paracakkaṃ balī, haṭhati plavatīti haṭhaṃ, haṭhaṃ paṇṇaṃ yassāti haṭhapaṇṇī,
haṭṭa:
[ haṭa + ṭa. kayavikkayaṭṭhāne. thoma. haṭa dittiyaṃ. haṭṭo āpaṇo. amara, ṭī, byākhyā. haṭṭa-saṃ, prā. ]  CL=7 The marketplace where goods are bought and sold.
Haṭati dibbatīti haṭṭo, kayavikkayaṭṭhānaṃ. Dhātvattha. 421.
haṭṭha:
[ hana ô+ ta. kaccañña်း. 573. hana ôpītimhi, ahasīti haṭṭho. rū. 626. hasa haṃsane, hasa alike vā. dhāna်, ṭī. 752. hasa hāse, hasitthāti haṭṭho. nirutti. 739. haÂÌ-saṃ. haṭṭha-prā, addhamāgadhī. ]  CL=7 (1) Pleased or happy. (2) Having goosebumps or goose pimples.
(1) haṭṭho (vi, 1. 16) ti tuṭṭho. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 172. Haṭṭho udaggo (vi, 1. 264) ti tuṭṭho ceva unnata-kāyacitto ca hutvā. Vi, ṭṭha, 2. 191. Haṭṭhā (aṃ, 1. 66) ti tuṭṭhapahaṭṭhā āmoditā pamoditā. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 40. Pītiyā haṭṭhaṃ. Buddhavaṃ, ṭṭha. 109. (2) atha kho kaccāno saṃviggo lomahaṭṭha-jāto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. Vi, 3. 320. Dī, 1. 47, 89, dī, 2. 193.
haṭṭhabhāva:
[ haṭṭha + bhāva ]  CL=7 (1) A state of being joyful. (2) A state of having goosebumps or goose pimples.
(1) teneva haṭṭhabhāvena bhagavantaṃ abhivā-detvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi. Vi, ṭṭha, 2. 191. (2) sakalasarīralomānaṃ haṭṭhabhā-vo. Sārattha, 2. 10.
haṭṭhabhāvāpādana:
[ haṭṭhabhāva + āpādana]  CL=7 That leads to having goosebumps or goose pimples.
Lomahaṃsana-koti lomānaṃ haṭṭhabhāvāpādano. Saṃ, ṭī, 1. 253.
haṭṭhacitta:
[ haṭṭha + citta ]  CL=7 One with a joyful mind.
Karitvā haṭṭhacittohaṃ, sahatthena samokiriṃ. Apa, 2. 13. Pitusinehaṃ paṭilabhitvā haṭṭhacitto. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 290. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 1. 75. (-apa, ṭṭha, 1. 107).
haṭṭhaloma:
[ haṭṭha + loma ]  CL=7 One with bristling hair.
Kiṃ maṃ muhuṃ pekkhasi haṭṭhalomo. Jā, 1. 370. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 34. Bhīta-tasitā bhayavasena chambhitasarīrā uddhaggalomā honti haṭṭhalomā. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 263.
haṭṭhamānasa:
[ haṭṭha + mānasa ]  CL=7 See - haṭṭhacitta.
Sugatānugataṃ maggaṃ, pūjetvā haṭṭha-mānaso. Apa, 1. 141. Haṭṭhamānaso tuṭṭhacitto pūjetvāti sambandho. Apa, ṭṭha, 2. 107.
haṭṭhapahaṭṭha:
[ haṭṭha + pahaṭṭha ]  CL=7 One who is repeatedly joyful.
Haṭṭhapahaṭṭho udaggudaggo hutvā. Milinda. 7. Haṭṭhapahaṭṭho (vi, ṭṭha, 1. 28) ti (cittapīṇanavasena) punappunaṃ santuṭṭho. Sārattha, 1. 115. Vimati, 1. 26. Sīlāni paripūretīti haṭṭhappahaṭṭho udaggūdaggo sampiyāyamāno sīlāni sampādeti. Aṃ, ṭī, 1. 285-6.
haṭṭhapahaṭṭhabhāvāpādana:
[ haṭṭhapahaṭṭha + bhāva + āpādana ]  CL=7 That which leads to a state of joy or happiness.
Yāthāvato vijjamā-nehi guṇehi haṭṭhapahaṭṭhabhāvāpādanaṃ sampahaṃsanaṃ. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 313.
haṭṭhapahaṭṭhakāla:
[ haṭṭhapahaṭṭha + kāla ]  CL=7 A time of great happiness.
Udakadassanā haṭṭhapahaṭṭhakālo viya pubbabhāgārammaṇe haṭṭhapahaṭṭhākārā pīti. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 161.
haṭṭhapahaṭṭhamatta: [ haṭṭhapahaṭṭha + matta ]  CL=7 Merely elated or simply thrilled. See - haṭṭhapahaṭṭhākāramatta.
haṭṭhapahaṭṭhākāra:
[ haṭṭhapahaṭṭha + ākāra ]  CL=7 (1) Having the manner of extreme joy. (Pu) (2) The manner of being very happy.
(1) See - haṭṭhapahaṭṭhakāla. (2) haṭṭhapa (ppa) haṭṭhākāraṃ pāpento āmodeti pamodati (ca). Sārattha, 2. 244. Visuddhi, ṭī, 1. 341.
haṭṭhapahaṭṭhākāramatta:
[ haṭṭhapahaṭṭhā-kāra + matta ]  CL=7 Merely the manner of extreme happiness.
Buddhānaṃ pana hasitaṃ haṭṭhapahaṭṭhākāramattameva hoti. Ma, ṭṭha, 3. 192. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 63. Bhagavato haṭṭhapahaṭṭhākāramattaṃ hasitaṃ uppādesi. Ma, ṭṭha, 3. 192. Haṭṭhapahaṭṭhākāramattanti haṭṭhapahaṭṭhamattaṃ. Ma, ṭī, 3. 135. Haṭṭhapahaṭṭhākāramattanti haṭṭhassa pahaṭṭhā-kāramattaṃ. Aṃ, ṭī, 3. 54.
haṭṭhatupaga:
[ haṭṭha + tā + upa + gamu + kvi]  CL=7 Reached a state of joy.
Antarāmagge haṭṭhatupagaṃ upakaṃ nāma ājīvakaṃ disvā. Buddhavaṃ, ṭṭha. 343.
haṭṭhatuṭṭha:
[ haṭṭha + tuṭṭha ]  CL=7 One who is very joyful or one who is extremely happy.
Tāvadeva sabbe haṭṭhatuṭṭhā ativiya pāsādikaṃ maṇḍapaṃ paṭiyādesuṃ. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 59. Pahaṭṭhā mahatī camūti “Paveṇīrajjaṃ no diṭṭha”nti haṭṭhatuṭṭhā hutvā mahatī senā. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 20.
haṭṭhatuṭṭhacitta:
[ haṭṭhatuṭṭha + citta ]  CL=7 (1) One who has a very happy mind. (2) One who has an extremely happy mind, marked by joy (pāmojja) and rapture (pīti).
(1) (2) haṭṭhatuṭṭha-citto (dī, ṭṭha, 1. 11) ti ativiya somanassacitto, pāmojjena vā haṭṭhacitto, pītiyā tuṭṭhacitto. Sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 77.
haṭṭhatuṭṭhamānasa:
[ haṭṭhatuṭṭha + mānasa ]  CL=7 See - haṭṭhatuṭṭhacitta.
Dhammaṃ suṇamānā haṭṭha-tuṭṭhamānasā hutvā. Abhi, ṭṭha, 2. 376.
haṭṭhuṃ: [ hara + tuṃ. hatthuṃ= haṭṭhuṃ ]  CL=7 See - abhihaṭṭhuṃ.
hadayamasabbhantara: [ hadayamaṃsa + abbhantara ]  CL=9 Inside the heart muscle. Established inside my heart muscle.
hadayamasacalana: [ hadayamaṃsa + calana ]  CL=9  Trembling/movement of the heart muscle.
hadayamasachedanaphālanakavāta: [ hadaya-maṃsa + chedana + phālanaka + vāta ]  CL=9 Wind that cuts and splits the heart muscle.
hadayamasadohaḷa: [ hadayamaṃsa + dohaḷa ]  CL=9  Desire/craving arising in the heart.
hadayamasadohaḷī: [ hadayamaṃsadohaḷa + ī ]  CL=9 having desire/craving arising in the heart..
hadayamasagahaṇūpāya: [ hadayamaṃsa + gahaṇa + upāya ]  CL=9 Means of grasping/taking the heart muscle.
hadayamasalohita: [ hadayamaṃsa + lohita ]  CL=9 Blood from the heart muscle, heart blood.
hadayamasalohitasamānavaṇṇa: [ hadayamaṃsalohita + samāna + vaṇṇa]  CL=9 Having color similar to heart blood; refers to the bandhu-jīvaka flower (Pentapetes phoenicea).
hadayamasapesi: [ hadayamaṃsa + pesi]  CL=10 Piece/lump of heart muscle/flesh
hadayamasasadisa: [ hadayamaṃsa + sadisa]  CL=9 Similar to/resembling heart muscle/flesh.
halāhalavisasayutta: [ halāhala-visa + saṃyutta ]  CL=9 Mixed with instantly deadly poison
haneyyu: [ hana + a + eyyuṃ ]  CL=9 they should kill/strike/cut.
hanitu: [ hana + tuṃ ]  CL=9 (1) to kill (2) to torture/torment/destroy. (1) hantu (aṃ, 2. 430) nti hanituṃ. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 166. (2) tvaṃ dubbhasi hanituṃ icchasi. Jā, ṭṭha, 3. 178. Varena kodhādayo hanituṃ. Jā, ṭṭha, 4. 10.
hanisu: [ hana + uṃ ]  CL=9 They killed/harmed (past tense plural).
hanumasapariyosāna: [ hanumaṃsa + pariyosāna ]  CL=9 The end/edge of the jaw flesh/muscle.
hanusacopana: [ hanu + saṃcopana ]  CL=9  Movement or motion of the jaw.
hanusahanana: [ hanu + saṃhanana ]  CL=9 The act of immobilizing someone"s jaw through mantras/spells that have the power to bind the mouth.
hareyyu: [ hara + a + eyyuṃ ]  CL=9 They should carry, take.
harissa:
[ hara + a + ssaṃ ]  CL=10 (I) will take, carry.
Addhā harissambaphala (jā, 1. 257) nti addhā ambaphalaṃ āha-rissāmi. Jā, ṭṭha, 4. 204. Ahañca yaṃ ito mūlaphalāphalaṃ tesaṃ harissaṃ. Jā, ṭṭha, 7. 340.
haritahasa: [ harita + haṃsa ]  CL=9 A green-colored swan.
harisu: [ hara + a + uṃ ]  CL=9 (1) They took away. (2) They removed, eliminated.
harāpetu: [ hara + ṇāpe + tuṃ ]  CL=9 In order to cause to remove. I
harāpeyya: [ hara + ṇāpe + eyyaṃ ]  CL=9 Would cause to take away.
harāyeyya: [ hare + eyyaṃ ]  CL=9 Would be ashamed, would feel shame, would be embarrassed.
hasisu: [ hasa + a + uṃ ]  CL=9 they were happy/laughed.
hasāpetu: [ hasa + ṇāpe + tuṃ ]  CL=9 to cause to laugh/happy/fun.
hatamahisa:
[ hata + mahiṃsa ]  CL=7 One who has killed buffaloes.
Hatamahiṃsanaraturaṅgādiradādīnaṃ aṅgāni ālumpitvā. Buddhavaṃ, ṭṭha. 249.
hatasasāracakkāra:
[ hata + saṃsāra + cakka + ara ]  CL=7 Lord Buddha who has destroyed the cycle of rebirth.
Hatasaṃsāra-cakkāro, paccayādīnacāraho. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 87. Visuddhi, 1. 195. Suttani, ṭṭha, 2. 163. Mahāni, ṭṭha. 161.
hatthapādasasīdana:
[ hatthapāda + saṃsīdana]  CL=7 The sinking of the hands and feet or legs.
Amhākaṃ pana mahākammaṃ karontānampi tiyāmarattiṃ dhammaṃ kathentānampi ekadivaseneva dasa yojanāni gacchantānampi hatthapādasaṃsīdanamattaṃ vā piṭṭhirujjanamattaṃ vā na hoti. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 142.
hatthasavācika:
[ hattha + saṃvācika ]  CL=7 One who speaks with the hands or one who communicates with hand gestures.
Tattha hatthasaṃvācikā (abhi, ka. 80) ti mūgā viya hatthamuddhāya vattāro. Abhi, ṭṭha, 3. 146.
hatthasayama: [ hattha + saṃyama ]  CL=7 The restraint of the hands or self-control of the hands. See - hatthasaññamapakkhara.
hatthasayamamaya: [ hattha + saṃyama + maya ]  CL=7 Constructed through the restraint of the hands. See - Hatthasaññamapakkhara.
hatthasayata:
[ hattha + saṃyata ]  CL=7 One who restrains the hands.
Hatthasaṃyato (dhamma. 65) ti hatthakīḷāpanādīnaṃ vā hatthena paresaṃ paharaṇādīnaṃ vā abhāvena hatthasaṃyato. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 2. 362. (khuddaka, ṭṭha. 187. Peta, ṭṭha. 109).
hatthiassagomahisagopaka:
[ hatthī + assa + go + mahiṃsa + gopaka ]  CL=7 One who takes care of the elephants, horses, bulls, buffalos, etc.
Sāmaṃ dāsabyaṃ upagato nāma jīvitahetu vā ārakkhahetu vā ahaṃ te dāsoti sayameva dāsa-bhāvaṃ upagato rājūnaṃ hatthiassago-mahiṃsagopakādayo viya. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 282.
hatthimasa:
[ hatthī + maṃsa ]  CL=7 The meat of the elephant.
Manussā dubbhikkhe hatthimaṃsaṃ paribhuñjanti. Vi, 3. 312. (jā, 1. 292. Jā, ṭṭha, 4. 330).
hatthissarathasakula:
[ hatthī + assa + ratha + saṃkula ]  CL=7 Mixed with elephants, horses, and chariots.
Evampi nagaraṃ mayhaṃ, hatthissarathasaṃkulaṃ. Apa, 1. 38.
haññisu:
[ hana + ya + ū. ū-kiု uṃ-prana်. uṃ-kiု iṃsu-pru. ]  CL=7 They were afflicted or killed.
Tasmiṃ kho brāhmaṇa yaññe neva gāvo haññiṃsu. Dī, 1. 134. Sabbe sattā ca haññiṃsu.
haci:
[ haṃ + ci= hañci, yadi. visuddhi, ṭī, 2. 499.krañña့်ūး. ]  CL=7 See - hañci.
Haṃci tuvaṃ evamaññasi seyyo, puttena pitāti rājaseṭṭha. Jā, 1. 26. Tassattho- yadi tvaṃ rājaseṭṭha sabbaṭṭhā-nesu seyyo puttena pitāti evaṃ maññasi. Jā, ṭṭha, 6. 182.
hacivagga:
[ haṃci + vagga ]  CL=7 A collection of ten Jātakas marked by the word "haṃci."
Haṃcivaggo dvādasamo. Jā, 1. 28. Jā, ṭṭha, 1. 466.
hakanakavāsī:
[ haṃkanaka + vāsī (=vasa + ṇī. thī-၌ --vāsinī. haṅkanaka-sī, mū. ]  CL=7 See - haṅkanakavāsī.
Haṃkanakavāsī mahādattatthero viya. Visuddhi, 2. 270.
hasacchanna:
[ haṃsa + channa ]  CL=7 That which is covered with geese or swans.
Dvādasayo janikaṃ sakalanagaraṃ haṃsacchannaṃ viya ahosi. Jā, ṭṭha, 4. 214.
hasadundubhinissana:
[ haṃsa + dundubhi + nissanā + a. nissana= nisvanā-saṃ. ]  CL=7 One"s sound resembles the sound of a king goose or swan.
Haṃsadundubhinissano (apa, 2. 119) ti haṃsaravo dundubhibherisadda-sadisavacano. Apa, ṭṭha, 2. 227.
hasagaggara:
[ haṃsa + gaggara ]  CL=7 Having a pleasant sound like the sound of a goose.
Haṃsagaggarā (jā, 1. 395) ti evarūpā haṃsā viya madhurassarā nāriyo passati. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 100.
hasagaggarabhāṇī:
[ haṃsagaggara + bhāṇī. thī-၌ --bhāṇinī. ]  CL=7 Speaking with a pleasant sound like the sound of a goose.
Haṃsagaggarabhāṇinī (jā, 2. 218) ti gocaratthāya vicarantānaṃ haṃsapotakānaṃ viya gaggarena madhurena sarena samannāgatā. Jā, ṭṭha, 6. 307-8.
hasagaṇa:
[ haṃsa + gaṇa ]  CL=7 A group of gooses or swans.
Kūjitā haṃsa pūgehī (jā, 1. 360) ti haṃsagaṇehi upakūjitā viravasaṅghaṭṭitā. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 10.
hasagaṇamajjha:
[ haṃsagaṇa + majjha ]  CL=7 In the middle of geese or swans.
Cittakūṭa pabbate haṃsagaṇamajjhe ṭhito viya homi. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 383.
hasagaṇaparivuta:
[ haṃsagaṇa + parivuta]  CL=7 Surrounded by a group of gooses or swans.
Haṃsarājāpi ---- haṃsagaṇaparivuto cittakūṭameva agamāsi. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 381.
hasaghaṭa:
[ haṃsa + ghaṭa ]  CL=7 See - haṃsagaṇa.
Sumukhassa haṃsasenāpatino tīsu haṃsaghaṭāsu taṃ adisvā nivattanañca sabbaṃ mahāhaṃsajātake āvi bhavissa-ti. Jā, ṭṭha, 4. 425.
hasaghātaka:
[ haṃsa + ghātaka ]  CL=7 One who kills a goose or swan.
Ekaṃ haṃsaghātakaṃ bhikkhuṃ ārabbha kathesi. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 2. 360.
hasaghātakabhikkhu:
[ haṃsaghātaka + bhikkhu ]  CL=7 A bhikkhu who kills a goose or swan.
Idaṃ satthā jetavane viharanto ekaṃ haṃsaghātakabhikkhuṃ ārabbha kathesi. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 330.
hasaghātakabhikkhuvatthu:
[ haṃsaghāta-kabhikkhu + vatthu ]  CL=7 The story of a bhikkhu who kills a goose or swan.
Haṃsa ghātakabhikkhuvatthu dutiyaṃ. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 2. 362.
hasaka:
[ haṃsa + ke + a. haṃso iva kāyati saddāyatīti haṃsako. thoma. amara, ṭī, byākhyā. kappadduma. haṃsa + ka. ka-paccañña်း svattha. kappadduma. haṃsaka-saṃ. ]  CL=7 An ornament worn on the anklet.
Tulākoṭi, haṃsako pyatra. Dhāna, ṭī. 288.
hasakoñcamayūrādipakkhisamūha:
[ haṃsa + koñca + mayūra + ādi + pakkhi + samūha ]  CL=7 A group of gooses, sarus crane birds, peacocks, etc.
Haṃsakoñcamayūrādi pakkhisamūhehi ca sobhito. Apa, ṭṭha, 1. 117.
hasakoñcābhinadita:
[ haṃsakoñca + abhinadita ]  CL=7 See - haṃsakoñcābhiruda.
Haṃsakoñcābhinaditā, kosiyā piṅgalā bahū. Apa, 2. 169.
hasakoñcābhiruda:
[ haṃsakoñca + abhiruda ]  CL=7 The crying sounds of gooses and sarus crane birds.
Haṃsakoñcābhirudā (peta. 163) ti haṃsehi ca koñcehi ca abhināditā. Peta, ṭṭha. 145.
hasakula:
[ haṃsa + kula ]  CL=7 A goose lineage.
Teneva ca kāraṇena tāni dve haṃsakulāni aññamaññaṃ vissāsi-kāni jātāni. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 379.
hasakāja:
[ haṃsa + kāja ]  CL=7 A yoke for carrying the goose or swan.
So luddo haṃsakājena, rājadvāraṃ upāgami. Jā, 2. 93. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 394.
hasakīḷita:
[ haṃsa + kīḷita ]  CL=7 See - haṃsakīḷā.
Jātassaraṃ samo gayha, kīḷāmi haṃsakīḷitaṃ. Apa, 1. 318.
hasakīḷā:
[ haṃsa + kīḷā ]  CL=7 The fun/play of a goose or swan.
Haṃsakīḷaṃ kīḷetvā cittakūṭameva paccāgami. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 380.
hasaloka:
[ haṃsa + loka ]  CL=7 The world of swans.
Lokassā (jā, 2. 92) ti haṃsalokassa. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 390.
hasalomādipuṇṇa:
[ haṃsa + loma + ādi + puṇṇa ]  CL=7 Filled with swan feathers, etc.
Haṃsalomādi-pūritāni upadhānāni ṭhapāpesuṃ. Ma, ṭṭha, 3. 13. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 88.
hasamasa:
[ haṃsa + maṃsa ]  CL=7 The meat of the swan or goose.
Etāni haṃsamaṃsā-dīni lacchati. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 160.
hasamaṇḍalākāra: [ haṃsa + maṇḍala + ākāra ]  CL=7 The form of a swan"s circular flight or the circular shape of a swan"s flight' See - haṃsavaṭṭakacchadana, haṃsavaṭṭakacchanna.
hasamaṇḍalākārachanna: [haṃsamaṇḍalā-kāra + channa ]  CL=7 Covered or enveloped by the circular form of a swan"s flight. See - haṃsavaṭṭakacchanna.
hasanasamattha:
[ haṃsana + samattha ]  CL=7 Capable of causing goose pimples.
Lomānaṃ haṃsanasamatthatāya lomahaṃsanaṃ. Cariyā, ṭṭha. 88.
hasapaharanaka:
[ haṃsa + paharana + ka. paharaṇaka?. ]  CL=7 One who kills a goose or swan.
Idaṃ satthā jetavane viharanto ekaṃ haṃsapaharanakaṃ bhikkhuṃ ārabbha kathesi. Jā, ṭṭha, 1. 442.
hasapantisata:
[ haṃsa + panti + sata ]  CL=7 One hundred rows of swan images.
Caturo ca haṃsā (saṃ, 1. 150) ti cattāri haṃsapantisatāni. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 196.
hasaparikkhepasaṇṭhāna: [ haṃsa + parikkhepa + saṇṭhāna ]  CL=7 That which is a round shape like the Mount Haṃsa. See - haṃsavaṭṭakacchadana.
hasaparisā:
[ haṃsa + parisā ]  CL=7 The assembly of the swan or the swan"s followers.
Haṃsaparisā sākiyagaṇo. Jā, ṭṭha, 4. 431.
hasapotaka:
[ haṃsa + pota + ka. thī-၌ --potikā. ]  CL=7 A baby swan or goose.
Yathā hi haṃsapota-kā ---- gacchanti. Visuddhi, 1. 148. Haṃsapotakāti javanahaṃsapotakā. Visuddhi, ṭī, 1.
hasapuppha:
[ haṃsa + puppha ]  CL=7 The feather from the wings of a swan or goose.
Haṃsapuppha (vi, ṭṭha, 2. 59) nti haṃsānaṃ pakkhapattaṃ. Vajira. 167.
hasapātana:
[ haṃsa + pātana ]  CL=7 A pond of the wandering place of geese or swans is called Haṃsapātana and Mandākinī.
Sīhapapātano (sīhapātano) haṃsapātano ----
hasaratha:
[ haṃsa + ratha ]  CL=7 Haṃso ratho vāhanaṃ yassāti haṃsaratho. Kappadduma. Haṃsaratha-saṃ.
A Brahma with four faces.
(thoma). Haṃsaratho, viriñco,papitā-maho
hasarava: [ haṃsa + rava ]  CL=7 The sound of swans. See - haṃsadundubhinissana.
hasaruta:
[ haṃsa + ruta ]  CL=7 See - haṃsarava.
Haṃsarutehi nigghosaṃ, viññāpentaṃ mahājanaṃ. Apa, 2. 108.
hasarāja:
[ haṃsa + rāja ]  CL=7 A king of swans.
Haṃsarājaṃ gahetvāna. Vi, 2. 340. (-vi, ṭṭha, 1. 44).
hasarūpa: [ haṃsa + rūpa ]  CL=7 The form or image of a swan. See - haṃsarūpasata.
hasarūpasata:
[ haṃsarūpa + sata ]  CL=7 One hundred images of swans.
Caturo ca haṃsā (saṃ, 1. 150) ti cattāri haṃsarūpasatāni. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 196.
hasasadisagāmī: [ haṃsa + sadisa + gāmī ]  CL=7 Having the same nature as a swan and going or going like a swan. See - haṃsasamabhāga.
hasasadisassara: [ haṃsasadisa + sara ]  CL=7 One"s sound is like the sound of a swan king or the king of swans. See - haṃsassara.
hasasahassa:
[ haṃsa + sahassa ]  CL=7 One thousand swans or geese.
Ete channavuti haṃsasahassā ñātivihaṅgamā maṃ chaḍḍetvā gacchanti. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 360.
hasasakuṇa:
[ haṃsa + sakuṇa. thī-၌ haṃsasakuṇī. ]  CL=7 A swan or goose.
Ahaṃ haṃsasakuṇī viya tato tato nikkhamitvā asajjamānā gamissāmi. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 2. 137.
hasasamabhāga:
[ haṃsa + sama + bhāga ]  CL=7 A part that resembles a swan.
Haṃsasamabhāgo (apa, 2. 119) ti haṃsasadisagāmī. Apa, ṭṭha, 2. 227.
hasasavhaya:
[ haṃsa + saha + avhaya. nīti, sutta. 746. ]  CL=7 The Haṃsavatī city is called Haṃsa.
Upāgami tadā buddho, nagaraṃ haṃsasavhayaṃ. Apa, 1. 41.
hasasenāpati: [ haṃsa + senāpati ]  CL=7 A swan general leading an army of swans. See - haṃsaghaṭa.
hasassara:
[ haṃsa + sara ]  CL=7 The sound of the king of swans.
Haṃsassarañño (vimāna. 53) ti haṃsassaro añño, haṃsasadi-sassaro aparo. Vimāna, ṭṭha. 152.
hasataruṇa:
[ haṃsa + taruṇa ]  CL=7 A young goose or swan. 
pyiurvayapyiunu sohaṅsāṅhaka, haṅsāṅhakaṅaya. Dviguṇakoṭṭhāsalābhī haṃsataruṇo jāle paharitvā cattāri bhindi. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 509.
hasavaha:
[ haṃsa + vaha ]  CL=7 A horse named Haṃsavaha.
Haṃsavahaṃ nāma vara turaṅgamāruyha mahābhinikkhamanaṃ nikkhamitvā. Buddhavaṃ, ṭṭha. 240.
hasavantu:
[ haṃsa + vantu. thī-၌ haṃsavatī]  CL=7 The mansion named Haṃsava.
Haṃsavā yasavā sirinandoti tassa tayo pāsādā ahesuṃ. Buddhavaṃ, ṭṭha. 307.
hasavara:
[ haṃsa + vara ]  CL=7 A noble swan or goose.
Sumukho pana haṃsavaro ca mahā. Jā, 2. 148. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 553.
hasavattakādipokkharaṇīgata:
[ haṃsavattakādi + pokkharaṇī + gata ]  CL=7 See - haṃsavaṭṭakādipokkharaṇīgata.
Haṃsavattakādipokkharaṇīgatassa ca udakassa paricchedo natti. Dī, ṭṭha, 2. 30.
hasavatīnagara:
[ haṃsavatī + nagara ]  CL=7 See - haṃsavatī (A).
Haṃsavatīnagaraṃ sampāpuṇi. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 106. Haṃsavatī-nagare padumuttarakālepi sattāhaṃ mahādānaṃ datvā. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 1. 63.
hasavatīnagaravāsika:
[ haṃsavatīnagara + vāsī + ka ]  CL=7 The townfolk of Haṃsavatī.
Haṃsavatīnagara vāsike gandhamālādihatthe yena buddho yena.
hasavatīnāmaka:
[ haṃsavatī + nāma + ka ]  CL=7 Named Haṃsavatī or the one called Haṃsavatī.
Haṃsavatī nāmake nagare aññatarassa brāhmaṇa-mahāsālassa eko putto uppajji. Thera, ṭṭha, 1. 19.
hasavaṭṭaka: [ haṃsa + vaṭṭaka ]  CL=7 The form of a circle of swan wings. See - haṃsavaṭṭakacchadana, vaṃsavaṭṭakacchanna.
[ haṃsavaṭṭaka + ṇa ]  CL=7 The decorative design resembles the form of a circle of swan wings.  See - haṃsavaṭṭakacchadana, haṃsavaṭṭakacchanna.
hasavaṭṭakacchadana: [ haṃsavaṭṭaka + chadana ]  CL=7 A layered covering in the form of a decorative circle of swans wings.
hasavaṭṭakacchanna:
[ haṃsavaṭṭaka + channa ]  CL=7 See - haṃsavaṭṭakacchadana.
Kūṭāgāraṃ anto katvā haṃsavaṭṭakacchannena katā sabbā-kārasampannā buddhassa bhagavato gandhakuṭi. Ma, ṭṭha, 2. 169. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 3.
hasavaṭṭakapaṭicchanna: [ haṃsavaṭṭaka + paṭicchanna ]  CL=7 Covering or forming a roof in the shape of a decorative circle of swan wings. See - haṃsavaṭṭakacchadana, haṃsavaṭṭakacchanna.
hasavaṭṭakādipokkharaṇigata:
[ haṃsa-vaṭṭaka + ādi + pokkharaṇī + gata ]  CL=7 Located in a square-shaped pond, featuring designs such as a decorative circle of geese and others.
Haṃsavaṭṭakādipokkharaṇi-gatassa ca udakassa paricchedo natthi. Ma, ṭṭha, 4. 131.
hasavaṭṭakādisenāsana:
[ haṃsavaṭṭakādi + senāsana ]  CL=7 A dwelling place featuring designs such as a decorative circle of geese and others.
Haṃsavaṭṭakādi-senāsanāni ceva maṇḍalamāḷabhojana-sālādīni ca patiṭṭhapetvā kato vihāro.
hasayoni:
[ haṃsa + yoni ]  CL=7 A swan species.
Atha kho bhikkhave so brāhmaṇo kālaṅkatvā aññataraṃ haṃsayoniṃ upapajji. Vi, 2. 339.
hasayuttaratha:
[ haṃsa + yutta + ratha ]  CL=7 A chariot associated with images of swans.
Ahaṃ pana haṃsayuttarathe nisīditvā gacchāmi. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 35.
hasayūtha:
[ haṃsa + yūtha ]  CL=7 See - haṃsagaṇa.
Athekadivasaṃ tato haṃsa-yūthā katipayā suvaṇṇahaṃsā mānusiyaṃ saraṃ gantvā. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 359.
hasenti: [ haṃsa + ṇe + anti ]  CL=7 They cause goosebumps or goose pimples. See - haṃseti.
haseti:
[ haṃsa + ṇe + ti. haṃsati-mha. ]  CL=7 That which causes goosebumps or goose pimples.
Diṭṭhamattā vā sutamattā vā lomāni haṃsentīti lomahaṃsanarūpā. Mahāni, ṭṭha. 375.
hasādhipati:
[ haṃsa + adhipati ]  CL=7 The king of swans or the leader of swans.
Dhataraṭṭhā mahārāja, haṃsādhipatino ime. Jā, 2. 86. Mahārāja ime dhataraṭṭhakule jātā dve
hasādika:
[ haṃsa + ādi + ka ]  CL=7 Swans and others (like them).
Haṃsādike abhibhavanto viya nadanti. Thera, ṭṭha, 1. 97.
hasāpana:
[ haṃsa + ṇāpe + yu ]  CL=7 Causing goosebumps or goose pimples due to gladness.
Lomahaṃsana (peta. 202) nti bhiṃsanakabhāvena lomānaṃ haṃsāpanaṃ. Peta, ṭṭha. 234.
hasārāma:
[ haṃsa + ārāma ]  CL=7 A monastery named Haṃsārāma.
Haṃsārāmamupeccāhaṃ, vanditvā taṃ tathāgataṃ. Apa, 2. 157.
hasāvatī:
[ haṃsa + vantu + ī. haṃsavatī-phraca်saṅa့်sañña်. ]  CL=7 See - haṃsavatī.
Haṃsāvatī nāma nagaraṃ ahosi jātanagaraṃ. Dī, ṭī, 2. 83.
hasāvaṭṭaākāra: [ haṃsa + āvaṭṭa + ākāra ]  CL=7 The form resembles the turning motion of a swan"s wing. See - haṃsavatī.
hasī:
[ haṃsa + ī. haṃsī-saṃ. ]  CL=7 A female swan or goose.
Haṃsī kākī kukkuṭī. Rū. 87-nhā. Haṃsātiādīhipi haṃsīādayopi gahitā. Nīti, sutta. 823.
hasūpakūjita:
[ haṃsa + upakūjita ]  CL=7 The crying sound of swans.
Rammāni vanacetyāni, rammā haṃsūpakūjitā. Jā, 2. 222. Jā, ṭṭha, 7. 18.
haṭṭhu: [ hara + tuṃ. hatthuṃ= haṭṭhuṃ ]  CL=7 See - abhihaṭṭhuṃ.
